reviews.title: GOVEE is where it's at it seems
reviews.body: I have several Govee products and I have watched a lot of growth over the years. What brought me back to Govee was not only their string lights, but the customer support is amazing. And they probably would win the popularity vote if there was one. Now it is getting to the point that when Govee releases another product, I want to buy it whether I need it or not. This table light is no exception! I wanted it just because it's Govee and who doesn't want a table side light that can do a heck of a lot more than just be a light. The scenes are amazing and there are so many to choose from. So not only can it be a white light that you can change the brightness but it can be programed to similate a sunrise when you get up or a sunset when you go to bed or any other combination in between. I had a night light with a smart bulb in it and was quite happy with it. But the Table light seemed like it would be the perfect companion. No matter what, I like this light, but there are a couple of things that could use help. This goes for just about every light strip that Govee has and it has to do with the music feature. For the most part it syncs well enough to most beats, but what bothers me and a ton of others is that when there is no sound, it still dances with light. So it's not exact. One day they will address this issue. The other issue that is not a problem for everyone, but certainly is for new people and even more so for older people who are not into apps and programing lights to do what they want it to. The presets are great, don't get me wrong, but there is a number of people that have issues in not knowing how to do even basic stuff. Don't be intimidated, there is plenty of support and plenty of communities who are willing to help. I just wish that Govee had their own How to Videos. But the growth has been amazing. I also think that prices are premium and they don't have to be. But once you bite down on the purchase, you will have a lot of fun with their products and for that reason I'm in.

reviews.title: Good enough that we bought two, Govee app just keeps getting better
reviews.body: I have two of these lights in my office, and absolutely love how customisable the lamps are. The lamps include touch controls on top for on/off, brightness and cycling between basic scenes, but the Govee app really shines for these. The amount of scenes that come pre-loaded is great, and being able to browse user made scenes, create your own, and curate them with AI is just insane. I especially love that the lighting on these is seamless; there's no ugly LED band that appears on the lamp, and with enough tweaking, there's no lag on the scenes that change light colours. My only complaint is related to that lag, it's quite difficult finding a scene where the colours don't jitter a bit. However, of you stick to the basic scenes or just use the lamp as natural coloured light, it's ideal. It also gets very bright when using the lamp in the white colour temperature mode, and the lamp itself is really stylish and modern, the base is super cool. And lastly for people who like tech specs, it plugs in with a DC barrel jack, with a cable that's about 5 feet long. The lamp also has crazy comparability with Home Assistant via Govee Cloud add one, but I've not dove deep enough into that yet!

reviews.title: Excellent early impression.
reviews.body: 1. The controls are at the base of the vertical riser. They do not get obstructed by other items on the desk. Controls are very intuitive except for the 45-minute shut-off timer. No silly remote control to lose. 2. The base is about 6" by 6" and is made out of steel plate. It is large enough and heavy enough that the lamp is very stable. There is a soft, non-skid pad on the bottom that protects the table surface while keeping the lamp from being inadvertantly pushed around. I specifically wanted a lamp with a base such as this rather than a clamp-on type. 3. There is enough vertical adjustment to clear the top of large monitors. 4. The arms and lamp came pre-assembled. The only assembly requirment is to slip the upright post onto the base and plug in the power supply. 5. The power supply transformer plugs into a standard 120 VAC outlet. The cord is over 6 feet long so placement is not an issue. 6. Color temperature and brightness adjustments are easy. The lamp is sufficiently bright for reading printed material. 7. The light diffusion is quite uniform and has a wide dispersion angle. I originally was looking for a unit with a light bar ("wings") but this has proven completely adequate. I hope that it lasts for quite a while. The manufacturer states that there is an 18-month waranty but that is hard to count on with Chinese manufacturers. Really happy with this lamp, especially for the price.

reviews.title: Excellent lamp for use with tall monitor configurations
reviews.body: After purchasing an Omorepa lamp to place behind my Dell UltraSharp U5226KW monitor, I discovered it was not quite tall enough to position properly without shining directly into my eyes. I ended up returning it and trying the LitONES desk lamp instead because it was slightly taller and, importantly, allowed the lamp head to rotate independently. That flexibility turned out to be exactly what I needed. I initially bought one lamp just to test the setup and quickly realized I had finally found the right solution. The lamp is tall enough to work well behind the 26.5-inch-tall Dell monitor, and the adjustable head makes it easy to angle the light over the monitor and down onto the keyboard and work area without glare. The light itself provides a soft white glow and the brightness can be adjusted easily. Because the monitor is extremely wide, I eventually purchased a second lamp and positioned one on each side behind the display. The only minor inconvenience is that each lamp must be turned on separately since there is no remote control. But honestly, that is a very small complaint — I can lean over and switch them both on in about five seconds. A pretty good sign that I may be a little spoiled at this point. If you have a tall monitor and prefer placing lights behind it so the illumination projects over the display onto your workspace, these lights are definitely worth considering.

reviews.title: Surprisingly Premium Monitor Light — Great for Daily Work and Low-Light Days
reviews.body: I’ve been using this monitor light, for several weeks, on an Acer display for daily work, and overall it’s been a really solid addition to my desk setup. Installation was straightforward — it mounted easily and felt secure once positioned. No complicated setup or tools required, which I always appreciate. The lighting itself is where this really shines (no pun intended). The adjustable color temperature range from warm to cool is useful depending on what you’re doing. It can give you more of a relaxed desk lamp vibe in warmer tones or a bright, focused work light when you need better visibility for detailed tasks. There’s also an auto-dimming feature, but I personally prefer setting a static brightness level once and leaving it there. The included remote control is a nice touch and honestly makes the product feel more premium than the price point would suggest. Build quality feels better than expected — not cheap or flimsy. I use this every day for work, and it’s especially helpful during gloomy weather or late afternoons when natural light drops off. It reduces the need for overhead lighting and keeps the workspace evenly illuminated without glare on the screen. My only real complaint is the articulation adjustment. The mounting design doesn’t provide quite enough tension, so adjusting the angle sometimes requires two hands to keep everything aligned. It’s not a dealbreaker, but it’s an area that could be improved in a future version. Overall, this has been a great upgrade for my workspace and something I didn’t realize I needed until I started using it consistently.

reviews.title: Excellent monitor light at a great value!
reviews.body: I'd been considering a monitor desk light for some time now, but I could not justify the price tag giong as high as $200 on the BenQ "original" that sorta started it off with these types of lights. This was a couple years ago now and clearly today there are many different versions of similar monitor lights on the market, the Quntis being among them, and which appears to be a fairly close copy of the BenQ light. I found this one on Amazon, priced around $40 for the non-remote (remote being rather superfluous in my opinion) version and did a little comparison research to see if this might be a good fit. There are many similar monitor lights out there, some cheaper and going as low as ~$25 and some obviously more expensive. I figured the Quntis was a good middle ground price-wise and took a shot to see if this would fit the bill. Indeed it does! Whether or not, or how close a copy to the BenQ the Quntis is I don't know for sure, as I've never seen the alternatives, but I can say this one is very well designed and well constructed, some plastic and also some metal in the construction and on close inspection the quality is definitely there. The mounting system is simple and functional and adapted perfectly to my HP Omen gaming monitor, which I would say has a somewhat non-standard profile shape and thickness, at least at the top where the light mounts. No problem, the mount is easily adjustable and rests perfectly and securely on my top monitor edge with full confidence that it's not going anywhere, or is any way unstable or wonky. The light controls on top of the light are easily accessible, operated by touch and the tactile "buttons" are shaped so they can be easily felt when operating the light. There are stepless controls for brightness and color temperature, as well as a sort of "auto" button that adjusts the brightness based on the ambient light in the room, which is nice. The lightbar throws a very nice pool of light on your keyboard and desk space in front of, and not directly ON, your monitor - right where you need it - without any glare, or being too harsh. Again, the quality, brightness and temperature of the light is easily adjustable to your liking. The monitor mounting system is sensible, simple, highly adjustable and highly functional. Lamp is powered by USB and in my case plugs right into a USB port on my monitor and totally invisible, hidden behind. Anyway, I guess I might have got a little carried away with this review, but tldr; the Quntis is an excellent monitor light and if this is something you've been looking at, I don't think you can go wrong with this one.

reviews.title: All Good except 1 Big Thing
reviews.body: TLDR: Solid build, good light quality, useful brightness and color controls, and a swing arm that does most of what you want. The big catch is that it does not behave the way modern smart home users will expect, and the mounting geometry has some real-world limits the listing photos do not show. Four stars, with caveats worth knowing before you click buy. Let me lead with the good, because there is plenty of it. The light itself is genuinely nice. Plenty of brightness for working, reading, or close-up tasks, and the color temperature options give you warm yellow, neutral white, and a cooler white-blue depending on what you are doing. Eleven brightness levels is more granularity than I expected. The arm extends and folds well, and the head pivots to put light right where you want it. It runs on USB, the wall adapter is included, and the wattage is low enough that you can power it from a laptop port if that is convenient. The clamp mount is solid and holds tight once you have it in place. A note on installation. The clamp wants a specific amount of mounting surface, and my location had less than the lamp wanted in one direction. I pulled out a Dremel and shaved a small relief into the underside so the clamp could sit properly. Not a complaint, just a heads up if your desk has a thick lip, a beveled edge, or a rounded corner where you want this to live. Now, the big thing. This lamp does not default to on when power is restored. If you turn it off and walk away, fine. If your power blips, or if you have it on a smart switch that cuts power, the lamp comes back off. To turn it back on you have to walk over to the lamp and press the little button on the inline cord controller, which sits close to the base of the arm and is not always easy to reach. This matters because the listing advertises a memory function, and modern buyers, especially anyone with a smart home setup, are going to read that and assume something it does not actually mean. Here is what is happening. The memory function does work, in a narrow sense. When you press the on button, the lamp comes back at whatever brightness and color mode you used last. It does not have to be reset every time. That is real and it is useful. What the memory function does not do is preserve the on/off state across a power cut. The reason is that this is a soft-touch push button rather than a mechanical switch. The lamp's electronics have to be powered to know they are on, and when power is removed and restored the default state is off. A traditional mechanical switch physically holds the circuit closed and is why your bedroom lamp comes back on when the power flickers. This one does not, by design. If you live in a fully manual lighting world, this is a non-issue. You will press the button and life goes on. If you have your office lights on a smart switch, or you have ever said the words "Google (or Alexa), turn on the lights," this is going to be an ongoing minor annoyance. I had assumed, like most lights, that I could plug this into the same smart switch as the rest of the room and have it come on with everything else. Instead it sits there dark while everything else lights up, waiting for me to walk over and poke it. The other thing worth flagging is the arm geometry. The first segment, the one closest to the clamp, is not designed to swing forward. It folds up and back, which is fine on an open desk where you have empty wall behind you. If you are mounting this on the back edge of a desk that sits against a wall, on the lip of a hutch, on top of a shelving unit, or inside a cubicle, you are going to discover that the elbow needs room to bow outward behind the lamp. The listing photos all show the lamp on an open desk with nothing behind it, so this is not obvious until you have it in hand. Plan your mounting location with that in mind. There is also a 45 minute auto-off timer button on the controller. Apparently aimed at bedtime reading. I have not used it but it is there if you want it. Four stars. The light is good and the build is good. The memory function exists but means something different than a smart home buyer will assume, and the mounting flexibility has limits that the listing does not show. If you can live with those, this is a nice lamp at a fair price. If you were hoping to drop it into an automated lighting routine, you are going to want to know about the default-off behavior before you order.

reviews.title: An Excellent Lamp with a Small Caveat
reviews.body: This is a great lamp. It is VERY bright, and has lots of cool color and warmth settings. It's a very light sheet steel construction, and folds up neatly with a convenient hand screw for quick removal and installation. The boom, arm, and light mantle are highly flexible and have a solid range of motion, and keep their position very well. The light strip is VERY large, with LOTS of LEDs and casts a very significant amountt of light. In it's highest setting, probably several thousand lumens across each LED. It is powered by USB, and draws close to 15 watts. The manufacture rates the light at 12 watts, however, they only supply a 10 watt, 5-volt @ 2-amp USB wall adapter. The supplied wall adapter started to cut in-and-out after about 3 months of regular nightly use at 80%+ brightness plus warmth settings. If you don't run the light past roughly 75%, you won't have any problems. Otherwise, I'd recommend upgrading to a 5-volt @ 3-amp USB wall adapter to save the hassle. For that I'm deducting a star. Your mileage may vary. I paid about $36 in December of 2025. It was worth the money. I do structural engineering and CAD, and like to see my keyboard while up at night. TL;DR: Worth the money, well built, and very bright, but needs at least a 5-volt @ 3-amp USB wall adapter to work to it's full capacity, as the supplied 2-amp adapter is not substantial enough for light levels above 75% plus warmth settings. Pictures coming ASAP.

reviews.title: Perfect... in most keys
reviews.body: I got this lamp to use on a grand piano at church. The arm reaches across reasonably well from the side (though it doesn’t extend far enough to be fully centered over the music desk). The multiple color temperatures and brightness levels are very helpful for accommodating the preferences of various users, and all our pianists seem to like it. It works smoothly and perfectly... in most keys. BUT if you like to play in D-flat, beware! I just discovered that the resonance point of the casing appears to be a D-flat (138.591 Hz). The plastic started buzzing quietly when playing strong tonic chords in that key. This was, of course, horrifying. I assume the same disturbing outcome holds true when playing in C-sharp major, since the identical notes are used, but I only had sheet music in D-flat today. More testing would be needed to determine whether the issue extends to enharmonic keys, but this didn’t seem urgent to share here, since: • I didn’t want to go into too much detail that isn’t relevant to the average consumer (because we all hate that), and • Only psychos play in C-sharp major anyway. I realize this acoustic phenomenon may not affect all potential buyers of this lamp, but it seems like this particular harmonic bug could be mentioned somewhere in the description—if not in the product title itself—just so that members of the five-flats-loving community have some warning. Oh, also, the buzzing stopped as soon as I moved the arm slightly, so there’s that.

reviews.title: Great modern looking desk lamp
reviews.body: Very sleek, modern looking lamp with a variety of lighting levels. It matches my black glass desktop very nicely, adding a sophisticated modern look. Contrary to what some reviewers said, I think it has a relatively small footprint on the desk, which is nice because I'd rather utilize the desktop space for working instead of a huge lamp. I've wiped it down here for the photos, but do realize that it is a dust/fingerprint/cat hair collector. Smudges show up, so if you're not willing to wipe it down every now and then you might be disappointed with it's overall aesthetic look. Pro tip: I keep a pack of Pledge multi-surface wipes ( Pledge Multi Surface Everyday Wipes Fresh Citrus, 25-Count (Pack of 4) ) in a drawer near my desk to wipe both it and the lamp down - takes a few seconds and looks as good as new. I mostly use this lamp at its lowest setting, as it provides a nice ambience to my work area. Each of the preset light levels can be brightened and dimmed. If I'm going to be doing real work, the light gets bright enough by itself to make reading from a textbook or paperwork comfortable and without strain. Usually one of the reading or middle settings is as bright as I'll go for reading actual pages from a book, and I only use the brightest settings if I'm struggling to see something small like jewelry or I'm fiddling with some component or part of my computer. It does get quite bright. I haven't used the timer function, but there is an automatic 60 minute timer included. Overall, it's a versatile little lamp. I got mine on sale at Christmas during a flash sale, for thirty something dollars, and I think it's well worth it. The listed price, however, is complete rubbish - total waste to pay full price regardless of how well it works, as it is simply made up of plastic and LED bulbs. Wait for a sale and you'll be happy with it. I've included photos of the lamp with various light levels and in different positions.

reviews.title: Visually appealing, nice size, sensible controls that remember your previous settings!
reviews.body: First of all, I really appreciate a desk lamp that can simulate the warm glow of an incandescent lamp (this is 3k, not 2.7k which is close enough for me). The harsh white/blue colors of many LED lamps don't do it for me but if that is what you want, you can get that here too! In addition, I think it is nice to have a consistent light color throughout the entire house and the warm color is consistent with the rest of my home. I also really appreciate that I can turn it on/off and have it come back on at the LAST SETTINGS that I had previously!! I don't have to re-set my preference every time I turn on the lamp which is not uncommon (I have other lamps that I have to press the button 3-4+ times to get it to the intensity and/or color that I want every time I turn it on). Once you set your preference, it remembers it! It is somewhat of a minimalist design, just enough equipment to do what it needs to do. The black color matches the other things on my desktop. It does have quite a lot of brightness levels which I also appreciate. I find the height to be about right. reviews.title: Massive desk coverage and true colors perfect for dual monitors!
reviews.body: I bought this 4-head lamp for my large workstation setup and it has completely transformed my workspace. If you have dual monitors or a massive 90-inch desk area, this light coverage is unmatched. The Good: Phenomenal Coverage & Flexibility: The 4-head design is a game-changer. With the combination of the 360° flexible neck, folding arms, and rotatable heads, you can eliminate every single shadow on your desk. You can fold them out wide or point them down directly for detailed work. True Eye-Care (CRI 95+): The light is genuinely soft, flicker-free, and anti-glare. Colors look vibrant and accurate under it, which is incredibly helpful for crafting, reading, or long hours staring at a computer screen without eye strain. Dual Controls: Having both the wireless remote control and the hand-wave motion sensor makes adjusting settings effortless. The stepless dimming and adjustable color temperatures (from warm yellow to crisp daylight) work flawlessly. The Not-So-Good: Clamp Clearances: The desk clamp is very sturdy, but make sure your desk has enough of a lip underneath to attach it securely (it fits up to 2 inches thick). Takes Adjustment Time: Because there are so many points of articulation, it might take a few minutes of twisting and bending to find your perfect angle without hitting the tops of your monitors. Verdict: An exceptional, space-saving architect lamp that clears up desk room by clamping to the back. It’s easily worth the price if you need powerful, customizable lighting!

Overall, this is a very well-designed desk lamp and a great upgrade for any desk or home office. Highly recommend.

reviews.body: I ordered this for better lighting for miniature painting as well as lighting up my desk area. It is a light lamp and has a heavy base, I incorrectly ordered this instead of the mounting one to gain desk space, which is a small foot print so not terrible. The simple minimalist look is sleek and contemporary meeting almost any desk or setup universally. The lamp feels sturdy and solid but you can tell the material is not all metal but some pressed plastic or much cheaper thin alloy material which is non-magnetic, maybe thin aluminum. The buttons are touch sensors not actual clicky buttons so that could put some folks off but non-issue for me. The lighting has color adjustments so you can light to you preference whether warm, cool, or cold and even has an automatic brightness and stepping feature built in. Honestly I though the brightness feature was a gimmick however using it as a back light in my office has improved my eye comfort from long periods at the computer for work. While the lamp is very easy to adjust and stays in place when moved the information presented makes it seem like the lamp head would rotate 180º which it does just not in the direction expected, meaning the lamp must always be parallel to the surface it is placed on no exceptions. I dinged it a star because of this as the image shown seems to be a bit misleading whether intentional or not. It uses a power adapter with barrel socket to the lamp so is not portable and does not charge, has no remote though there are auto stepping and brightness features you must manually activate the lamp.

The lamp is also sturdilly made and has a heavy base so it doesn't tip over as you move the arms and body post. It's also tall enough to provide ample light coverage, yet compact enough to fit comfortably on my desk. The versatility of this lamp makes it a great choice for any workbench or study area. After searching the site for several hours and reading tons of reviews I finally decided to search my order history to see exactly what lights I had already ordered for video recording. This light came up and "ding", a light came on in my head. "Why not get the desk light for the sewing table???" I did place an order for another desk light since I am so pleased with my first one. Not only is the quality of the light amazing, so is the longevity. It's been almost 2 years and I have not had one issue with my desk lamp. I'm sure I will be pleased with the new one. reviews.title: Great Double Head LED Desk Lamp
reviews.body: This is a great 24W for my office desk where I spend too much time at LOL. Having good bright and adjustable light and different temperature's is also great when your eyes get tired. When the LED dual head lights are extended, it measures 80cm/ 31.5 inches which covers most of mt (2) 27" HP monitors. Having the dual LED head able to adjust is great for when I occasional light up the desk for when I take pictures. The top of the light has a sensitive touch buttons, it can easy to control color temperature and brightness individually. It has 5 dimming levels and adjustable 5 color temperatures modes (3,200 K-6,500 K). The LED light also has a memory function that remembers your last Settings when turned on and off. The whole light is supported by a heavy screw clamp that should accommodate most solid surface or desk. The shaft or arm of the light comes in 2 pieces, one solid aluminum and the other is a heavy flexible goose neck that can bend at different areas of the shaft to accommodate heights as much as 33"/83.8cm. The dual headed LED light also comes with a remote control that's nice but I personal don't use because if I'm at the desk working, it's easier to just turn the light off and on or do adjustments right in front of me. Once you clamp the light to the desk or table and assembled it, you need to remember to use the screws provided to tighten the arm to the clamp base and the two arms together or it will shake and wobble. I love this dual adjustable headed LED light and when you try to find and compare this light to the big box stores, this is a great value.

reviews.title: Lovely desk lamp for my mini office.
reviews.body: I ordered this desk lamp off of Vine for my office because I needed one and was remodeling. I was using just a regular light that is on my ceiling and it was creating a glare on my Monitor that was hard on my eyes. This one is much better. It is adjustable. Bendable, Dimmable and has eye saving features with different colors of light. A White neon type. A medium light and a Warm light that is very easy on the eyes. Setting it up was pretty easy. Clip it all together. put in a few screws. It even came with a mini screw driver. The light has a spot to hide the cord.. Along its side. It clips right in and hides . I thought this was a very nice feature. More should have it. You cannot even see the cord at all. The lamp comes with a remote for hands free operation. It also has 4 buttons on the top to control the brightness. Mode and a timer function. You can turn it off and on to from there. The neck is flexible and bendable so you can set this up in many different ways. The arms of the lamp both pivot 180 degrees. So you can keep it horizontal looking or pivot them to the front for when working on things. reading documents or need to see fine details. The clip was nice and sturdy on my desk. No bends or breaks. I hooked it on pretty tight to. Solid build quality all the way through. All in all I really like it. I think this lamp makes a great office light and can also be a very good workshop light. Or lab light. Or even just a reading lamp for your room. The retail price was more then fair and it just works. No complaints. I love it and can recommend it. Thanks a ton.

reviews.title: Long LED heads, super bright, high and flexible stand
reviews.body: This is a double-head LED lamp that is very bright and raised high on desk edge. The head lights are two LED panels that can rotate 90 degrees horizontal between front and side. It doesn’t have a lamp stand on desk. It has a desk edge mounting bracket that can be mount to a variety of thickness of desk. A fixed metal pole attached to the mounting bracket. Then a flexible goose neck attached to the metal pole which then hold the LED heads. The goose neck can be adjusted to any angle of your choice. Both the metal pole and the flexible goose neck bring the LED heads very high over desk that you can place monitors underneath the LED heads. Both LED panels can independently rotate at axis of the center of the LED heads. On top of the center of LED heads there are 4 touch buttons: power on/off, light color temperature, dim and brightness. These buttons are very sensitive and responsive. In addition to the control buttons on the LED heads, the desk lamp comes with tiny remote control for convenience. It has exactly the same 4 buttons as those on the LED heads. The desk lamp comes with a special power adapter which provides 24V/1A power for the lamp. The wire attached to the LED heads can be inserted into the slots of the goose neck and metal pole, so that it is not visible. A very detailed design. Excellent. The bottom screw plate of the mounting bracket is kind of small compare to the weight of the lamp that it needs to hold. Not sure if it will be strong enough and durable. So far so good. Very good desk lamp. Highly recommend.

With my existing lighting, I had difficulties in getting the lighting correct and without shadows. After looking at several items on Amazon, I opted for this one. The price was better for me too. I ordered the white one but thought that I had received a pink one upon receipt since the one pictured on the box was pink. Apparently, the boxes all show pink ones, I suppose. This is made in China (pictured). Likes: This light is quite flexible and allows different angles. Obviously, if you extend the arm with the light out too far, this will fall forward since it disrupts the center of gravity too much. If I needed it to extend farther, it would not take something of much weight to be placed on the base to keep it from tipping over. The light is quite bright. It has 3 settings of brightness. The easy-to-work single button facilitates on level 1, then level 2, then level 3, and then back off (I tried to show the different levels of lighting in my pics). The button is very easy to operate. The light came charged enough to try. The instructions suggest going ahead and charging it, which I did. A small light near the charging port illuminates red to show it is charging and turns green when completed. The charging cable is a standard USB A to USB C. I like the fact that it is rechargeable. I found this to be a reasonable price. It has a small footprint and easily folds away for storage. It's aesthetically pleasing. There are small pads on the bottom of the base to keep it from sliding around. These would make nice and inexpensive gifts. Dislikes: I really don’t have any dislikes at this time. Neutrals: Some reviewers reported the light not lasting very long, both battery life and functionality. Time and usage will be the judge. I will try to update this review accordingly if necessary. reviews.body: I've had the lamp for a month now, and it is as advertised. Plenty bright, very adjustable, etc. The lamp wasn't tall enough for my use case (up from behind and over a rather large computer monitor), but a small stool and some books corrected that, and I knew from the measurements going in that I was going to have issues with the height. Two minor negative issues that folks should know about: 1) The instructions are pictures only, and blatantly misleading at times. (It shows the wrong size screw going in the wrong location at times, etc.) Fortunately, assembly is not complicated, and you can generally work out when you're being lied to. :) 2) The biggest issue: The lamp responds to half the remotes in the house. I have a Vizio TV in my office where the lamp is, and a Samsung TV in the living room, and the directional buttons & "OK" button for both remotes turn the lamp on and off -- and the volume up/down for both remotes changes the lamp "color". This is HIGHLY ANNOYING, and the only reason for lowering the rating to a "3" star (the lamp WORKS; they just picked unfortunate frequencies for it to respond to). That's it. I like the lamp. I just hate having to reset it every time I adjust the TV.

reviews.title: Function Over Fashion, and I'm Fine With That
reviews.body: When this lamp arrived, my first thought was that it looked like something borrowed from a dentist's office, an architect's desk, or possibly a low-budget science fiction movie. My wife immediately clamped it onto her pottery worktable and declared it perfect. As it turns out, she was right. The adjustable arms make it easy to position the light exactly where it's needed, and it does an excellent job of filling in the shadows on cloudy days or late afternoons when natural light isn't cooperating. The light is bright, even, and makes it easier to see texture, details, and surface work without constantly repositioning pieces. It's not the most conventional-looking lamp I've ever seen, but after watching it in use for a while, I stopped noticing how it looked and started appreciating how well it worked. In the pottery studio, that's about as high a compliment as a tool can get.

reviews.title: Best light I have found
reviews.body: I have searched for and bought so many different kinds of lights for my sewing machine station. None of them have been satisfactory until this light. There are two important properties I need. Brightness and flexibility. First Brightness: I am 80 and need a lot of light where the needle is stitching. Yes there is a sewing machine light that turns on when the machine is running but even though it gets hot enough to burn skin, it is frustratingly dim. This desk light has 4 color temperature settings from warm to cold controlled by one button and 4 brightness levels controlled by another button so 16 different choices in all. These are regulated by lightly touched buttons on the lowest arm and the highest brightness out shines any other light I have tried. AND there is no flicker like many LEDs. So many lights have claimed amazing brightness only to be completely useless. Flexibility: A sewing machine is a very challenging lighting problem since the needle (where the work is happening) is hidden under the mass of the machine. The light has to be mounted on the right side of the machine so it doesn't block the movement of fabric. The right side of the machine is also solid and won't let any light pass through! Ideally it has to be located between the sewer and the machine so the sewer does not throw a shadow. This desk light offers EXTREME flexibility with 4 joints which all articulate in multiple ways but once the arms are set where I want the angles do not slip. The light might look very awkward in its placement on my table (and please excuse the mess!) but the outermost arm is throwing light exactly where I need it. The fabric can easily move underneath it. The other two arms are lighting up the overall table nicely. It is very well made and the clamp keeps the light steady even with such a long reach. I love this light.

reviews.title: Best Lamp I've Owned
reviews.body: It is without a doubt the best lamp I've had the privilege of buying. It feels, looks, and functions at a premium and high quality. The neck of the lamp is what I'd consider nearly perfectly balanced between flexibility and sturdiness. With the adjustable angles of the light bars themselves, as well as the neck, it will unquestionably meet your positional needs. The touch controls are practically flawless. They work every time they are pressed, as inputted without fail. They are positioned as such you can easily identify and press them at any time without having a clear visual of them. I was extremely satisfied with the quality of light itself. The range of warmth/cool strikes a node of nostalgia and comfort for me that is difficult to explain. They are arranged perfectly, and can satisfy any particular need for a specific light task by task throughout your day. The brightness levels do not fail to complement this standard, there are a satisfactory amount of levels ranging from beautifully ambient dim to possibly light up the room. A more niche comment, my desk has oddly positioned metal framing that goes underneath in a rectangle. It is often difficult for clamp based items to function on my desk because of it, but the size of this clamp was so good it still managed to clamp all the way up and firmly onto the edge of my desk. I saved plenty of space with this lamp. I have literally 0 complaints. I'd buy it again.

reviews.title: Great execution of a novel designed and versatile LED desk lamp
reviews.body: This desktop lamp is BRILLIANT! Most items I see from Amazon ads are gimmicky and often overpriced. Such nonsense does not apply to this versatile LED desk lamp. Was shopping for better lighting than the clip-on ring light I have, which is harsh on my eyes and does not provide illumination for my desk. Saw this lamp popped up in my search for webcam lighting. Checked the reviews and was pleasantly surprised on the positive feedbacks. It's a creative design yet priced as the same cost as simple non-harsh webcam/video streaming lighting. Works really well and has plenty of color shades (5) and brightness levels to suit a variety of light settings. Wide enough to handle my home office setup with a laptop screen plus 34" main screen of an external monitor. Dual tilt function means I can cast enough light on my profile on video conferencing calls and rotate back to original position when I am off calls and typing away on the daily grind. Truly happy with the purchase and rarely am I bothered to write a review, but here I am giving the lamp some high raves.

reviews.title: Exactly what I needed.
reviews.body: Unboxing: Everything was in the box with no missing parts. Instructions were included. Assembly: Not hard to assemble at all. Took about 5 to 10 minutes. The bendable arm is easy to move and holds the lights in place. Even when changing the positioning of the lights themselves it does not change the bendable arms position. Its also nice that when I want to adjust the position of the bendable arm it is not difficult to do so. The lights themselves are sufficiently bright for day or night use. I find it particularly helpful to be able to change the light color along with brightness. Rotating the lights with near 360 degree rotation is also helpful. It works great with a web cam. I can easily tilt them to face me to provide better lighting for web meetings and then tilt them down to be out of my eyes when just working. reviews.title: Do Not Buy, unless you want the light to shine right into your eyeballs!!
reviews.body: If I could give this NO STARS I would. When I got my item and opened it up, as you can see from the picture, it's got a goose neck on it, well, that's not what I got. When I put it together, the part that has the lamp light on it, was backwards, so if you wanted to turn it on, it was on the backside. (Yes, I know it comes with a remote.) Also, it only is straight across, no bending, other than straight up and down, with no curve downward. I wanted a goose neck, so I could have it shine down on my desk, NOT IN MY EYES, which this one would have. If you are going to show that it has a goose neck, the box shows that it has a goose neck, but the instructions and the parts AREN'T goose neck, then don't send it to your customers. Very, very disappointed. This is the second one that I have bought and now have to return for the EXACT SAME ISSUE . . . NO GOOSE NECK! UGH!!!! So frustrating! See photos attached. This is what I got. First photo: is of the box, clearly a goose neck on it. Second photo: is the instructions manual, that shows NO goose neck. Third photo: is after I put it together. You can clearly see, there is NO goose neck to it. Fourth Photo: is showing it as instructed to put it together, but the lights are facing directly at your face and the buttons are on the back, not accessible. Fifth photo: if you turn it around so you can access the buttons, then the lights are in the back. The only way the lights strips work is like the photo is showing or straight up and down. So it will ALWAYS be shining right in your face, not where you need it. Hence why you'd want a GOOSE NECK!)

reviews.title: Versatile light source for home office, workshop, or craft area.
reviews.body: TL;DR: A really great desk lamp and even better customer support. I’m really enjoying this desk lamp. I appreciate that you can adjust the color and brightness of the light and the gooseneck such that you can adjust the position. It clamps right onto the edge of my adjustable stand-sit desk. It’s been the perfect addition to my home office. I also had an exceptional experience with the support team this past week. Oddly, when I turned my lamp on to start the week, the light was not bright and it was kind of flashing a bit. I thought maybe there was something wrong with the USB port it was plugged into, so I tried another. It was on the same multi-plug though. Same problem. I emailed the support email from their seller page with an explanation and a video and within 24 hours I had a response - one that suggested I try another power source but that also stated if the issue persisted they would certainly make it right. So this time I actually moved it to a different multi-plug (a step I should have done myself before the email) and the lamp was working fine. Clearly an issue with my power source. Sheepishly I responded and acknowledged my mistake. Their response? To offer me a partial refund so that I could purchase a new power adapter - something they obviously did not have to do. All this to say - if you’re thinking about buying this lamp, do it. I can assure you that the company stands by their product. And I will always recommend a company that goes above and beyond with their service, which this one absolutely did.

It’s a weird looking contraption that reminds me of the old War of The Worlds movie’s depiction of the aliens😂 but the two settings are another handy feature. Use the adapter plug it comes with. It’s cheap but different adapters can cause it to not turn on. reviews.title: Excellent Clamp Lamp for Monitor Setups — Bright, Adjustable, and Easy on the Eyes
reviews.body: I bought this desk lamp to improve lighting around my dual-monitor workstation, and it’s been a solid upgrade over a traditional desk lamp. The clamp is sturdy and holds securely to the back edge of my desk without wobbling. Installation took less than a minute, and it immediately freed up desk space. The arm has a good range of motion and stays in place once positioned, which makes it easy to direct light exactly where I need it without glare on my screens. Brightness and color temperature adjustments are the standout features. I can switch between warm and cool tones depending on whether I’m working late or just need focused task lighting, and the brightness levels are more than sufficient without being harsh. It’s noticeably easier on my eyes during long screen sessions compared to overhead lighting. Build quality feels better than expected for the price. The controls are responsive, and the lamp looks clean and modern once mounted. I also appreciate that it distributes light evenly instead of creating a harsh hotspot and doesn’t get hot to the touch either. If I had to nitpick, the power cord could be slightly longer for larger desk layouts—but that’s a minor issue and didn’t affect functionality for me. Overall, this is a great choice for anyone working from home, gaming, or needing focused desk lighting without clutter. I’d confidently recommend it, especially for monitor-heavy setups.

reviews.title: Sleek, modern, and ultra flexible desk lamp with integrated clock and calendar screen.
reviews.body: Overall this lamp is exactly as described. The light's color temperature is selectable from yellowish to bright whitish blue on the opposite end of the scale. The light can also be dimmed from just-barely-on to full brightness. The housing is very attractive and flexible in the way that it can tilt to cover the area you need illuminated. I have only two small complaints and neither makes this less than a great lamp. The first complaint is that, in a world of super accurate clocks around us, this integrated clock in the vertical "beam" runs slightly faster than it should requiring a minimal adjustment occasionally. The other very minor complaint is that when tilting the lamp in any direction, the upright "beam" which houses the clock and calendar screen become more difficult to see. It's not that the information cannot be read, it's just that no other similar piece of clock/calendar technology pieces in your home or office are viewed at an angle relative to the surface on which is sits. It's a minor annoyance that does not lessen the usefulness and attractiveness of this desk lamp. If you use the lamp in its most upright stance, the viewing angle issue will be irrelevant.

reviews.title: Eine der guten Tischlampen
reviews.body: Design und Funktionalität Diese LED-Schreibtischlampe bietet ein schlankes, minimalistisches Design, das gut in moderne Büroumgebungen passt. Die Verarbeitung ist solide und das Lampengehäuse fühlt sich robust an. Ein kleiner Kritikpunkt könnte die Wahl des Kunststoffs sein, da hier eventuell hochwertigere Materialien eine noch bessere Anmutung bieten könnten. Besonders praktisch ist die Kombination aus Beleuchtung und Ladefunktion. Das integrierte kabellose Ladepad sowie der USB-Ladeanschluss sind ideal, um verschiedene Geräte gleichzeitig aufzuladen und den Schreibtisch übersichtlich zu halten. Der integrierte Wecker mag für manche überflüssig sein, ich finde ihn jedoch nützlich, um beim Zocken die Zeit im Auge zu behalten. Der Timer, der die Lampe nach einer halben Stunde automatisch ausschaltet, ist eine nützliche Funktion. Noch besser wäre es, wenn man die Zeitdauer einstellen könnte. Beleuchtungsqualität Die Lampe bietet viele Einstellungsmöglichkeiten, sowohl für die Lichtfarbe als auch für die Helligkeit, wobei die Helligkeit stufenweise und nicht stufenlos einstellbar ist, entgegen einiger Produktbeschreibungen. Die Beleuchtung des Uhrdisplays kann nach Bedarf ein- oder ausgeschaltet werden – hierzu einfach die M-Taste längere Zeit gedrückt halten. Die Nachtlampenfunktion ist am Schreibtisch für mich weniger relevant, könnte aber in anderen Szenarien sehr praktisch sein. Leistung des kabellosen Ladegeräts Das kabellose Ladepad funktioniert mit allen Qi-kompatiblen Geräten und lädt diese zuverlässig auf. Die Ladeleistung ist angemessen, erreicht allerdings nicht die Schnellladegeschwindigkeiten spezialisierter Schnellladegeräte. Der USB-Port bietet zusätzliche Flexibilität für Geräte, die nicht kabellos geladen werden können oder einen separaten Ladeanschluss benötigen. Fazit Insgesamt bin ich mit der Lampe sehr zufrieden.

reviews.title: A small powerhouse
reviews.body: Great so far. Very easy to use and very effective for a moderately sized row house. Within 15 minutes on the highest setting I could feel the difference in the air quality. I put it in different rooms daily. It's light enough to carry from room to room. I keep it on a low setting at night. It's quiet and a powerhouse. I'm really happy with my purchase.

reviews.title: Game changer.
reviews.body: I only just got this yesterday and used it last night for the first time but I feel compelled to write a quick review already. This thing is a game. changer. Ever since moving to Texas, I suffer from terrible seasonal allergies. I never have in my life until now (turns out I'm allergic to a handful of trees that are native around here. Fun.) Some years are worse than others but this year is baaad. For the past few weeks my mornings have had me waking up congested and unable to breathe, blowing wads of snot out of my nose (sorry!), and with a itchy/scratchy sore throat. First thing I do is take an allergy pill and wait in misery until it finally seems to kick in around mid morning. (I've had a terrible time finding meds that work too. It just sucks.) I don't know why I never thought to get an air purifier. I guess when I thought of air purifiers I'd always think of the fancy Dyson ones that cost hundreds of dollars. I mean, puh-lease. Not happening. Then I found this little guy. Had great reviews, was the perfect little size for our master bedroom (216sqft), and reasonably priced with reasonably priced replacement filters. In a plee of desperation I talked my husband into us trying it. It got in yesterday (quicker than expected, yay!). I immediately unboxed it upon getting home from work and plugged it in. It says you only need to run it for about 15-20 minutes on high to cycle the room but I set that little baby on high with a two hour timer and let it run. When it was time for bed, I set the 6 hour timer on sleep mode. The sleep mode is great. It's a lot more quiet than I expected. I still expected to be able to hear a little white noise from it (which doesn't bother me at all) but unless I lift my head off the pillow and really listen, I can only just baaarely hear it. And I have it on my side of the bed about 3 feet away. Our home air system is louder than it on sleep mode. If you enjoy white noise, you could probably just run it on low and be fine. It has a button to turn off the indicator lights at night too so you don't have bright lights keeping you awake if that's a problem for you. Anyway, I woke up this morning with NO allergy symptoms. None. No congestion, absolutely clear nasal passages, and NO sore throat at all! I'm blown away. I'll try to come back and revise this review if my opinion changes but after the first night and the relief I was FINALLY able to feel from my allergies this morning I absolutely rate this thing 5 stars. Worth every penny!

reviews.title: Great Little Machine!
reviews.body: This small, quiet and efficient air purifier is ideal for our needs. It fits neatly into any room, is unobtrusive, and is simple to operate and maintain. The build quality and overall aesthetics is top notch. The cost of replacement filters is reasonable and can be done in less than a minute... about every six to eight months. We noticed that the unit quickly removed any smoke and cooking odors from the area while running. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: So far so good
reviews.body: Bought one for my mom and one for my sister in law. Good thing I bought it for my sister in law because a couple months later the devastating wildfire in the Palisades of Los Angeles happened. So the entire LA county was full of smoke. Hopefully it helped but I'm not entirely sure how well it cleans the air because the amount of air that gets pushed out the top is not as forceful as my own air filters at home. My decades old Hunter air purifier has a ton more air flow it's almost like a high power fan. But I think it is able to move so much air because it doesn't have a pre-filter like all the new air purifiers use. It just uses replaceable HEPA filters and I know it works because I see all the dust it catches in the filter before I have to replace it. As for the Levoit it has a pre-filter which catches most of the dust and dirt but you never know how much actually gets through to the actual HEPA filter. I recommend the Levoit for smaller bedrooms, it's too small to do anything in a large room. At least it's fairly quiet on the lowest and middle setting.

reviews.title: Pet Odor and old house odor, bye bye!
reviews.body: Edit to original review: it’s been several months at this point and I have two in our small farmhouse. They work amazing, best purchase we’ve made. So far: it’s perfect, surpassed all expectations, ALL. Backstory: we’re living in a house from the late 1800s, that has been dormant for about ten years until we moved in a couple years ago. We have five pets, four cats which are strictly indoor and use an automatic litter box (Popur S7 which does great for the smell, it can only do so much though) and one fat, lazy, stinky pitbull. The house is musky, it’s old, it had way too much mold in the detached basement when we moved in. And the pets? They stink bad too, this is coming from someone who is very particular about the house smelling good. The litter box is horrible, the dog is gross, the house is old. I went searching for an air purifier, I’ve been wanting the SHARK never change, but couldn’t break down and buy it for $300. Didn’t try it out, can’t say if it’s good or not. While I was looking at reviews, I found the shark had only 5,000 reviews on Amazon, and it was at 4.3 stars. Okay, that’s not too bad. But this Levoit one had over 100,000 reviews and 4.8 stars. That’s nuts in comparison. I done a lot of looking on Reddit and found that the shark wasn’t even mentioned in the majority of good quality reviews, so I disregarded it. This specific one happened to be in budget and also has amazing reviews. We received it last night and set it up this morning, yep this morning, in our cat’s litter box room which is also unfortunately our closet. That room is the worst room of the house in my opinion. It’s been running for about 6 hours and I already notice a huge impact. It’s easier to breath, the air doesn’t feel so heavy, and the litter box is nonexistent, even right after they use it. Hubby sprayed cologne on himself and not 20 seconds later I walked in and it was gone, already sucked away. I put a box fan on it to help circulation and have it on 3. I’m buying another. Maybe two more. If I remember I’ll come back and review again when it gets a little later in the month. We’re leaving for vacation next Monday, so I’m curious how it will hold up against the cats stagnant litter box, which usually stinks pretty bad when we get home after a week. TLDR; Amazing for pet odor, amazing for muskiness. Perfect and worth every penny.

reviews.title: Use daily in our home!
reviews.body: We have 2 in our house and looking to purchase a 3rd. Love these things! Ours run all the time and after a couple of years are still going strong! I've recommended them to quite a few people. I can't attest to any personal allergy relief since my immediate family doesn't really suffer from much (maybe due to the purifiers) but I do feel a peace of mind having them in our home, especially with pets! Does a great job to trap dust and debris. I am always very surprised to find how much these things pick up when I check/change the filter. I also appreciate the white noise that it gives off. We do run ours on the 3 setting most days and it provides a nice background noise, which is a personal preference for my family. There are 2 other lower settings which are much much quieter. The purifier is easy to use and easy to maintain (filters can be a pricey). I will actually clean the filter a few times before purchasing new and have found that works great for us and saves an extra buck. We have two white ones and find that they look nice and blend in well with the rooms they are placed in. One of the purifiers is in a space between the living room and kitchen area (most traffic and use) and the other is near our home office and entry. I feel that they do a good job for the space size. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.title: A lifesaver in wildfire season.
reviews.body: Impressive. It is whisper quiet, and extremely effective. I’ve been sick all week from the wildfire smoke in the Denver area. I happened to be talking to a friend on the phone when I received my LEVOIT air purifier. I set it up while we chatted and within half an hour I could tell that the air quality had improved. I was breathing easier and my friend said she could hear it in my voice - it wasn’t as rough and nasally. It says it is for a room up to 222 square feet, but it is portable (under 10 lbs), about the size of a wastebasket, it plugs in to a regular outlet, and I can physically only be in one room at a time. It cleared the air so quickly that I can probably manage with just the one for the rest of the wildfire season. But it was very cost-effective, under $100, so I may go ahead and get another one for the kitchen next week. (I am a senior on a fixed income, but this is a necessity if I want to be able to breathe in my own house when the air quality outside is so bad.)

reviews.title: Levoit Air Purifier Home Allergies, Asthma
reviews.body: I love the Levoit Air Purifier! It is very quiet all of the time, but if you use the night time sleep mode, you can just barely hear it at all. I only use GENUINE LEVOIT filters and they're a bit more costly, but I prefer to use the real deal and have less problems/headaches. It can be a bit catchy to find them on Amazon and the generic ones keep popping up; however, I went straight to the Levoit store to get the genuine ones. Blessed to be able to somewhat better control my Asthma and all-season Allergies with the help of these two awesome products! Thank you, Amazon and Levoit! reviews.title: Fingers crossed this helps my allergic dog!
reviews.body: I got this air purifier for my bedroom. My dog has a very severe dust mite allergy. He was literally disintegrating. His hair was falling out and his dandruff was like a blizzard. He had full body yeast and it smelled like a dirty gym sock on steroids. Despite having no carpet, rugs and bedding that are washed weekly, and dust mite covers on both of our beds, he was still miserable. He is so allergic that out of desperation I'm trying everything I possibly can to minimize his exposure while his immunotherapy does its job. The vet said that short of having hospital level air purification I would never get rid of all the dust mites, but I can limit his exposure with air purifiers, so we are giving it a try. There's no way I can accurately gauge how much this air purifier is reducing the dust mites, but it has to be better than it was before I got it. My dog gets 3 medicated baths a week and is about to start immunotherapy, so I can't really credit any progress to the air purifier alone, but there is no doubt it will help reduce the total number of dust mites he is exposed to. I also got a larger air purifier for my living room/kitchen. I live in a camper currently as I recently moved and am building a home. Since we live in cramped quarters with less ventilation than a sticks and bricks home, the dust mites and other allergens are far more concentrated. I've noticed since having these two purifiers running that our home smells fresher and cleaner, any smells do not linger. I've tried my hardest to deep clean any dust collected around the house in all the little nooks and crannies that you can't see and hopefully the purifiers will help keep that to a minimum. For some reason even in the dead of winter we seem to have a lot of dust. Again, probably because the space is so small. It seems the smaller the space, the bigger the mess! Thankfully it doesn't take as long to clean a smaller space. I'm not sure if I'll ever really know how effective these are, but I can say I've noticed a big difference since I got them in the quality of the air. We have wood heat so there's not a furnace constantly blowing air around. They provide air flow in what used to be pretty stagnant areas in the winter when the a/c isn't running. The stinky sock yeasty dog smell has been reduced quite a bit, and any other lingering smells like cooking or flatulence from my gassy teenager don't tend to hang around as long lol. So they have been a win-win! They seem to work very well. I don't use the timer features because I let them both run 24/7, but it's nice to have that as an option if it's ever needed. I really appreciate the small footprint of this purifier because there's not much room in a camper. I have it on my bedside table. You can see in the picture about how big it is next to my 40oz swig. Even on high it's very quiet, but I'm one of those "can't sleep without a fan" people so I enjoy the sound lol. Between this and the fan at the foot of my bed pushing air towards it, our air in the bedroom ought to be squeaky clean!

reviews.title: Awesome air purifier
reviews.body: Excellent Compact Air Purifier for Small Spaces 5.0 out of 5 stars Compact, Efficient, and Quiet – A Game-Changer for Allergy Sufferers I’ve been using the Levoit Core 300 Air Purifier for about two months now in my 200 sq. ft. bedroom, and it’s exceeded my expectations in every way. As someone who deals with seasonal allergies and pet dander from my cat, I was looking for an affordable, reliable solution to improve indoor air quality without breaking the bank or taking up too much space. After researching options, I settled on this model, and I’m thrilled with the results. The setup was incredibly straightforward – just unbox, remove the plastic from the filter, plug it in, and you’re good to go. The design is sleek and modern, with a cylindrical shape that fits neatly on a nightstand or floor corner without dominating the room. At around 8.7 inches in diameter and 14.2 inches tall, it’s compact enough for apartments or offices, yet powerful for its size. Key features include a 3-stage filtration system: a pre-filter for larger particles like dust and hair, a True HEPA filter that captures 99.97% of airborne particles as small as 0.3 microns (think pollen, mold spores, and fine dust), and an activated carbon filter to tackle odors, smoke, and VOCs. It has three fan speeds plus a sleep mode that dims the lights and runs ultra-quietly at just 24dB – quieter than a whisper, making it perfect for nighttime use. There’s also a timer (2/4/6/8 hours) and a display lock to prevent accidental changes. In terms of performance, this little unit punches above its weight. It refreshes the air in a 219 sq. ft. room up to 5 times per hour on high speed, according to the specs. I tested it during a smoky day from nearby wildfires, and within an hour, the air felt noticeably fresher – no lingering smells or stuffiness. My allergy symptoms have reduced significantly; I wake up with clearer sinuses and less sneezing. It’s also energy-efficient, using only about 45W at max, which keeps my electricity bill in check. Pros: • Affordable and great value: At under $100, it outperforms many pricier models in small to medium rooms. 3 • Quiet operation: Sleep mode is a lifesaver for light sleepers. 1 • Effective filtration: Handles pet dander, dust, and odors exceptionally well. 2 • Easy maintenance: Filter replacement is simple, and indicators remind you when it’s time (every 6-8 months). Cons: • No built-in air quality sensor or auto mode – you have to manually adjust speeds (though the upgraded Core 300S adds smart features if you need them). 5 • On the highest speed, it can get a bit noisy (around 50dB), but it’s still tolerable for short bursts. 3 • Best for rooms under 300 sq. ft.; for larger spaces, you’d need multiple units or a bigger model. Overall, the Levoit Core 300 is a fantastic entry-level air purifier that’s reliable, user-friendly, and effective for everyday use. If you’re dealing with allergies, pets, or just want cleaner air in a small space, I highly recommend it. It’s ETL, CARB, and Energy Star certified, so you know it’s safe and efficient. Worth every penny!

reviews.title: Piccolo e silenzioso
reviews.body: È piccolo, perciò non ci si può aspettare miracoli, ma se vengono rispettate le indicazioni del produttore utilizzandolo in stanze delle adeguate dimensioni, lavora benissimo, e purifica l'aria correttamente. Tutto sembra essere costruito con ottima qualità: plastiche, incastri, motore ventola ecc... Perfino il filtro sembra essere ben costruito e di qualità superiore rispetto ad altri della stessa fascia di prezzo. Ha una regolazione di 3 velocità delle quali solo la massima è rumorosa ma non molto fastidiosa, infatti la velocità intermedia è appena udibile (pari ad un soffio) e mai fastidiosa anche stando nelle vicinanze. Alla prima velocità è praticamente impossibile udire qualcosa e questo è un pregio ENORME rispetto ad altri purificatori in commercio della stessa categoria. Questa velocità si presta benissimo per il riposo notturno. Nessun ronzio o rumore. Questo, forse, credo sia possibile anche grazie al motore/ventola in corrente continua, infatti il purificatore viene fornito di un piccolo alimentatore che si trova nella confezione. In essa vengono forniti anche 3 "feltri" per la diffusione delle essenze naturali da inserire in un apposito cassetto laterale quasi invisibile. Nel complesso quindi un ottimo purificatore poco ingombrante, con un buon rapporto qualità prezzo e soprattutto poco rumoroso e che vale la pena acquistare.

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.body: I previously owned one purifier, an AIRROMI purifier. I kept it near the litter box because phew my cats can be stinky. Unfortunately, one of my cats recently started showing symptoms of asthma. And hearing those attacks he has is honestly extremely scary, knowing I cannot offer him direct relief. So I made the decision to get a second purifier, a bigger one this time. But not just one, I got THREE! Maybe a little over kill but I want to ensure my cat is OKAY! I have had them for about a month and there has been ZERO asthma attacks from my cat. So it is fair to say that all the bad allergens in the air have been going straight to the filter. My boyfriend works in HVAC and he said the HEPA filter combined with the activated charcoal works great for catching particles and allergens. I have yet to open it up to see the damage; the purifier has an alert that will show up on the control panel, letting you know when it is time to change the filter. I will come back and update with pictures once I change the filter on at least one of the purifiers. There is about 3 modes on the purifier, Automatic, Speed 1, 2, 3 and Pet mode. Automatic is hardly detectable in terms of noise. Pet mode and the highest mode are very loud though. I don’t mind the white noise, so I could sleep with it no problem, others might have a problem. As for looks, I think she is really pretty! I absolutely love the reader on the front that determines the air quality, all of ours sit at a range of either 5-7. I very interestingly found that my purifier in my room almost hit 400 after a hot shower, and it did not go down, the numbers fluctuated between 150-350. I unplugged it and then it read 005 again…not sure what that was about, but it only happened once, so I did not think much of it.

reviews.title: Perfect for elderly parent with pets
reviews.body: I bought this for my mom. My siblings don’t visit her because they claimed pet hair/dander was severely triggering their allergies. I thought they were making it up because I personally never had any kind of reaction. Well, I recently I went to visit Mom for a few hours as I normally do, and the trifecta of dust, dander, and pet hair hit me like a ton of bricks. For 3 days, I was having coughing fits, wheezing, and my eyes were itchy and felt like there was dust in them 24/7. My mom already has COPD and frequently complains about being short of breath, so realizing that she was casually breathing all of this in 24/7 completely freaked me OUT. That said, I went on the search for an air purifier and ended up pulling the trigger on this one and can finally report on well it works. Even though at first my mom wasn’t happy that I spent money and bought this for her, after I set it up, she allowed me to leave it running on high if it meant there could be a chance that it might make her air quality suitable for my siblings start visiting again. Well, 6 weeks later, I was able to convince my siblings to come with me to mom’s house to visit for Christmas because now there she has a good air purifier. Upon entering my mom’s house with my family, the first thing I noticed immediately was how much lighter the air way. Before this filter, the air was thick, heavy, and DUSTY. Afternoon light filtering through the blinds would reveal clouds of pet hair and dust particles swirling around like smoke. Now? Nothing! No dust in the air when sunshine is coming though the windows. The second thing I noticed was that the smell of litterbox went from 100% to 40-50%. My family had a wonderful, comfortable holiday visit with my Mom, they were shocked how much of a difference this machine made. No one had any of their allergies triggered. YAY!! My mom, who originally wanted to hate this machine, finally confessed that she’s breathing a lot better lately & believes that it’s due to this machine improving her air. She leaves it running on auto now, when she cooks, it kicks into high gear until the numbers go down. She loves it a lot. Highly recommend this machine.
