reviews.body: I've been using the Levoit 200S-P in a bedroom, and it's been a great balance of performance, noise level, and convenience. Setup took just a few minutes, and pairing it with the VeSync app was straightforward. I like being able to check the air quality, adjust the fan speed, create schedules, and turn it on before I get home. Auto mode works well and usually keeps the fan quiet unless it detects a noticeable change in air quality. It's nice when I'm cooking and the lights will blink red indicating the air quality has changed and it will kick on high speed. For everyday use, it's very quiet on the lower settings, making it easy to sleep with. On the highest speed it moves a lot more air, but as expected it's much louder. I typically leave it in Auto mode and rarely have to adjust it. The filter has done a good job reducing dust and everyday odors in the room. While no air purifier can eliminate every smell instantly, I've noticed the room feels fresher, and there's less dust settling on furniture over time. It's also very easy to clean. A few things to keep in mind: replacement filters aren't the cheapest, and this unit is best suited for bedrooms or other smaller spaces. If you're trying to clean the air in a large open living area, you'll probably want to step up to a larger model like the Core 400S or 600S. Overall, if you're looking for a reliable, easy-to-use smart air purifier for a bedroom or office, I'd recommend the Levoit 200S-P. It's quiet, simple to maintain, and has performed exactly as I hoped.

reviews.title: Fresher Air
reviews.body: I bought this for my living room and kitchen with an open concept of around 540 sq. Ft. It took about 4 hours for the light to change from red to blue. I can't really tell a difference because I'm home all the time, however my guests say it smells fresher. I have 2 cats and a dog and their hair and dander is a nightmare! I've already cleaned off the front and the screen twice in two weeks, so that shows it working, but I still have some dust and hair floating around just not quite as bad, however I did shave my long thick hair coated dog and that helped alot! From the reviews I expected more out of this, my allergies haven't changed I'm still congested and use meds for that, but I also have various food allergies. I put this unit in a high traffic area and center of living room and kitchen. I've noticed my TV doesn't have near as much dust and hair accumulation on the screen. For the price it's okay, it doesn't compare to the real expensive ones perhaps, but it does help.

reviews.title: Efficient - Easy to Operate - Attractive - Quiet
reviews.body: This is a very attractive and easy unit to use. The filter is easily replaced, and the sleep mode is fantastic! It is quiet at any speed but barely noticeable on Level 2. WE can feel the difference in the freshness of the air in the home. Less sneezing and coughing! :)

reviews.title: Great purifier for bad AQI and allergies.
reviews.body: This is a sleek shaped purifier that fits well in our hallway. We are using it on our top floor to help with the smokey weather we are experiencing outside that’s seeping inwards. In the first couple of days it has already helped with the air quality and reduce our allergies and also seems to be reducing the dander from our cat. It’s very quiet. I have to check that it’s on because it doesn’t sound like anything on the low setting.

reviews.title: No es True HEPA certificado, sensor de pésima calidad, publicidad engañosa
reviews.body: Pros: - Disminuye un poco el polvo en la habitación Contras: - No sirve para los 1875 pies cuadrados (174m2) que indica en su publicidad. En efectos prácticos sólo sirve para 388 pies cuadrados (36m2) como lo indica en la última foto la publicación. Se requieren más de cuatro cambios de aire por hora para que un filtro de aire sea efectivo y esa cantidad sólo la alcanza en un cuarto de 36m2 y a MÁXIMA VELOCIDAD (punto importante). - Sólo es grado HEPA a MÍNIMA VELOCIDAD. Lo pueden consultar en la página oficial del producto. No es un filtro HEPA certificado. Incluso quitaron la leyenda de filtro HEPA del propio filtro, como se observa en la imagen. Los obligaron a remover algo que, básicamente, era falsa publicidad. - A MÁXIMA VELOCIDAD además de no ser HEPA fácilmente alcanza 60db de ruido, más menos, como se escucha en el video. Es extremadamente silencioso en primera velocidad para dormir, pero en tercera y cuarta no es para que estés dentro del mismo cuarto. - El sensor siempre esta en azul, calidad de aire "óptima". Aún encerrándolo en un cuarto donde hay moho es incapaz de detectar dichas partículas. Sólo se pone en rojo cuando barres el cuarto dónde se encuentra el filtro, sólo detecta partículas verdaderamente grandes. Ni al cocinar frente a él baja la "calidad del aire", aún si se te está quemando la comida. Así que el modo automático básicamente no sirve de mucho. Esto contando que el sensor se limpió y calibró como se indica en las instrucciones. Casi casi tienes que encender y apagar un cerillo frente al sensor para que detecte el humo y la luz pase de azul a roja. - Trae muy poco carbón, si tu problema es olores, te vas a consumir este filtro en semanas o pocos meses, no en 1 año. - Plástico barato de muy mala calidad. El panel se rayó a la primera pasada de una tela de microfibra. En las fotos se ven detalles de lo barato que se ven todos los materiales

reviews.title: Entrega rápida
reviews.body: Chegou antes do prazo, 5 dias antes. Veio bem embalado, com manual em inglês. Muito silencioso, até a velocidade 2 não ouve absolutamente nada, do 3 acima, som muito confortável. Controle e modo pet pelo aplicativo. O resultado e benefício, o tempo o dirá.

reviews.title: Reduces Allergy Symptoms, Quiet, & Convenient
reviews.body: I was waking up in the middle of my sleep because of my terrible allergy symptoms for the past few weeks (lots of sneezing, runny nose, watery eyes, itchy eyes/throat/ears) so I decided to get this for my bedroom. It has been a game changer! I started sneezing/watering/itching a LOT LESS since turning this on, and the air just feels a lot fresher now! I love it! The UX is great too! It's so convenient to be able to use your phone to control fan speed (you can choose 1 of 4 levels or do any % of max fan speed you want under the DIY mode), turn the interface lights on and off (great for keeping it dark at night to sleep), turn the purifier itself on/off, and keep track of what the air quality is like (there aren't numbers afaik but it gives you 4 levels of either very good, good, moderate, or bad and these show up as different colours of light on the ring around the power button of the machine as well), check how much filter life is left as a % (so far it seems to go down 1% per 3 days, which I guess should last about 300 days). As for noise, it is super quiet on levels 1 & 2. I can't even hear it from across the room! Levels 3 & 4 are definitely audible across the room, but not terribly bothersome. I sometimes like the white noise. I'd recommend it! (So far at least; I've only had this for 3 days so I'll update if anything happens) Edit: Just had the forest fire smoke drape our city with opaque yellowish-brown skies. The air purifier helped some during the day, but now the smell is seeping into my apartment. It’s a bit better in my bedroom where the air purifier is, but I can definitely smell that burning smell now. I will also note that the sensor says the air quality is “Very Good” though the graph has dipped a little. From what I remember reading, there are 2 types of air quality sensors (IR and laser) and the one this unit has is not as accurate. We had some of the worst air quality in the world for parts of the day and it’s saying it’s “Very Good” which is a huge stretch… All this to say, don’t trust what it says about the air quality.

reviews.title: Purificador de aire
reviews.body: Llego en fecha pactada, a un excelente precio, cumple con todas las funciones comentadas, tenía una alergia al pl aceerin ya que se encontraban trabajando con madera, despacio la alergia en un día, definitivamente lo volvería a comprar

title: MOOKA Air Purifier for Home Bedroom Large Room 2200 Ft², HEPA Filter, White

reviews.title: Amazing and buying another!
reviews.body: Okay not gonna lie I was a skeptic. When I turned it on the first time the number it showed was an 8. Which is almost close to perfect air quality. I’ve been running it every single day and it seems to work fine but I wasn’t sure how good it actually cleans the air. Well I just cooked and an olive oil smell was in my kitchen and it had created smoke. I looked at the air purifier and it was working hard and the number was up to 132!!!! I now have it running at three speed and it’s cleaning our air so fast! I’m a believer in the Mooka air purifier and will be buying a second one for my upstairs!! Love this thing and highly recommend!!! It’s also super quiet and easy to change and clean filters. 10/10

reviews.title: Helped with allergies a lot!
reviews.body: I bought this for our home and honestly noticed a difference faster than I expected. The air feels fresher and cleaner, especially in the bedroom. It’s surprisingly quiet, even at night, and doesn’t disturb sleep. I also like that it covers a larger area, so I don’t feel like I need multiple units running. Setup was simple and it’s been easy to use. Definitely happy with this purchase and would recommend it to anyone wanting to improve the air quality in their home.

reviews.title: Makes a noticeable difference!
reviews.body: When my elderly cat (18 this summer! Cat tax included in review) was diagnosed with asthma, it meant that all three of us who live in my apartment (my husband and I plus cat) all have some sort of allergy or respiratory issues from different things. I've always had allergies to things like dust and pollen, and my husband had recently developed a cough and post nasal drip that the doctor could find no particular cause of. I happened to be browsing on Prime Day after looking into air purifiers and got this one for a very affordable 60 bucks. The reviews said it worked great just out of the package and setup was easy, and they were right. No assembly, nothing to fuss with. Just remove the plastic from the filter, pop it back in and plug it in. The difference was noticeable very quickly. Husband has basically stopped coughing and his post nasal drip has reduced significantly. I also noticed he isn't snoring anywhere near as loudly as he was before. My own allergy symptoms have alleviated; my sinuses used to feel stuffy which made it harder to fall asleep, but that's basically solved. My own post nasal drip has also noticeably improved. Even my cat's asthma noises have improved. I'm sort of shocked to encounter a product that actually noticeably solves a problem. Shortly after buying it, I had a small fire in my oven. Everything was okay, but the smoke was obviously a problem. I decided to put the air purifier on the counter to see what the number went up to- 130! But about an hour later, the number on the panel read about 10 or 12, and the normal range for my apartment is between 5-17. It has a sleep setting, but we keep it on 1 during the night because it's so quiet. I like to keep it on 2 during the day because it's still just light background humming. One thing I thought was nice is that there's a QR code on the side of it to link you to the correct filters to buy when you need to replace them. However, out of all the things that could actually use an app, it doesn't have one. It could be nice to have a really simple one that records the PM number so you could have an idea of the air quality patterns in your home. At the same time, it's refreshing that it doesn't have one lol My apartment is 1,300 square feet so technically this little guy should be making some difference on the whole thing, but it might be better to have it in a more central location for that; I like it in the bedroom though, since it's made such a difference in our symptoms that were impacting our sleep, and my cat mostly stays in the bedroom so it just makes sense for us. 10/10, really happy with it!

reviews.title: It’s decent
reviews.body: I think it’s working well but I wouldn’t say optimal. Not too loud so that’s a plus. Easy to use. The lock button is a plus. I don’t smell the neighbors cigarettes anymore but I do still smell the pets. My old one used to eliminate both so that sucks.

reviews.title: Mooka Air Purifier Helps
reviews.body: The Mooka Air Purifier is just as advertised. The smoke is heavy where I live this late summer. I breathe normally. No smell. Quiet. The Automatic setting works like it is explained in the directions.

reviews.title: Nice price for a quiet and efficient air purifier!
reviews.body: I like it! I have an older air purifier and this one is quieter and smaller. It covers a large room area and I can tell the air feels cleaner. I like how it gives you a number of how clean the air is at any given time.

reviews.title: Quiet, affordable and gets the job done!
reviews.body: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Actually Gets Rid of Smoke Odor I bought this because my boyfriend smokes THC, and somehow the smell was making its way out of our bedroom and into my son’s clothes. He’s young and goes to school, so having him show up smelling like smoke was obviously a HUGE problem. This air purifier has made a noticeable difference. My boyfriend smokes in our bedroom with the door closed and the window open, and we leave the purifier running all the time. As soon as he starts smoking, you can actually hear it kick into a higher gear like it knows it has work to do. 😂 Most importantly, my son’s clothes no longer smell like smoke. That alone makes this worth it for me. We also have several dogs, and I’ve noticed the house just smells fresher overall. If you’re dealing with smoke, pets, or both, this thing WORKS. Very happy with it.

reviews.title: Sound not an issue
reviews.body: I've had this for about a month, so far works great. I smoke Cigars in my apartment and it is working good. Clears the smoke great even with the filter it came within is a bit loud on the 2nd and third setting, but it is not distracting. I leave it on the first setting over night and its quiet. Next morning there is no cigar smell. Of course I empty ash try. When I come home from work my place smells great and I hardly see see any dust on my glass TV stand and tables. I've read some bad reviews on the sound, but its something you don't hear when tv or radio is on. It really sounds like having a fan on. I would recommend this for the price. I've had other air purifiers no difference on sound.

reviews.title: Good for bedroom use.
reviews.body: Small but quite efficient. Sleep mode is almost inaudible, but still produces a steady stream of filtered air. The controls are easy to use, the instructions are easy to follow. It's a neat looking machine, and good value.

reviews.title: Registers air quality and adjusts fan accordingly
reviews.body: This machine automatically senses changes in air quality and adjusts the fan accordingly. Tried it in various rooms where our air quality varied between 8 and 20 and the fan stayed on low, however it turned to full and the red light came on when the wok started to smoke! (I can’t recall what number it registered this to be as I was impressed at the light and fan speed!) Not tried this overnight on sleep mode as the air quality has been good, though the low fan speed isn’t obtrusive so can’t imagine it disturbing sleep. I can imagine this will be great for the damp weather, new furniture smell removal cleaning and dusting days and also spring pollens. The carbon filter pieces had space between them so I googled if that was normal and apparently it is, as small molecules bounce around before getting trapped. I have bought the same model again for a family member with allergies and asthma, after buying two smaller models and finding fault with both.

reviews.body: Its a great air purifier but I give it 4 stars as the scent section does not work when putting aromatherapy oils inside as no smell comes out

title: Levoit Air Purifier for Home Pets Bedroom Dorm Room, Smart & Voice Control

reviews.title: Best Purchase All Year
reviews.body: I simply cannot say ENOUGH good things about this product! After 2 weeks of use the air feels lighter, I no longer wake up with a stuffy nose or junk in my lungs and I bought the pet specific air filters that are an added bonus. I LOVE the lighting features and that you can sync the device to my phone and set up schedules so it's quiet at night. The controls are SUPER easy to use and fool proof. Just don't forget to open the base when you get it and take the plastic packaging off around the air filter!!! I forgot to do this and wondered why there was no air flow coming out of the top till I Googled it. 😂😂😂

reviews.title: Affordable and effective for dust and allergens
reviews.body: We moved into an incredibly dusty townhouse, I have terrible allergies, and we discovered our neighbors are chain smokers. We now have 3 Levoit air purifiers in our home: Vital 100 (non-smart version), Core Mini and Vital 200S. I initially bought the Vital 100 and put it in our bedroom because I have terrible allergies. It collected a ton of dust and helped a lot with the allergies. I thought I didn't need the smart version but in hindsight the availability of specialty filters and the remote control would be very helpful. It's relatively quiet although on high it's too noisy for me to sleep with. I absolutely love that you can turn the all the control lights off. We tried using this for the cigarette smell but it wasn't very effective except when the smell was very light. It did completely abolish cooking smells though. If I could go back in time I would have ordered the 100S instead but this one works fine. The smoke smell from the neighbors comes into our house through the laundry room which is a very small room. I bought the Core Mini to try to combat it. The Core Mini doesn't really do much to get rid of smells and was definitely overwhelmed by the smoke so now we move it around the house now when the pollen level is high. It works ok for dust and allergens but the range isn't great; you need to be right next to it to notice a difference. On low and medium speed it's barely audible and high is relatively quiet but overall the fan isn't very powerful. The lights on this one automatically turn off after a few seconds making it bedroom friendly. If I could do it again, I would have skipped this one and bought one of the larger ones sooner. Lastly, in an attempt to mitigate the smoke coming from next door, we got the big boi Vital 200S with the add on smoke specialty filter. So far it isn't able to remove the smell while they're smoking but it does cut down the severity and will clear it eventually provided the source stops for long enough. It's amazingly quiet on the lower speeds. It's pretty loud on the higher speeds but the fan moves a ton of air around. I'm disappointed that the auto mode doesn't detect the smoke smell but I can use the app to turn it to high speed as soon as I smell it. You don't have to use the app but it's really easy to set up and connect. The app allows you to set schedules which is really handy and as I touched on earlier, it works as a remote control. As with the others, you're able to turn the lights off completely so it's good for bedrooms. We've only had this running a few days but I'm pretty impressed with what it can do.

reviews.title: great replacement for my bedroom
reviews.body: I use this in a room I use to have an Ionic air purifier, the old worked there was some dust near the unit, but the smell of Ozone was too much since i kept my door closed most of the day. the Levoit was a perfect replacement, no smell, lot less noise and my room felt refreshed when i open the door. I have the 330 model for over 2 years in the Livingroom and i happy with that one as well. the only down i don't like is the 300 can sense the air and adjust where the 200 can't, but you can program to go on or off multi times throughout the day, the night light is a nice touch for when it's in my sons room or i want to see enough light in a pitch black room. fits perfect in my bedroom, cleans the air, no dusty or ozone smell. very effective for the rom it is in.

reviews.title: Great small sized air purifier that does some heavy lifting
reviews.body: I got this air purifier for my bedroom as my sleep can be disturbed by air quality pretty easily. I was highly skeptical of this product at first as the price point to me indicated that it might be cheap in terms of quality of the product but so far it has been pretty impressive. On even the lowest setting, it has substantially improved the air quality not just in the bedroom but in the adjoining room so we're looking at space of about 200-300 square feet or so. I would say I can breathe easier at night with it and my comfort level while sleeping has increased a bit. The air after it's been running for a bit smells and just seems fresher and I am considering getting a second one to see if it can handle a much larger area. Noise is pretty low on it's lowest "normal" setting and the night mode feature drops the noise to almost silent, but not quite. At it's lowest setting, there is an odd whine, for lack of better words that can just barely be heard. This whine was an annoyance at first but you get used to and can ignore it. It still works well on the lowest setting to keep the room fresh so it's a good deal. Setup was easy as can physically, however I cannot as yet speak to the application setup as I haven't gotten to that. I treat air purifiers as non-smart devices but I do plan to at least try to integrate it with Home Assistant and if that doesn't work I may try integration with Amazon Alexa. I'll update the review when that happens. Durability of the purifier long term is unknown, though the filters do seem very easy to replace and their price point does make them economical enough to justify getting a filter instead of replacing the entire air purifier. Summary: Good, powerful little air purifier that can sit on a dresser or nightstand, relatively quiet with some caveats. Long term durability is unknown but still was a good buy overall.

reviews.title: 1000% RECOMMEND!
reviews.body: I bought this purifier because I really wanted one that I could turn on from my phone while laying in bed, since I am completely blind in the dark due to my vision impairment, and I don't necessarily have anywhere to place this type of electronic near my bed that was the major deal breaker for me. This air purifier is about the size of a PS5, but a little more convenient due to the cylinidrical shape of it. The app set up is easy and it allows you to auto order a new filter through the app via a scheduled set up. I have mine set up for every 6 months and you can tell the difference between the 2 filters after those 6 months.... the app also will tell you the life on your filter left and will tell you the air quality/ pollen count outside of your home. All the modes do exactly as they say and the sleep mode is ultra quiet which is nice. I've been using this air purifier for almost 2 years now and it is still working great. You can immidetly tell when you take it out of the box that it is a good high quality purifier and not a purifier where they say its high quality and after a week it stops working... My last purifier was lmof a lower quality and stopped working with-in a year, but also I paid $50 for that one and I didn't have a dog at that time. It is so nice to have a higher quality purifier that works exactly as it says on the ads. The app also includes other Levoit electronics you can add to your account so you have all your Lwvoit products in one spot on your phone which I think is so mice and easy. The app is also really easy to use and to set up everything on, it looks and feels very professional and easy which I really enjoy. I love opening up my app and seeing all my Levoit electronics in one spot, ready to turn on or off, or to change any mode it's on to something different. You can aslo set up a schedule of when you would like your devices to turn on and off and what mode to use whenbit does. The purifier has been so helpful with my allergies as it takes about 10 minutes for my severe allergy symptoms to begin subsiding a good amount after coming inside from walking the dog. To some 10 minutes may sound like a long time, but to someone with really really REALLY awful allergies 10 minutes is well worth the wait... Also, the air suction is powerful enough where I have to wipe I'm purifier down with a clean and dry paper towel to get some dog hair off of the sides where the air flows into the machine. It's also kept the infamous "dog smell" from settling in my room. I highly recommend this purifier it's great and if/when this one goes, I will definitly be purchasing another Levoit brand...

reviews.title: Skeptical About Used? This Changed My Mind
reviews.body: I chose the Amazon box option mainly so I could check whether the item shipped safely and arrived without damage to the outer packaging. The Amazon box itself arrived in good condition, but the Core 200S-P’s box was damaged, likely because it had not been handled carefully during a previous shipment. Since I bought it in Used – Acceptable condition, I inspected the purifier carefully. I found no issues with the unit itself. It came with what appears to be a new filter, had no strange smell, and works perfectly, just like my other Core 300S-P, which I recently bought new. I also bought a second unit in Used – Good condition. The only thing I noticed was a black scuff mark on the bottom of the purifier, as shown in the pictures, but it does not look like actual damage. The box for that one also appeared to have been damaged during a previous shipment. From my experience buying used items on Amazon, that seems fairly common, and it is probably one reason the price is lower when the manufacturer’s box is damaged. I ran it for an hour on level 3, the highest fan speed and it seems to be working perfectly. Afterward, the room smelled cleaner and felt easier to breathe in. I also found no visual issues. After comparing it side by side with the Core 300S-P, I honestly think the Core 200S-P is a better fit for bedrooms, while the Core 300S-P is better suited for larger rooms. Overall, it was definitely a steal at $53.36 for both of the units and I’m very satisfied with this purchase. 🙏 Update after 2 weeks: I’ve just check the filters it also surprising picks up more than just dust, it picks up tiny mosquito!!! 🦟 we have left the living room sliding door open because of the renovation so this is proof to be a life saving from these annoying little pest

reviews.title: My 1st Levoit is "Le Bon" - Good quality,, easy to use
reviews.body: Highly recommend it so far - have only used it the past week BUT it is during the worst air quality in the world time in Chicago from the Canadian and Minnesota wildfires. It really seems to be working, helping. Easy to put together - no actual assembly required. Nice and small, very quiet (sound free on sleep), and you should totally download the recommended app. I wasn't thinking I would, but so helpful and serves like a remote almost. Already recommended to 2 friends and another who bought it already. Good product so far!

reviews.title: Purifier
reviews.body: I’ve been really happy with this air purifier so far. It works exactly as expected and has done a great job helping the air feel cleaner and fresher. It’s also surprisingly quiet, especially in sleep mode, which makes it perfect for a bedroom or office. One of my favorite features is the Alexa integration. Setup was simple, and being able to control it with voice commands is super convenient. The app also works very well and makes it easy to adjust settings, schedules, and fan speed right from my phone. Overall, a great smart air purifier for the price.

reviews.title: Indispensable.
reviews.body: Je ne sais pas par où commencer, mais en tout cas, je suis super satisfait. L'appareil a un joli design et on sent la qualité. Sur l'écran tactile, il y a tout ce qu'il faut. Ce que j'adore, c'est le fait qu'il soit connecté à l'application. Elle est vraiment super simple et complète sans en faire trop. On peut voir sur les photos qu'il est indiqué quand il faut changer le filtre (par exemple, il affiche 100 % quand il est neuf) ; on peut donc suivre son état d'usure au fur et à mesure. En plus, juste en dessous, tout est prévu : 1. Il y a un lien « acheter le filtre » 2. Ce lien vous redirige directement sur Amazon 3. Le filtre coûte actuellement 25 €, ce qui n'est pas trop cher puisqu'il faut le changer tous les 3 à 6 mois C'est vraiment bien pensé. La notice est en français, mais j'avoue qu'on n'en a pas vraiment besoin car tout est expliqué étape par étape dans l'application. L'appareil dispose de 3 modes : 1. Mode silencieux 2. Mode moyen 3. Mode fort : utile pour purifier une pièce rapidement (pendant une demi-heure par exemple) avant de baisser la puissance. En mode fort, le ventilateur s'entend forcément assez fort, mais c'est pour l'efficacité. En mode moyen ou silencieux, on ne l'entend presque plus. Il y a même un mode veilleuse (on peut le voir sur une de mes photos) qui diffuse une petite lumière la nuit. On peut également désactiver tous les voyants si c'est gênant, par exemple dans une chambre d'enfant. Pour l'instant, je suis très satisfait et je recommande mon achat.

reviews.title: Fresh air.........
reviews.body: Our vet has this air purifier in each of their exam rooms, what a difference it makes. I bought one for the laundry room as we have a new puppy. You can sense the fresh air straight away. Great purchase.

reviews.title: I Looove it!!
reviews.body: Just love it and cools the room when active. Integrated with Alexa and so far it's been working really well.

reviews.title: WARNING WARNING WARNING
reviews.body: I've made a complaint to amazon supoprt. If you haven't noticed it like my this product is not European, its American and 110 volts. No idea why they are listing it on European site without sufficient warning. Better tittle might be Levoit Vital 100 Air Purifiers (110 volt US)

reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.body: El producto llegó a tiempo y en buen estado. Aunque el manual viene en inglés, es súper sencillo hacer el montaje y encenderlo. Tener la app en el celular hace más fácil controlarlo y pude conectarlo con Alexa sin ningún problema, además de que en la app te avisan el tiempo de vida que tiene el filtro, para poder monitorearlo y cambiarlo cuando sea necesario. reviews.title: A Breath of Fresh Air — Literally

What really won me over, though, is that you can genuinely feel the difference in the air. It's hard to describe until you experience it yourself, but the room just feels cleaner and fresher after it's been running for a while. Setup was a breeze — no complicated instructions or frustrating app configuration. I had it up and running in minutes, and scheduling it to fit my routine was just as straightforward. One of my favorite things about this purifier is how quiet it is. Some units sound like a small jet engine no matter what mode they're on, but this one operates at a level where you can easily forget it's even there. No constant background hum disrupting conversations, sleep, or focus. The auto mode is a standout feature. It intelligently ramps up the fan speed when it detects a drop in air quality, then gradually winds itself back down once the air is clear again. It's the kind of smart, hands-off functionality that makes you wonder how you managed without it. You're not babysitting settings it just handles itself. reviews.title: It's doing a very good job for me.
reviews.body: Update to my previous comments: It's been 2 years since I purchased the Vital 100S and it has worked very well for me. Until ... I just purchased a replacement filter for the unit this month. I considered buying the knockoff filters because they were significantly cheaper than the Levoit replacements. The only reason I went with the Levoit branded replacement filter was because it looked like it included the washable pre filter. I specifically wanted another pre filter as a backup in case something happened to the one that came with the unit. They are not flimsy, but neither are they invincible! What if I tear it, or lose it, or my dog eats it (which could absolutely happen!) ? The knockoff brands made it very clear in their product descriptions that the pre filter was NOT included with the replacement filter. However, the product description for the Levoit replacement filter uses phrases like "3 in 1", "washable pre filter", and the pictures of the product show the pre filter and DO NOT specify that it isn't included. I am very disappointed with this order and Levoit's shoddy advertising. And I want a spare pre filter, but it seems I can't find one for love nor money! I bought the Vital 100S. Like many reviewers of this product, I purchased it because the wildfire smoke had infiltrated my house. I never ever thought that I would be "that" person - someone who needed their own atmosphere! But the irritation in my nose and throat motivated me to buy this unit for my well-being. The reasons I chose this model are: the true HEPA, of course! Also the 3-stage filter. The CADR was good for the size of my rooms (I have open concept on the main floor, and a vaulted ceiling upstairs) the pre-filter is cleanable and I like the fact that I can also get specialized filters for Pet, Toxin and Smoke (in case things get really crazy!). The reviews are excellent and the price is right. I am seriously considering buying another of Levoit's units for the upstairs! I have not used any of the "connected" features so I cannot comment on those. The unit is easy to unpack and I was able to start using it immediately. It is very presentable; it's also light enough to be portable because I've been moving it from room to room (when the wind shifts sometimes the smoke comes into a different part of the house). It's super easy to use; I love the control panel, you just tap on it to turn it on, set the fan strength, and activate the timer. The first 2 fan settings are so quiet that I can barely hear that the unit is on. The third setting is a little louder but it IS moving a lot of air after all! I've only had it 2 weeks so haven't had to clean it or change the filter. One thing I didn't consider thoroughly was the placement of the unit. In order to work properly any air purifier needs to be kind of in the middle of things. Proper placement of an air purifier is between 3 and 5 feet off the ground, with about 3 feet of open space around it. Luckily, the 100S fits well with my decor and is light enough to put on a table or my bookshelves. I was worried that it might vibrate a lot and eventually shake itself off the table but it's staying put quite well. So far, I am very satisfied with this purchase.

title: WINIX 5510 Air Purifier (New Generation of 5500-2 with App Support) for Home Large Room Up to 1881 Ft² in 1 Hr, True HEPA, High Deodorization Carbon Filter and Auto Mode, Captures Pet Allergies, Smoke

reviews.title: Best Bang For Your Buck
reviews.body: I've been looking for a new air purifier for almost a year now, doing research here and there trying to find a unit that meets all the requirments I'm looking for. I need a unit that's for a larger room, has an auto feature, has good priced replacement filters, and looks good to match my home decor. A recent 80,000 acre fire hastened my research due to the thick blanket of smoke that blanket the area (and still is) every morning. With all things considered, the Winix 5500-2 met all my requiements. The unit arrived promptly and unpackaging was an ease. I literally had it set up ans running in about 5 minutes. The body is a hard, matte black plastic that feels sturdy and durable. The front panel is easy to remove, and secures to the unit via a clever magnetic clasp that is secure, yet simple to remove to access your prefilter for bi weekly cleaning and hepa/carbon filter replacement. There are 3 filters in total, and they fit snugly inside the filter chamber, amd ate secured in with the prefilter that snaps firmly into place. The control panel at the top is intuituve and user friendly. The buttons are clearly marked and visual ques explain what each button does taking out any guesswork as to what they do. A stylish indicator light bar runs along the bottom of the control panel indicating the level of air cleanliness with a 3 color scheme...green for clean, orange for okay, and red for bad. You can manually run the machine on 4 fan settings, or choose auto mode and let the machine choose the settings based on the data colected from the sensor. This means hands off operation. There's a night mode that will set the fan to its lowest setting to cut down on noise, and also dim all lights on the panel. This night mode will set automatically if you have the auto mode set on the unit, a light sensor will detect (or not detect) any light in the room and go into night mode. A filter change indicator light also is on the control panel. According to what i've researched, the hepa filter should last approx 1 year. It also comes with a remote control with a battery preinstalled. I dont plan on using it, but if that's your thing, it's there. This is the quietest air purifier I've ever owned. On level 1, it's almost undetectable, and even on level 4 turbo mode, it's no louder than a standing floor fan on high. This was a very pleasant surprise. It cleans the air well. I'm currently using it in my 350 sq ft bedroom. I don't have the equipment to test it, but per their website I should be getting at least 4 air changes per hour which is the amount of air exchanges you need for allergies and serious air purification. I've had no smoke smell AT ALL in the bedroom when I run this with the door shut to the rest of the home and it was initially startling to walk from the bedroom into the rest of the home after the first night of using it. This unit has more than exceeded my expecations ans meets all the things I was looking for in an air purifier. I plan on purchasing 2 more of these when money permits for my combined kitchen/dining/living room area that totals 700 sq ft. I can place these at opposite sides of the area and get more than ample coverage. I would highly reccomend this unit. For the price and the feature list, this just can't be beat. The cost is low, the replacement filters don't cost an arm and a leg, it covers a large area, and you get a lot of features. 09/28/2019 2 years later and this machine is STILL going strong. Besides the occasional vacuuming of the pre filter and the yearly filter changes, I've had this guy quietly working away in the house keeping my air clean. Can definitely say at this point that it's a durable machine! 08/20/2020 3 years later and still working! I'm only posting this update because I find myself in ANOTHER horrible fire season for California, and I'm in a zone getting insane amounts of smoke. Besides regular cleanings on the pre filter, and my yearly change out of the hepa and carbon filter, not much else to report. I really hadnt expected this thing to last this long as I run it 24/7, often on its highest setting to get maximum results. I own 2 now, I bought another one last year to get more coverage throughout the house. I would highly recommend this until to anyone. 01/03/2022 I was buying a new filter today on here and remembered that I actually had a review for this product. I've owned this air purifier for 5 years now. I just added 2 more photos (should be the last 2 in my string of pictures) just to show that I STILL own this device. 5 years of literal CONSTANT USE. I've had it set on the 3rd setting, just 1 below it's highest setting, for nearly this entire time. I have absolute confidence stating that this is a solid piece of machinery. I'm actually shocked that this guy hasn't given up on me yet! If you're worried about durability, at least in my case, yes, this is a very durable air purifier. Winix created a home run product with this one. I think that this may be my FINAL update on the product (unless of course it survives for 10 years, in which case I may throw a party for the thing!) ***I also want to add to those who say this device produces harmful amounts of ozone. That's simply not true. You can go to the California Air Resource Board, specifically to the section under California Certified Air Cleaning Devices. This will show you a list of air purifiers that have been tested by the state and produce under 0.050 ppm of ozone. This device, and all others from Winix, are on the list. That means that this device is at, or below, the levels indicated as safe. Make sure when reading reviews you guys do your own follow up research on an item. It's insane the amount of bad information that's out there! Dont take anyones word, look up what they claim!***

reviews.title: Super clean air purifier with unique features
reviews.body: A really good air purifier with some unique features. In terms of noise, it is among the quietest at about 60 DB. Obviously there’s more noise the faster the fan spins, but in automatic mode, it senses the amount of gluten in the air and adjust the speed automatically which means most of the time it will be running at low speed unless there’s a lot of dust in the air. You can download an android or iOS app to control the fan speed and to see how much dust it is seeing in the air. You can also set it up for Alexa or Google Home to be able to control it through those devices. One need feature is being able to ask Alexa for a reading of air quality from the device. You can also enable an automatic sleep mode, which basically keeps the device on auto fan mode where it senses the amount of dust in the air during daylight, but when the device notices that the room is dark at night, it will put the fan speed to its slowest mode to ensure that there’s minimal noise during nighttime hours. Once the room is lit again and it is daylight the device will automatically switch to auto mode and if necessary, increase the fan speed to pull in more air if it detects an increased amount of dust. These are the main features of the device, but the other thing that I liked about it compared to similar models from other brands is that they say the standard filters it comes with should last 12 months where many other brands recommend changing filters after three months. This is probably because the HEPA filter that this device comes with is thicker at about 1 inch compared to what I have on other air purifiers filters that are generally 1/2 inch or less thick. I have not yet replaced my filters, but with an estimate of one year it should not be a substantial yearly cost because filter filters run around $20. And I say filters because as you can see in the images for the product, there are actually two separate filters that work together one is a white HEPA filter to filter out particles. The other one is a black carbon filter, which filter filters out smell smells. And holding both of those filters in place is a screen which is washable that is meant to capture, larger dust particles or pet hair before they hit the main filter filters. Overall, very satisfied with this device and the only thing I can’t really comment on is how long it will last as I’ve only recently started using it.

reviews.title: Effective and efficient air purifier
reviews.body: I bought this air purifier because I only have the small ones, and I noticed that they couldn’t keep up with the severity of poor air quality when we have heavy wildfire smoke in our area. The unit itself is sleek, has easy to operate controls, and the white color matches my interior decor. The fan noise is very quiet even on High setting— it only gets loud when I use the Turbo feature. It has a faster Clean Air Delivery Rate (CADR) compared to my other air purifiers. Within a few minutes of running it on Medium or High, it cleans the air in my apartment. The one thing I don’t like is the app— it gets laggy and sometimes unresponsive, so take note of that. I know it sounds excessive having so many air purifiers for a one bedroom apartment, but I’m very sensitive to poor air quality and I have frequent asthma attacks if I don’t run my air purifiers. I’m so happy with it, I bought a second WINIX 5530 of the same color so that I’ll keep that one in the living room along with the small air purifier. I also bought replacement filters to have at hand when I need to change them out.

reviews.title: The 5530 is WHITE! FINALLY!
reviews.body: Powerful and works great!!!.... AND NOW I WAS ABLE TO GET IT IN WHITE!!!!, to go better with my neutral tones decor!!! Took 2 minutes to open filters stick em in, turn it on, and connect my app. Winix for the win! Agonized and researched, and researched, and researched, before picking this purifier. I originally ordered in black, and saw the next day it hadn't shipped yet and the white one (Model 5530), was now available, so I canceled before being charged, and ordered the white one...even though there had been none purchased yet and no reviews. It had recently came on the market (at least for Amazon) and I am so glad I went with it. It's so much nicer to look at then a big black box. BUT AGAIN.... I would have gone with the black anyhow, because of all of my research on air purifiers as far as testing and price point for the unit (as well as options/price for replacement filters.) THIS ONE CAME OUT ON TOP ALMOST EVERY TIME!! Powerful filtration and very quiet. The turbo is a little louder, but it fades into the background, and it's nice for me to fall asleep to, honestly. I don't even notice it, especially when the TV is on. I run mine with Plasma Wave and on turbo, full time, but I use the app to set the time/schedule to go to medium overnight, after I've fallen asleep, because I like the quiet noise to fall asleep to... and then it automatically turns back on turbo at the set time for the morning. FANTASTIC! Note: Because I'm on a budget, I already ordered a 2 pack of aftermarket filters to have on hand, but I can tell you the honeycomb carbon pelleted aftermarket ones, are filled a little too much. I'm a little concerned with what will happen regarding air flow because of this, not to mention, who knows if the carbon pellets and HEPA filter, are really of the same quality...but time will tell in the future. THE ACTUAL WINIX BRAND FILTERS THOUGH ARE WONDERFUL!! The only difference between the 5520 and the 5530 is the 5530 is white. I love it! Ps. For those afraid of the Plasma Wave / ion thing... You can't even tell it's on. I have asthma, and I'm extremely sensitive to those older machines that produced ions, but this one is a different kind of thing. It's double bonded or something like that, and there are ZERO EFFECTS OR ODORS from it. Do some research on the Plasma Wave technology, it's nothing like a typical ionizer, nor the purifiers of old days before we knew better, or anything of the such. Don't let anyone else fool you. ALSO, IF YOU DON'T WANT IT, THERE'S A BUTTON JUST TO LEAVE IT OFF....BUT, I SUGGEST USING IT!!! IT'S "PART" OF THE TECHNOLOGY AS TO WHY THE PURIFIER WORKS SO WELL. Great air purifier, I highly recommend!

reviews.title: Fantastic Machine, Automatic, Very Quiet, Great looking
reviews.body: ** 3-week update ** After a few weeks a clicking noise developed in the fan when running on the sleep (lowest) speed. Looking at the fan it appears there maybe an imbalance that over the weeks developed into a motor shaft tapping. Make sure to inspect your unit for a balanced fan. I just issued a replacement on the 5500-2 so we'll see what happens. ** Original ** I spent weeks comparing units on Amazon and elsewhere. I didn't want to spent > 200 on an overbuilt fan, or be stuck buying overpriced filters. I ended up buying the Winix 5500-2 and Renpho AP002 and first impressions with the two units are that they both appear well built, quiet, and have the automatic mode I really wanted. TL;DR; Winix 5300-2 - Quieter w/Smarter hands off Automatic technology & Ionizer - Set and Forget! Winix 5500-2 - Identical in Black w/Remote & washable carbon filter Renpho AP001 - Incredible unit, Amazing filters, Low cost ownership! Renpho AP002 - Almost identical, slightly more air volume FILTERS The Renpho filter has a price and feature advantage over the Winix. Both units have H13 Hepa filters, both have the honeycomb active carbon filters (for capturing VOC), and both have a washable pre-filters for catching large particles. The Renpho however has 2 bonus layers, a microbial coating on the Hepa filter, and an additional charcoal filter sitting before the carbon filter to collect larger particles. The Winix does claim the active carbon filter is washable - Renpho does not make this claim, however both appear similar so it maybe purely marketing. The Renpho filter is shorter and fatter - if you ran the numbers they both likely have similar surface area, thought the Winix is CADR rated for 360 sqr/ft while the Renpho is 330 sqr/ft. They are close. Renpho OEM filters sell for $25 for a full replacement. Winix OEM filters sell for $50 for a full replacement. Renpo claims the filter should be changed every 6 months, Winix claims every 12. I assume this is reflected in their price strategy, however since the filters are so similar, I doubt both claims can be true - and this all depends on how dirty your air is! So cost of ownership is likely less with the Renpho. AIR IONIZATION The Winix comes with an Ionizer (called Plasmawave) and Renpho does NOT. The Ionizer charges any particles passing through the unit so they are heavier and will float to the ground and out of air. If you're concerned about Ozone gasses, then this is a feature you can disable and is not a feature on the Renpho. SOUND This is a real issue for me - I am sensitive to sound and like the home quiet at night. Deciding on a unit for my children makes this even more important, and I don't want to force them into a white machine for air filtration. In Sleep mode the Winix is significantly more quiet at (advertised) 26dB where the Renpho is at 35dB. With the Winix 10ft from the bed I can just barely hear it. The Renpho is noticable but not "loud". The Winix appears to have 5 speed modes, Sleep, Low, Med, High, and Turbo. The Renpho has just 3 modes, Low, Med, High, with Sleep mode being the Low mode with lights off. Here's the rub however - outside of Sleep mode, the Winix sounds "louder" having a higher pitched whine while the Renpho is more of a hum. If I was going to just set this on High in a corner and forget it, then Renpho is the winner. For a quiet bedroom the Winix appears the winner. AUTOMATIC MODE This was a huge feature for me and the Winix is a much "smarter" unit. Both units have a similar Automatic feature, sensing the air, bringing the fan speed up or down according to the readings. Both have light(s) indicating the current air quality reading. The Winix however had a light sensor that, when the unit is in Automatic mode, will place the unit in Sleep mode when the lights go out (for more than 1 min). In the morning the unit goes back into Automatic mode. This is huge if you appreciate how quiet the unit is. You can set the Winix to Automatic mode and not touch it until your next filter cleaning. If you wish to use the Sleep mode on the Renpho you will need to push the Speed button to cycle through the speed options back to Sleep - and then again in the morning cycle back to Auto. In reality you maybe better covering the lights with black tape and leaving it in Auto or just leave it in Sleep mode permanently. REMOTE Winix has one, Renpho not - for my needs this is a non-issue. CHILD LOCK Renpho has one, Winix does not - this is a great feature if young kids are around! APPEARANCE Personally I think the Winix looks clean, modern, and the black color blends well into a corner near furniture. The Renpho AP002 like the Renpho AP001 have their signature funky look which is fine but not as refined. It's an air purifier, so who cares, but it is also a visible piece of equipment in your home. For us the Winix seems more appropriate for a bedroom, the Renpho for a living room. Winix higher cost of ownership justified by the features and sound levels, Renpho for lower ownership cost. If the Renpho unit was QUIETER (ahem - hint hint Renpho) then I would just go that route - save on upfront and ownership cost. SIMILAR MODELS The Winix 5300-2 and Winix 5500-2 are the exact same physical unit in different colors with different filters. The 5300 is gray, the 5500 is black. Only the 5500 has a remote. The 5500 has their "advanced" AOC Washable Active Carbon filter, while the 5300 has a disposable active carbon. The 5300 Hepa filter is slightly thicker (good) and you get 4 disposable filters with each replacement. If you buy the 5500 and don't like the washable filter it comes with you can buy the 5300 replacement pack and use them instead. For $23 more we went with the Winix 5500-2 to test the AOC filter, and for the black aesthetic. Currently you can get the 5300-2 for $129 (Amazon) and when I purchased the Winix 5500-2 for $152 (now listed at $159 on Amazon). The Renpho AP001 (often found as RP-AP001 or AP-001) and Renpho AP002 are very similar products, both using the exact same filters, having different aesthetic designs, and with the AP002 having more airflow (for supposedly the same sound levels) and covering 30 sqr/ft more space. The AP001 has a dedicated Sleep button while the AP002 Sleep mode is the first option on the Speed cycle button - more daily button work for you. Currently the AP001 sells for $99 (Renpho direct) while the AP002 for $137 (Amazon). I bought the AP002 thinking the newer model maybe more quiet than advertised. If we get another Renpho it will be the AP001 for $37 bucks less.

reviews.title: auto setting runs fan according to air quality
reviews.body: The auto setting of this air purifier is good: it detects when the air is dirtier, indicates that with an orange or red light, and increases the fan speed accordingly. This happens when I run the filter in my kitchen and it reacts to the smoke from the stove or oven, even when it is not enough to see with your eyes. Sometimes the light changes to orange or red in the bedroom right after someone coughs or sneezes, so I think that indicates that it is probably cleaning the air of infectious particles breathed out by someone who is ill. Sometimes it indicates dirtier air and it is not obvious to me what it detected, but I trust it since it does detect things I know about like cooking smoke and sneezes. Most of the time it runs on the lowest and quietest setting (which is reasonably quiet), but runs higher when needed. It also detects the light in the room, so if it is dark at night, it runs an even quieter mode. My sister had bought one of these air purifiers for our elderly parents in California. I don't remember whether it was smoke from wildfires or Covid that first motivated my sister to buy the air purifier, but it has been good for both of those health hazards. So when I visited them, I had seen how the auto-detection worked and when I had vacuumed out the filter for them, so I could see that cleaning and changing the filters was easy. I first bought a unit for myself in 2023 when smoke from wildfires in Canada blew down and made the air in Chicago hazy and orangish and beaches were closed because the air quality index was over 100 and was bad enough that people were told to stay inside. Our HVAC system has 4" MERV 13 filters, but I felt that smoke was still getting in whenever we opened our doors and the HVAC filters were probably not filtering enough to completely clean the air. I also have pretty bad seasonable allergies, so this unit is good for cleaning the pollen out of the air in my house. Just a couple months after I bought the unit for my own house, I sent another unit to my adult child in DC when the smoke from Canada blew into DC. They liked it so much that this year they bought one for their workplace office after they had to start working part-time in-the-office rather than fully remotely as they had done when they were hired during the height of the pandemic. The unit is a bit heavy at 17 lbs. So I got tired of taking it up and down the stairs from my bedroom to the dining room or kitchen and I bought this second unit for our household. It has a different style of activated charcoal filter that has gravel-sized pieces of charcoal in a plastic cage instead of the black fiber filter that the previous units used. The new charcoal filter is supposed to last longer than the fiber filter so I think it is better. I found that generic filer replacements of the HEPA filter and the charcoal filters fit my first unit just fine. I haven't looked for replacements for the newer type of charcoal filter yet.

reviews.title: Perfect for our asthmatic household. *Updated
reviews.body: My toddler and I both have severe allergies and asthma. To the point that over the past month we have both been having major issues with the pollen and smog in the air, even with being home most of the time! I ordered this one after doing A LOT of research, and I decided this was the best for the money. With a true HEPA filter that you replace once a year (opposed to once a month) it would save money in the long run. I chose this one for the den in our house and over the coming weeks we will be getting smaller ones for the bed rooms. This review for right now is 24 hours in to having it on in the house, and later I will come back and add to it. Set up was easy straight out of the box, and I put it out of traffic areas in the house. I was worried with where I put it there would be trouble for good air circulation, but it is doing great! In fact with it on high I noticed a tag on the other side of the room (directly across) was moving on one of the toys yesterday as I was cleaning. Then I cooked fish last night (our den has an open doorway to the kitchen), and I couldnt even smell it cooking!! I decided to test it this morning, and sat on the couch painting my nails. Even using nail polish remover I couldnt smell it!!! (which astounds me b/c I hate doing my nails simple b/c of the toxic fumes!!) As far as noise, its not that bad. On high, with the tv and with kids running around it is a little white noise and thats it. I sleep with the bed room doors open, and having a tower computer on in the den annoyed me, however on medium I couldn't even hear it in the den! It also moves a lot of air b/c even when the ac isnt blowing air, it feels like it is b/c of this tower! I am super excited at the thought of having better air quality in the house so we dont have as many issues, and I know it will take probably a good month for me to be able to judge that (and trust me I keep up with our flair ups b/c my son sees a specialist so I can tell you if it will make a difference or not). I also liked the UV light, since we have kids over to play all the time it makes perfect sense to have it to. Also anyone that has lung issues, make sure to avoid any purifier that has the ion part (where you turn it on for a fresh smell) it actually causes lung problems (if you have underlying problems). Oh and check out the reviews on walmart . com for this purifier, it has hundreds of reviews and most are five star (which is one of the reasons I went with this model even though not everyone loved it on here). Check back in August and I will add an update =) ****************************UPDATE****************************** 12/2/2012 Hi ALL! Sorry took me so long to come back and update =) Fortunately if you see below I did give a heads up three weeks in we still loved it. This unit is holding up well, and really does a good job! Since buying it (I guess going on six months ago now --WOW THAT WENT FAST!!) it helped with our asthma and allergies. Within the first month I stopped waking up with a stuffy nose, and it was taking particles out of the air so I wasn't seeing as much dust. I still would love to have them in each room, but that is on the back burner. Make sure you have enough for the sq footage of your room. We have since moved to a larger place, that has more sq footage in the den, and also two open doorways leading to other rooms. As such, this unit is doing really well for how much air it has availability to; when I should honestly probably should have one more in here. It isn't too loud, and I love the uv light. Within the first month of us having it we were exposed to someone (a visitor) that wound up having pneumonia. With the fact we have a higher risk of catching lung illnesses, I was really nervous. I think a big contributor to not catching it is because we had this unit running on high with the uv light. I highly recommend this unit, and I hope it helps! =) ***********************************Update 6/26/13 We just about hit the year mark! Still working great and going strong! Make sure you wipe down (inside and out) once a month (as the book says). Still going strong, and working well! =) Buy this one, and you wont regret it! ***********************************Update 11/13/13 Unit is still working great! We added a second one earlier this year, and pleased with both! =) ***********************************Update 06/29/14 Both units are still going strong with no issues. Still helping with our asthma and allergies.

reviews.title: Quickly Eliminated Days Old Very Strong Indoor Skunk Odor
reviews.body: My dog got skunked at 3:45am, on 05/24/26, the Sunday morning of Memorial Day Weekend. I tried everything, for several days, around the clock, and nothing else, eliminated, the very, very, very, strong, indoor skunk odor, until this item arrived on Thursday, 05/28/26! Because it happened at 3:45am, and it was my first ever skunk experience, I learned the hard way, that I should not have let my dog back in my house, and especially not back on my bedroom floor. The house reeked unbearably! Especially, in my bedroom! That same day, I took my dog to get a skunk bath, I replaced his collar, harness, bed, etc, and I began trying to deskunk my house, especially my bedroom. My parents let me borrow their $300-$400 very big, tall, wide, heavy, Cuckoo, room air purifier, and I used that in my bedroom, around the clock, on high, as well as multiple fans, and my bedroom and my living room ceiling fans, (my bedroom is by my front door and enters from my living room), and I opened my front door and my (living room/kitchen/open concept) back door, and I placed bowls of vinegar around, etc, around the clock, for several days. Nothing was working! Especially, in my bedroom! The smell was literally making me sick! I couldn’t take it anymore! This all started at 3:45am on Sunday morning, then thankfully, this item arrived on Thursday. I immediately plugged this item in, and placed it a couple of feet inside the doorway of my bedroom, with my bedroom door open, blowing into my bedroom, elevated a few feet off of the floor, nothing blocking it, with its UV light on, and I left it running around the clock. The next day!, on Friday 05/30/26, I couldn’t smell the skunk odor in my bedroom, I couldn’t smell it when entering my bedroom where it was the strongest, I didn’t feel sick from the odor anymore, and my bedroom air finally smelled fresh again! It was amazing! And, such a huge relief! That was yesterday, today is now Saturday, 05/30/26, and I wanted to write this review, because this item, quickly eliminated, days old, very, very, very, strong, indoor skunk odor, it performed better than my parent’s $300-$400 very big Cuckoo room air purifier, and it actually does work! And, it has a comfortable sound, even on high, around the clock. And, it looks good. I am so glad that I purchased this item! (After reading other good reviews about it. Including, good skunk related reviews.) I would definitely recommend this item! For ANY indoor air purifying uses/needs! (Not just for very strong dog skunk indoor odor. But, if it can eliminate THAT, it can handle A LOT!) 5 Stars! Thanks for reading. Sorry this review was long, but I hope it was helpful.

reviews.title: Excellent air purifier
reviews.body: This air purifier has made a noticeable difference in the air quality of my office. It's quiet, easy to use, and does a great job reducing dust, odors, and allergens. The HEPA filtration provides peace of mind, and the unit is compact enough to fit nicely in a bedroom, office, or living area. Setup was simple, and it runs efficiently without being disruptive. reviews.title: Good value, works good and an added bonus (?) a brilliant blue nightlight
reviews.body: So far, so good. I never thought I would buy an air purifier, but my seasonal allergies now require it. This unit running in a 20x15 foot room. It is not quite as quiet as I would have liked, but it is no louder than my warm mist humidifier. This is the only air purifier in the house so it really is doing "extra" duty because if I shut the room door, the room gets too cold. Other than the first day and when I get home from work, this unit is running on the lowest of 3 settings. Here is what I like and dislike about this air purifier: Likes: Does a really good job of removing the dust and pollens that I am allergic to When using the UV, it seems to take out the molds that I am allergic to (keep in mind this is not measured by anything other than my nose) The unit is stable even on carpet with a medium carpet pad. Doesn't take up a lot of space. Easy to get at the filters (haven't tried to get to the UV light) Everything is replaceable so I should be able to keep this for a good long time. Time to "sense" a noticeable difference in the 20x15' room - about 15 min I even notice a slight difference in other rooms of the house, this is much more than I expected Dislikes: The obnoxious blue light when the UV is on. I do understand and appreciate the safety factor that the light provides, however, I would be happy with a dot indicator next to the power switch. Settings 2 and 3 are likely to be too loud for most people to sleep with. Luckily, they really are not likely to be needed during sleeping hours. Overall, I like this unit and would consider getting another one for the rest of my house if my allergies get worse. I would recommend that you run the unit on high only when you are not in the room or are not trying to sleep. Yesterday I experimented with turning the unit off when I left for work and turned it on when I came home. Using the 1 setting, the air was better in an hour (that's when I went in the room). The blue UV indicator light does make a good nightlight if you like them. I will also add that where I live, we are still getting snow on a regular basis so my windows are not open and are covered with plastic to keep down the cold drafts. Pollens are not really in the air, but dust from road sand/salt is bad. My furnace is Gerry-rigged into the air ducts so the furnace filter is nearly useless. (I am working on a fix for that). My house was built in 1892 so I cannot complain too much. I would recommend this air purifier. It provides better than expected results and is a good value for the money. I will update this review as time goes on.

reviews.title: Seems to work great
reviews.body: I ordered two of these because I suspect I am allergic to something in my house. The first unit just arrived today, so I pulled it out of the box and plugged it in. It has a simple dial to control the level of air flow and a button for the AV light, so the operation is extremely simple. I put this one in my Office and turned on the AV light since it won't bother me in the Office anyways. Almost instantly the air smelled and felt much fresher. I do notice a slight plastic smell like others have mentioned but I expect that will fade away within just a day or so. The plastic smell is common to all new electronics (most just don't blow air across it) and typically fades quickly once the item is in regular use. This smell is not very strong so it really doesn't bother me much, I can easily stand the plastic smell for the otherwise much fresher feeling air. One of the things that made me decide to try out these air purifiers is that I have been having a lot of problems with common allergy symptoms such as congestion, runny nose, sore throat, etc... After only having the purifier in the room for a few minutes I am already starting to feel better. My nose isn't running at all, and the congestion appears to be fading, and my throat while still a little sore isn't quite as bad. I just got the purifier so I'll try to update this later after I have had it a while, but first impressions are positive. As for airflow, I am just using the lowest setting right now and it seems to be moving quite a bit of air through, and it's really very quiet (about as loud as a laptop running but not doing anything). I doubt I will ever have to worry about the high setting at all. Pro: - Clean air - UV light - Easy to use - Starts working instantly - No assembly - light weight, so easy to move around Con: - Cost, though if it works as well as it seems to be, it should be well worth the cost - Bright lights (bad for bedroom use, but does have an option to turn it off). Update 3/20/2014: I ended up purchasing 3 of these to try and address some health problems (allergies). Almost immediately I noticed a positive effect in the air around me (I had it very close and pointed towards me). After several days I was still noticing improvements in the air quality and my allergy symptoms while not gone were significantly better. This ultimately prompted me to hire someone to come out and clean my AC vents and install an "AirscrubberPlus" in my AC unit. It hasn't even been 24 hours since the airscrubber has been installed and once again I am seeing improvements in air quality and symptoms. I expect at this current rate my symptoms will be all gone within the next week or so as the air continues to improve. The air purifiers were a great help in determining what was going on an in helping to alleviate symptoms at a relatively cheap price point. With just the air purifiers I went from being constantly and severely congested to having very mild congestion. My throat is continuing to heal, as is my skin. I rarely cough now while I was coughing constantly before. The rashes on my skin from the allergic reaction are nearly gone, and my skin feels much smoother and better. These purifiers are a great step and testing and diagnosing the problem, and if you only have mild allergies it will likely resolve them. Just keep in mind this helps pull junk out of the air, but doesn't prevent it from getting there in the first place. If you have severe problems like I did I would suggest picking up one or two of these Germguardian purifiers and see if that helps. If it helps but you are still having some problems you could then look into the "AirscrubberPlus" which seems to be working great for me. I have literally spent years working with Doctors trying to figure out what's been going on with me (Had no idea I was allergic to anything). I am glad to finally have an answer and one that is so easily resolved. I have spent significantly more over the past years in medical bills trying to figure out what was going on than these things cost. They are well worth the cost even if you just suspect you might be having problems. Even with my Airscrubber running I am still running all three of these. The air is great, it smells fresh and clean, and just feels lighter and better.

reviews.title: Must have
reviews.body: You don't realize how smelly or unclean your home smells until you setup and run a good HEPA filter air purifier. Throw in the UV light and you have a really neutral almost sterilized smelling home. I enjoy that personally. It will drastically reduce allergy issues if you have them. It has helped me a lot. Even on low with the light off it will collect a lot of air pollutants to prevent you from breathing them in. Its whisper quiet on low, tolerable on medium and I personally don't run it on high unless I'm gone. It isn't that bad but I am sensitive to sounds. Its pretty much ready to run out the box. Read over the instructions and read the instructions written on the unit. I absolutely love they did that. Don't need to dig out the manual later for things. Tips for use: 1. The UV light does generate heat. I would not recommend it in the summer if you have a temperature unstable room/house. 2. Vacuum off the black mesh of the filter ever week or two. 3. The air comes out from the side of the front mesh, try to place this away from a wall or object and have the fresh air shooting towards the middle or most open area of the room. 4. They have multiple filter types for different uses like pets. Read up on these and buy those replacements.

reviews.title: I recommend this to EVERYONE!
reviews.body: I purchased this about 4 months ago, and I have to say, it has changed my life! I have two large dogs and allergies. Though my dogs don't shed much, they still have dander and they used to send me into middle of the night asthmatic fits. I wasn't sleeping a full night through without a double dose of allergy medicine and an inhaler (and even then it was iffy)...Until I got the GermGuardian. Upon first use there was a little of that "new plastic smell," but it went away after about 36 hours of continuously running it. The first night I used it, I took my allergy medicine, but did not have to use the inhaler. Did not wake up once! The second week after using it, I noticed that there was less dust in our bedroom, and I had been able to take my allergy medicine less and less (now maybe once a week if that). In fact, I haven't touched my inhaler in over two months! I am going to buy a second (larger unit) for our upstairs living area. I take the smaller one upstairs while I'm cooking if I am making something that is really smelly (like fried fish or bacon) and run it while I cook. It really helps to minimize the amount of lingering odors. It would be nice to not have to move it around all the time! The best part though...In this yucky cold and flu season, I am pretty sure the GermGuardian kept me from getting full-blown sick! I started to feel a sore throat and stuffy, but it never broke out into a full cold. I have recommended this item to four people who ordered it, and all of them said that they are noticing a huge difference in the air quality in their home. ***ONE THING TO NOTE*** You have to rinse the thinner filter off about every two weeks (and be careful, it can tear easily). I don't recommend vacuuming it (I tore it up, and it didn't seem to get all the crud out). I usually just rinse it out in the tub with cool water and let it air dry for about 5-10 minutes. It will help prolong the Hepa filter in it.

reviews.title: They do a good job of cleaning the air
reviews.body: I bought two of the air purifiers for my large combination living dining room area. There is a lot I like about the units. On low, they are very quiet. They are a bit louder than a box fan when turned on high. They have helped my sinuses and greatly reduced the need for dusting. They have a UV C light that can be turned on to help sanitize the air. I usually only run the UV when there is a lot of pollution or someone is sick. They look nice. The replacement HEPA filters are less expensive than many other brands. Overall I am happy with the units. They do have a two issues that bug me. They blow the air out of the front of the unit at an angle. It makes it a bit trickier to aim the air flow, but it’s a minor issue. My other concern is the carbon pre-filter is pretty thin. If you notice in my picture, the filter isn’t uniformly dense and you can easily see my fingers through it. My bedroom air purifier has a filter that is far denser and is of a uniform density. This will lower the lifespan of the actual HEPA filter. I might try to find a generic pre-filters that are a thicker and better quality.
