reviews.title: Works Beautifully
reviews.body: We purchased one of these on sale in the hope it would help moderate the severity of pollen season in upstate NY and the dander generated by two large labradors. It has a nice, clean look and small foot print, which we feel is important. The HEPA filter was shipped inside it in a bag that needs to be removed but doing so was incredibly quick and easy to do. Twist the top a quarter turn and place to one side. Lift out the filter, remove the bag, lower the filter back in using the two tabs provided on it for that purpose, lift the lid back on and quarter twist to close. It takes 2 mins. Then its' plug-in, turn on and choose ""Auto" or a fan speed using the touch sensitive panel on top. You can control it from your iphone if you're into that but it certainly isn't necessary. The first thing we noticed is how quiet it is. Effectively soundless in sleep mode and at fan speed 1. Barely noticeable at fan speed 2, unless you're right next to it, noticeable at fan speed 3 when you are in the same room as it but not obnoxious. Noticeably louder at fan speed 4 which should be considered a 'Turbo" mode. Then we noticed the impact of running it - vastly reduced swelling of the eyes and sinuses of those suffering from hay fever and a significant reduction in the doggy smell of our labradors. It works really well. We have taken advantage of the ability to control this by iPhone to set a schedule where it automatically runs in sleep mode (low, continuous fan) from 10pm to 5am. Then at fan speed 2 from 5am to 5:30am, ramping up to fan speed 3 from 5:30am to 8am before switching to auto from 8am to 10pm. Because of the relatively severe allergies suffered by a couple of our family members the P2.5 micron threshold is set to 2 ug per meter cubed and this filter has been able to attain that incredibly low level with that schedule within a few hours of all windows and doors to the outside being closed to the 1800 sq. ft area it services. At this point we have an oasis for our hay fever sufferers to return to each evening and it's made an incredible difference to their comfort. Do they still take Claritin or Allegra during pollen season? Yes, we've found it necessary to deal with the pollen at work and in the garden. Are they doing better than they were before we got this filter? Yes, the continuously swollen and itchy, weeping eyes are gone. The inflamed nasal passages are gone. Their sleep deprivation is gone. Their quality of life has improved dramatically. We had no idea how dramatic an impact adding a quality, appropriately sized HEPA filtration system would have. This unit is rated for something like 3000 sq. ft. We're using to control air quality in a 1800 sq.f.t open plan area and its doing a great job of that without having to run the fan at high speed for prolonged periods of time. We've had this for several weeks now and experienced 1st hand how well it can deal with really terrible air quality when the smoke from the fires in Quebec blew into NY. Opening the door to come into the house with the shopping during the worst of it briefly dropped the air quality from a PM2.5 of 001 to as high as a PM2.5 of 185 within 12 feet of the door. This was then quickly reduced to a PM2.5 of less than 20 in an hour and back to 001 in about 2 hours after the door was closed. The outside airs PM2.5 was apparently North of 300 at this time (sources accuweather and the news), the air was literally a hazy brown like smog and this filter was able to detect it, automatically adjust its fan speed to clear it and maintain perfect air quality in the house. Does it work? Absolutely, quietly and brilliantly. Would we buy this again? Yes, in fact we have so that we can control the air quality for one of our allergy sufferers in another area where they have to spend prolonged periods of time. That one's been in place for about 3 weeks and has done exactly what we hoped it would do - improve the quality of life at work in a 7000 sq.ft. open plan office area. Now this is well beyond the manufacturers claimed coverage for a unit and it looks like they're right based on who's apparently benefiting and who isn't but here's the important point. The benefits to the workforce have been so noticeable to management they're now considering upgrading the offices HVAC system to include HEPA filtration. I think that speaks volumes.

reviews.title: A Must-Have for Pet Owners!
reviews.body: A Must-Have for Pet Owners! I am beyond impressed with the LEVOIT Core 400S-P Air Purifier! We have two Golden Retrievers, so dog hair and dander are a constant battle in our home. After just a short time using this purifier, I noticed a huge difference in the air quality and overall cleanliness of the house. The filter does an amazing job capturing pet hair, dust, and allergens. In fact, when I checked the filter, I was shocked by how much dog hair it had collected (see photo!). It’s clear this thing is working overtime. My home smells fresher, there’s less dust settling on surfaces, and even my seasonal allergies seem less noticeable. I also love the smart features—the air quality monitor, Auto Mode, and WiFi connectivity make it incredibly easy to use. It automatically adjusts when needed, so I don’t have to think about it. Plus, Sleep Mode is whisper quiet at night. If you have pets, especially larger shedding breeds like Golden Retrievers, this purifier is worth every penny. It’s one of the best home purchases I’ve made and has made a noticeable difference in our everyday comfort. Highly recommend! 🐾🐾

reviews.title: Easy to set up and effective- worth the money
reviews.body: We got this air purifier for our whole house because the wildfires in the northwest are giving us very bad air quality this year, but this is a common occurrence every summer so we felt that it was time to take the plunge and get a whole house air purifier. This model was super easy to set up and attach to my app that I already have for my humidifier. I like how I can check it at any time from anywhere to see how clean the air is in our house and even what it says the air quality is outside. It’s very quiet and easy to program. I especially like the ability of the air purifier to let you know when you will need a new filter. This seems like a great machine and I’m happy with everything. My son and I are especially allergic to things outside and we have not been sneezing as much since we got it. I like to check the machine and see what color the light is spinning because it shows the allergy level in the room.

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.body: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 Stars I've been extremely impressed with the Core 400S air purifier. Since I started using it, the air quality in my home has noticeably improved, and it has drastically reduced my allergy symptoms. The setup process was quick and straightforward, and changing the filter is simple and hassle-free. One of my favorite features is the automatic mode. The purifier responds quickly when it detects increased airborne particles or odors, making it especially useful in the kitchen when cooking. If you're sensitive to smells, you'll appreciate how effectively it reacts and cleans the air. The filter life tracking is another excellent feature that makes maintenance easy and convenient. Performance-wise, the Core 400S cleans the air quickly and efficiently, and it consistently keeps the air feeling fresh and clean. My only minor complaint is that the unit is larger than I expected based on the pictures. However, the performance more than makes up for its size. Overall, I highly recommend the Core 400S. It's a high-quality air purifier that delivers excellent results and is well worth the investment.

reviews.title: My Air Bender
reviews.body: Absolute game changer. We live in Oklahoma and around this time of year, the allergens and pollen are in full effect. Every year, we suffer and get sick constantly cause its so bad. On top of that, we have 2 indoor cats and an outdoor cat that periodically comes in, so we got to deal with pet dander x3. I was debating on getting an AirDoctor but was wanting something a little more affordable and was just as good. After hours of research, I decided on the Levoit Core 600S-P. Installation was rather easy and quick. I like that it is also a smart purifier as in it has its own app that you can manage wirelessly over a wifi or cellular connection (Purifier needs to be connected to your network). Once I turned it on, I noticed that it quickly scans the area for air quality. My air quality was so bad, I was honestly disappointed that I didnt invest in a air purifier sooner. The registered PM2.5 index was over 600!!! That's considered HAZARDOUS conditions. I cant believe we were suffering for this long. Well, after about a couple hours at the 2nd to highest setting, I noticed the Air quality was immensely better. Breathing was way easier and after just 24 hours, allergy symptoms were beginning to subside. My wife was suffering from the worst sinus congestion and pressure due to the allergies and that has now completely gone away after 2 days. What I also like about this Levoit is the air flow. Just at a lower settings I can literally feel air circulation at 20 ft away from my living room. The max fan setting pulls in air fast, which is nice if needing to filter your air quickly. The highest setting is loud, but that doesnt really bother me. Let that thing work haha. The lowest setting is super quiet, so its great for sleeping as well. Its been several days of me having this product and it truly is one of the best investments I have made. If you suffer from allergies and have multiple pets, the Levoit wont let you down. Our overall quality of life in our home has greatly improved now that we are breathing cleaner air. Definite recommend.

reviews.title: Best air purifier in the market
reviews.body: I’ve had the Levoit Smart Air Purifier for several months now, and it’s been a game changer. It’s incredibly quiet, and I didn’t need to replace the filter for about five months. The biggest difference is the air—you no longer see those little dust particles floating in the sunlight, and it does a great job eliminating odors, too. During the Fourth of July fireworks, the air quality reading shot up right away. I turned the purifier on full blast, and it quickly brought it back down. I love it and highly recommend it. It’s worth every penny!

reviews.title: Great Air Purifier
reviews.body: We purchased this unit to replace an older Kenmore filter in our bedroom, that worked okay but was loud and had annoying lights on the top. Given the three dogs and two cats that roam our house and sleep with us, good air filtration is a necessity. From the first night we knew this was a big improvement. First, it is much quieter than the older unit while handling much higher airflows. Second, there is an easy option to turn off all lights on the control panel. Third, it connects with Alexa which makes it even easier to control. Finally, we noticed that it did a much better job at making the room smell and feel better. We liked it so much, we bought a second one for our family room. I highly recommend this product.

reviews.title: Love my EverestAir
reviews.body: I intentionally waited a few months to make this review, just in case something ended up happening, and I’m glad to say that this device has exceeded my expectations. The touchscreen surface is very user friendly, and the app is just as easy to set up as it is to use. As Levoit’s largest unit, it is fairly heavy and big, and the wheels on the bottom only allow it to move from left to right, so be prepared to lift it when it comes time to clean the unit. The unit functions fantastic, it’s great at pulling pollutants out of the air, the allergies of both me and my dog have improved significantly since installing this. The air quality sensor is also top of the line compared to my other Levoit units. It gives exact measurements of the PM1.0, PM2.5, and PM10 in real time, while the Levoit Vital 100s & 200s (while still great air purifiers) will only rate your air quality out of four categories. The filter lasts a long time, and the performance in air purification and odor removal is consistent across its lifespan as long as the pre-filter is cleaned regularly. Other than that it’s pretty low maintenance. As someone who’s purchased both generic and brand, I do think the genuine Levoit filters are worth the extra cost. If you manage to find a generic filter that fits, I can almost guarantee the odor removal will be subpar when compared to the OEM filter. They go on sale every now and again, I recommend picking up a few during the sales, which can easily last you a couple of years. (Picture attached is a filter used for 10 months next to a new filter straight from the box) The quality of life improvement since installing air purifiers in my home has made the cost well worth it, and every purifier is from Levoit. Great brand, and they made a great product with this one. If you have a large space to purify, or want to splurge on a fancy air purifier for your bedroom, this is the one.

reviews.title: Perfetto per allergici e per chi vuole aria fresca in casa
reviews.body: Ho acquistato questo purificatore dopo aver confrontato diversi modelli e devo dire che sono rimasto davvero soddisfatto. La qualità costruttiva è ottima, il design moderno e discreto si integra bene in casa senza risultare ingombrante. La funzione smart con app è molto comoda: posso accenderlo e regolare le modalità anche quando non sono a casa, e l’integrazione con Alexa funziona senza intoppi. Il display che mostra i valori PM2.5 è chiaro e mi fa capire subito la qualità dell’aria nella stanza. In modalità notturna è praticamente impercettibile, il rumore è bassissimo (mi sembra persino più silenzioso di un ventilatore al minimo) e non disturba il sonno. Dopo pochi giorni ho notato davvero la differenza: meno polvere sui mobili, aria più fresca e soprattutto meno fastidi da allergie. Il filtro HEPA lavora molto bene e sapere che rimuove anche gli odori è un plus notevole. È uno di quegli acquisti che fanno la differenza nella vita quotidiana: vale ogni euro speso. Consigliatissimo a chi vuole respirare meglio in casa!

reviews.title: Efficace et silencieux !! Effective and very quiet !
reviews.body: (English follows !) Nous avons commandé et reçu très rapidement, et emballés sécuritairement, DEUX purificateurs d’air Levoit (Core 400S et Vital200S) pour 2 pièces de notre maison. Avant de faire l’achat, j’avais fait des recherches pour vérifier les recommandations des meilleurs appareils, et la marque Levoit revenait souvent au sommet des palmarès des purificateurs. J’ai été convaincu. Jusqu’à présent nous sommes tout à fait satisfaits. Ils sont efficaces et très silencieux. Le plus facile est de les mettre en mode automatique. Il faut savoir aussi qu’ils peuvent être contrôlés par une application (sur mon iPad et mon iPhone) qui offre des options supplémentaires. Nous avons 2 chats. Et nous avons des amis qui sont allergiques ! Et je suis moi-même atteint d’une maladie pulmonaire chronique et je constate déjà qu’il m’est possible de réduire ma médication, quoique je ne le recommande pas nécessairement ! Mais c’est juste une preuve, à mon avis, de l’efficacité de ces purificateurs. De plus, ce sont des appareils esthétiques qui s’harmonisent à n’importe quel décor et ne sont pas encombrants. Et leur prix, à mon avis est avantageux. Je ne suis pas un « influenceur », mais je recommanderais sans hésitation ! - - - We ordered and received very quickly, and securely packaged, TWO Levoit air purifiers (Core 400S and Vital200S) for two rooms in our house. Before making the purchase, I did some research to check the recommendations for the best devices, and the Levoit brand often came up at the top ! I was convinced. So far, we're completely satisfied. They're effective and very quiet. The easiest thing to do is set them to automatic mode. It's also worth noting that they can be controlled via an App (on my iPad and iPhone) that offers additional options. We have two cats. And we have friends who are allergic! And I myself have a chronic lung condition, and I've already noticed that I've been able to reduce my medication, although I don't necessarily recommend it! But that's just proof, in my opinion, of the effectiveness of these purifiers. Plus, they're aesthetically pleasing devices that blend in with any decor and aren't bulky. And, in my opinion, they're well priced. I'm not an influencer, but I would definitely recommend them!

reviews.title: Hilft im Alltag wirklich, besonders für Raucher
reviews.body: Ich habe mir den Luftreiniger gekauft, weil ich zu Hause E-Zigarette rauche und nicht ständig lüften möchte - vor allem abends oder im Winter. Nach ein paar Tagen Nutzung kann ich sagen: Genau dafür erfüllt er seinen Zweck sehr gut. Der LEVOIT läuft bei mir fast täglich im Wohnzimmer. Schon nach kurzer Zeit merkt man, dass der Dampf deutlich schneller verschwindet und die Luft frischer wirkt. Gerade auf mittlerer Stufe ist er effektiv, ohne unangenehm laut zu sein. Besuch hat mich sogar schon gefragt, ob ich überhaupt drinnen rauche - das sagt eigentlich alles. Auch Gerüche setzen sich weniger fest als vorher. Ganz ehrlich: Wunder darf man nicht erwarten. Direkt beim Dampfen riecht man es natürlich trotzdem kurz, und wie langlebig Gerät und Filter sind, wird sich erst mit der Zeit zeigen. Der Filterwechsel ist auch kein Schnäppchen, was man einkalkulieren sollte. Bisher macht das Gerät aber einen soliden Eindruck. Empfehlen würde ich ihn vor allem Rauchern, Dampfern und Allergikern, die ihre Raumluft spürbar verbessern wollen, ohne ständig Fenster aufzureißen. Für sehr große, offene Räume oder wenn man absolute Stille erwartet, ist er eher weniger geeignet. Ich bin insgesamt zufrieden - jetzt bleibt nur abzuwarten, wie er sich langfristig schlägt.

reviews.title: EXCELLENT for drowning out outside noise! Lasted 4 years.
reviews.body: I’ll touch on the purification, but the reason I have this, and why it was suggested to me - is for a sleeping aid! That is ALL I use it for and it is EXCELLENT for such. I was miserable and tried earplugs and white noise through my speaker. My brain knew that was artificial. This thing did the trick! My savior! It has 3 speed levels. Which, I’m guessing the lowest levels is what they’re saying is more quiet than an air conditioner. Level 3 is absolutely NOT more quiet than an AC. This isn’t about it justing be loud enough to drown out noise. I’m pretty sure it’s about FREQUENCY. Imagine the sound of an air conditioner, but a little louder and giving you a slight breeze to make your room just a SMIDGE cooler. If there are cars, birds, noisy AC condenser units outside, or people talking outside, turn this thing immediately makes them DISAPPEAR like magic. I think it’s got to do with the airwave frequencies. It brings your mental attention to your room because the purifier sound is in your room. So it keeps you in the present and kind of acts as a sensory deprivation when it comes to audio. It also makes light rain sounds disappear AND thunder!!! While not being disturbing. It’s soothing to me. I had this thing for 4 years until the fan gave out. Using it almost every night. Level 2 will only drown out the most subtle nuances like light wind and things in the distance. Sometimes I use it if it’s a quiet night. But level 3 is what I usually use to really help me knock out. If it’s off or level 2 and I wake up to some noise outside or wind chimes, I just get up and punch the 3 and boom it’s all gone and I’m back to bed. 😴 As for purifying the air, it’s always showing a blue light to indicate clean air. But it’s still good to use because the sensor doesn’t detect EVERYthing. For me the air purification is just a bonus. I probably wait too long to change the filters but they’re easy to do! And dust doesn’t go flying everywhere when I change it. That I can see.. But remember all you gotta do is turn it back on when the filter is changed in order for it to clean that invisible dusty air back up. I assume. Very RARELY does the light change to indicate air impurity. Maybe sometimes purple if it’s SUPER windy or there was a fire somewhere outside that you can smell. One time I was applying a diatomaceous earth powder to my room for bugs, and the light went REDD and I left it runnning for a whole day and I think it reallly helped. Probably wasn’t good at all for the machine but it kept going! I have never tried out the ion setting because the description I have read scares me. Ion wanna try it.. A few days ago, after 4 years, the fan just stopped going. And it made some noise. For the week leading up to it, sometimes the fan would slow down for 5 seconds and then go back. It sounded more like a power issue with maybe my apartment. But then when the fan stopped, I think that was my answer. Not sure how long it’s shooosed to last. I’m sure it varies. But I would say it’s worth it for 4 years. I don’t need any pictures. What you see in the other pictures is accurate. It’s the height of the length of a coat hanger! It’s less than a coat hanger wide by a good bit, and it’s half the length of a coat hanger deep when you measure behind it. Maybe that’ll give you an idea of the size. Not bad. It’s at the foot of my bed. Cleaning it was super simple. I’m ordering another one and it’s giving me same-day shipping. Idk. It’s cool.

reviews.title: A really great air purifier that has many key improvements/advantages over its competitors
reviews.body: I got this air purifier for a relative that has COPD. They already had an Alen T100 that they were pleased with. But, as is common in multiple industries where a core product requires a consumable, it's often not the condition of the core product but the availability of the required consumable that dictates when a product has to be replaced. While I've been able to find enough replacement air filters for that one air purifier, when the need arose for a 2nd air purifier for a second section of the house, instead of just getting a newer Alen, I opted to start the research process all over again and, this time, the clear winner was Coway And, as well as the Alen has done over the years, it didn't take long to see how much better the Coway model was by comparison. A first major difference is in the design and aesthetics. With several color variants and another model with a more classic look, it doesn't visually stand out as much as a typical tower air purifier does. It's more stylish and "elegant". Second, there are actual very practical functional reasons for those aesthetics. Instead of blowing air on people horizontally, it blows the air straight up so that nobody feels the air blowing. It's also significantly quieter so even set on medium speed it's quieter than the Alen at low speed. That's impressive given that this model is designed to handle a space 3X as much as the Alen was. But, it's due to the design of having the air come in from the sides and then exit out the top. It just provides a much more natural method of air circulation. And, also means it can be tucked along a wall and out of the way ... with the cord blocked from view if located directly at the power outlet. Another great feature that the Coway has that I haven't seen before is that you have 4 stage filtration .... with the initial pre-screen stage being a built-in filter that can be washed ... followed by the 1st charcoal filter to catch large objects like hair .... followed by a 2nd filter that have 4 replacement options and therefore can be customized based on what types of odors or particles a person needs filtered out ... and finally the HEPA filter that catches the smallest particles that make it past the other three. Not only is this like a coin-sorter process of filtering out different things at different people ... but this is why, unlike a lot of air purifiers, the main filters can last 1 year instead of just 6 months. The built-in filter is recommended to be cleaned once a month. The charcoal filter 6 months. The "environmental/smell" filter being replaced once a year. And, the HEPA filter being able to last even longer depending on environment. Where it actually gets better at filtering over time ... but then the tradeoff is air flow reduction. That's why the official recommendation is still once a year. And, best of all, the NYT wirecutter review I'd found says Coway has made continual improvements over the years to this product, which really shows. Many manufacturer's just seem intent on constantly reinventing the wheel and it seems Coway was instead focusing on perfecting what it already had. Very pleased with the results and the good deal we'd gotten on it. While we hope the Alen continues to do well for several more years, at least it's nice knowing that we already know what to replace it with whenever it become necessary.

reviews.title: Quiet, Effective, and Worth Every Penny
reviews.body: I’ve been very happy with this Coway Airmega air purifier. It’s surprisingly quiet, even when running throughout the day, and it has made the air in our home feel noticeably fresher and cleaner. I especially appreciate the automatic mode, which adjusts based on air quality without needing constant attention. The design is sleek and compact, so it doesn’t take up much space, and the filter replacement process is simple. We use it in a bedroom and have noticed less dust and fewer allergy symptoms. It runs efficiently and gives peace of mind knowing it’s helping improve our indoor air quality. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a reliable, easy-to-use air purifier. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.title: EXCELLENT PURIFIER!
reviews.body: I don't want to be one of those giddy-with-first-impressions folks in not testing a product thoroughly for months before posting a review... but this thing makes me wanna do just that. It arrived simple & understated.. and by that I mean, unpacking was easy and it did not take brute force or cleaning stray pieces of styrofoam for 30 minutes after unboxing. It slid out, I removed two pieces of protective styro caps, and unwrapped the shrink wrap. I took off the plastic wrap from the filters (which were already in place so I didn't have to read a book of instructions first to figure out where to put them). Then I simply plugged this sucker in, and it worked on auto right out of the box. It was like unboxing an Apple product -- so intuitive, so seamless, so simple. Kudos to manufacturers. And of course, as first impressions go... it looks good. So I love it even more because it's pretty. Aesthetics aside, it is also built well... and perfectly sized. I attached photos to show that it's not too tall, nor is it too deep. It is a bit shorter than my nightstand, which is of an average height. It's a bit on the wide-side, but you can position it however you see fit. It does need about a foot on the right side to allow for proper air flow, and probably a good idea to keep the front end free & clear since the "circle" is from where it pulls in air... but I found this guy could be positioned in many places throughout my home without being an eyesore. I have it in my bedroom currently, but I plan to buy one for my family room as well, and maybe the basement also. It really does work. My bedroom is often very stuffy, especially in the winter when we have the heat temperature set to 73 degrees -- I like it warm & toasty, but my nasal passages feel otherwise. I do suffer from pollen allergies, as well as mild allergies to dust mites, grass, ragweed, mold spores, and pet dander (although I still have 2 shed-heavy fur-babies.) But my allergies are never bad enough to warrant any real attention, I just suffer through it since they're pretty mild. HOWEVER, I keep saying mild when in all reality, I didn't know the difference between no allergy and mild allergy until sleeping one night with this purifier running. Man what a difference. My nose was not all dry and cracked up feeling on the inside. It also was not runny or scratchy, which is how it often feels after running my humidifier all night (which I run to keep my nose from feeling so dry!) This machine does not mask the issue, or dampen it, or freeze/cold draft it away.... it CLEANS THE AIR. I know, I know... it's hard to imagine, but boy is it easy to feel. I slept for the last 2 nights like a newborn baby. Granted, I've only had it for 2 days but the difference from walking into my bedroom vs the other rooms of my home, cannot be ignored. My home isn't particularly old, or stuffy, or dirty, or dusty. Yes we have pets, but I am a Dyson maniac and we have a brand new HEPA HVAC filtration system; we have our ducts cleaned regularly; and, there are no smokers or other reasons for contaminated air (at least that I can find.) However, when plugging this thing in... it ran a blue and then purple light for a bit on auto, but then changed to RED (which freaked me out a bit as it sounds rather aggressive). And it ran that way for about 10 minutes. I left it to its job, and when I returned a little while later, it was back to a blue light and I could barely hear it running anymore... but the air did in fact feel lighter, crisper, and easier to breathe. It felt much like the very first time I walked onto my hotel balcony in Vancouver, Canada and took in a giant breath. It just felt... clean. Air quality is a legitimate thing, and having poor air to breathe makes life a less tolerable for people with allergies or lung issues. Again, not something I suffer from necessarily, but I appreciate the cleaner air this provides nonetheless. So I cannot imagine how much better breathing could be for someone that does have serious allergies, asthma, or other breathing troubles. I would say this gem is a no brainer, if you do. But even if you don't, you'll still notice the difference after plugging this guy in and letting it run for about the first hour. I do think the auto feature could become a bit of a power monger as I have never witnessed it turn off after being on auto as if to say "okay, I'm done. All clean." So I do set the timer feature when I'm not going to be upstairs and I shut it off when I'm leaving the house for awhile. Another thing to note is that there are studies about potential harmful effects to lungs when using the UV and ion cleaning features. It is recommended that you only use these settings when not in the house as breathing in UV treated air is said to be harmful as a result of O3 air, similar to breathing in air high in ozone levels. So I only set my purifier with these features when not in the room. I can't yet speak to durability or filter tolerance, but they are priced reasonably enough that changing once or twice a year would be totally acceptable. I will update if I find that longevity or level of purifying impact worsens, or if cleaning/upkeep isn't as great with this machine moving forward, but for now... I am a Coway air purifier believer. ** UPDATE - after 7 months of constant use, I will say that my initial reactions were still pretty accurate in that this purifier does do what it claims to do. I notice that it is reactive to smells, smoke and other air-purity issues when they are occurring, even when I am simply cooking sausage or something extra smokey or fragrant in the kitchen -- while I have this unit upstairs in my bedroom, which is a considerable distance from the kitchen (bedroom in front of the house on 2nd floor, kitchen in the back of the house on the 1st floor.) So I know that it indeed works because I can hear it begin to run rapidly when I accidentally burn something or even when making bacon or something that has a smell or odor. I also know that it is filtering dust and pet hair, because both of my Coway purifiers (I have one upstairs and the tower unit downstairs) needed HEPA filter replacements at 6 months. The manufacturers suggestion is 6 months for the carbon odor filter, and 1 year for the thick, HEPA filter.. but my HEPA filter was so dirty at 6 months that the "change filter" light came on for the tower unit, so I figured I would change this 1512HH unit at the same time, and it definitely needed it. The filters were both clogged with so much dirt, dust and pet hair.. I couldn't believe this stuff was floating around my house for it to grab. In fact, even strands of my hair were in the filter! And my hair is pretty long, well below shoulder-length. I figure it must have sucked it in from the floor. Pretty cool purifier... I still give it 5 stars and 2 thumbs up after 7 months of use.

reviews.title: A little pricey, but performance is worth it
reviews.body: I’ve had this air purifier for a little over a month now and have really liked it. It seems to do a really good job at cleaning the air in the large room I have it placed in. It’s about 20 feet away from our kitchen and will almost instantly switch into turbo mode when we start cooking. You can also see the display numbers go up which is neat to see it doing its job! Set up was extremely easy. I have not had to put a replacement filter yet, but putting the current one in was very straightforward. It is also light enough where you can move it from room to room if there’s a reason. I will say I think the price is a little high as the actual body quality does not seem to match the price point the air purification quality does though. It’s placed in a pretty large open concept, Family room/Kitchen combo. The prefilter seems to be a pretty neat idea as it catches all the bigger dust particles and dog hair. I vacuum this off about once a week. Overall, I would say this is a pretty effective air purifier.

reviews.title: Amazingly quiet and scrubs the air clean.
reviews.body: I am very happy with this air purifier. Since I keep it in my bedroom, quiet oparation is a must. It didn't disappoint in this regard. It is so quiet I sometimes have to check to see if is on. Other purifiers are quiet when you first get them. But they almost always have a cheaper sleeve bearing fan motor that inevitably begins to rattle an buzz after you have had it for a while. This product claims to have a better motor so time will tell. Also, it really cleans up the room air compared to my last air filter. I hardly ever have to dust anymore. It has a lot of extra features, modes and displays. I just set the fan to speed 1 and let it run 24/7. You can't go wrong with this product.

reviews.title: I liked this so much I came back and bought a second one!
reviews.body: I think so highly of this that I have purchased multiple. It works great in our large bedrooms to manage dog hair and dander (we have a large German Shepherd, so it manages A LOT of hair). I also have one in my daughter's room where she keeps a herd of 3 guinea pigs. Before this was in her room, it always felt dusty and smelled like hay. Now the dust is much improved, and the hay smell is totally gone. We do use it with pet filters and keep it running on low all the time. At low speed, you almost can't hear it. At the higher speeds, it sounds just like white noise, so it is still just fine to run at high over night. The first layer filter is easy to clean, and all layers of the filter are easy to change. The first layer we clean about weekly, but it tells you when it needs to be cleaned (for us, this is where most of the dog hair catches). The disposable filters only need to be replaced every few months, and they are easy to change. This has made a huge difference for me in the air quality and breathability of the room air in our bedrooms.

reviews.title: Ok, Let's Clear The Air For A Moment.........
reviews.body: .........This Coway Air Purifier is outstanding, and I am not sure why it gets any bad reviews at all, unless someone just receives a bad unit from the factory (it happens, folks). Also, we have not had any of the bad "odors" that some people have complained about, either with the Coway air purifier itself, or with the replacement filters. However, the black colored model does look a lot like a large subwoofer, if that bothers anyone....lol. I did a LOT of research for an air purifier to replace the Bissell "My Air" air purifier that we had in our master bedroom, and this Coway air purifier kept coming up as a top pick everywhere. The Bissell "My Air" works well, but it's just too small to keep the air in our large master bedroom suite constantly clean, especially with our ever-shedding German Shepherd puppy always being in the bedroom with us at night. This Coway air purifier came well packed. It was double-boxed, and reinforced with cardboard packing material inside, and shrink-wrapped (no damage to the boxes or Coway unit at all). This Coway air purifier is very easy to setup. All that needs to be done is to open the front panel and unwrap the plastic around the charcoal and HEPA filters. Then replace the front cover, plug the unit in, and turn it on. Just don't forget to unwrap the filters before turning the unit on. This Coway air purifier is fairly quiet on the first 2 fan speed settings, but it gets pretty loud on the 3rd setting. However, the fan moves a LOT of air on the 3rd setting. The Auto and Eco modes are nice features, and they both seem to work well. We just keep the Coway air purifier in Auto, with the ionizer turned off, all of the time, as the ozone produced by the ionizer irritates my throat while sleeping with the unit on all night. I actually tested the dust sensor function in auto mode by shaking a dust rag in front of the Coway air purifier, and the fan speed ramped up from setting 1 to 3 for about 5 minutes, until the air was clean again, and then it went back to the 1st fan speed setting automatically. The dust sensor sensitivity is also adjustable by pressing the fan speed and ionizer buttons simultaneously for 2 seconds. Then use the fan speed button to adjust the 3 sensitivity levels (the unit is set to the middle "standard" setting at the factory). We have not had to change the dust sensor sensitivity level, as it seems to work well on the standard setting. Also, it is recommended that the dust sensor be cleaned with a cotton swab every 2 months. It is located behind the little door on the upper right of the unit. The large, bright power LED also indicates the dust particles ptesent in the room. Blue is clean air, purple is semi-dirty air, and red is really bad air quality. If the bright LED bothers anyone at night it can be turned off by holding down the ionizer button for 3 seconds. The 1,4, and 8 hour timer is a handy feature, if needed, but we never use it. We just run this Coway air purifier in Auto mode all of the time, and it works like a charm. It uses very little power (around 36 watts on high with the ionizer off), so I don't feel any need to constantly turn the unit on and off. The charcoal and HEPA filter indicator lights come on individually when it is time to change the appropriate filter, and the lights are reset by holding down the filter button for 3 seconds. The filter change timer can also be factory reset by holding down the filter change reset button for 2 seconds when neither of the filter change indicator lights are on (if the filters are changed early). The manufacturer recommends cleaning the washable mesh pre-filter every 2 weeks, changing the charcoal filter every 6 months, and changing the HEPA filter once a year. The charcoal and HEPA filters are NOT washable, and must be replaced. Only the mesh pre-filter is washable and reusable. I would take these filter cleaning/changing intervals with a grain of salt, and mileage may very, depending on the air quality in the individual home. I have seen many 3rd party companies that make the filters for this Coway air purifier. Most of them are much cheaper than the OEM Coway filters, and they have good reviews. However, we have only used the OEM Coway filters so far, and while being kinda over-priced, they work very well. Oh, and as previously mentioned, don't forget to clean the dust sensor every 2 months or sooner, as well. The rest of this Coway air purifier can be wiped down and vacuumed out as part of regular maintenance. Overall, this Coway brand is an excellent air purifier, and I highly recommend it, especially for anyone with allergies, asthma or pets in the house. It also filters cooking odors very well. Just keep in mind that this Coway air purifier is fairly large, so it needs plenty of room to function properly. Also, the shiny piano black model does attract finger prints like a magnet, if that bothers anyone. Oh, yeah, and as I previously mentioned, the black model looks a lot like like a large subwoofer. It is a unique design for an air purifier, to say the least. However, those minor "issues" should not detract anyone from purchasing this great Coway air purifier. Pick one up today!

reviews.title: Coway Airmega AP-1512HH
reviews.body: I've been using the Coway Airmega AP-1512HH for several weeks, and it's easy to see why this model has been recommended for so many years. **Setup & First Impressions** Setup took less than 10 minutes. The filters come pre-installed in protective packaging, so make sure to remove the plastic before turning it on. The purifier feels well-built without taking up much floor space. **Noise** One of my biggest concerns was noise since I use it in my living space. On the lowest setting it's quiet enough that I barely notice it's running. Medium is still comfortable for everyday use, while High moves a lot of air but is noticeably louder—which is expected when you need maximum filtration. **Air Quality Sensor & Auto Mode** The air quality indicator is surprisingly responsive. It increases the fan speed automatically when cooking odours or dust are detected, then returns to a quieter setting once the air clears. I rarely need to adjust it manually because Auto mode works so well. **Air Quality** I noticed less lingering cooking smells and the room feels fresher overall. Dust also seems to accumulate more slowly on nearby furniture. While I can't measure microscopic particles at home, it has made a noticeable difference in day-to-day air quality. **Maintenance** The washable pre-filter is easy to remove and clean, which should help extend the life of the HEPA and carbon filters. The filter replacement indicator is also a nice reminder instead of trying to remember the schedule yourself. **Pros** * Quiet on low speed * Excellent Auto mode with responsive air quality sensor * Compact footprint * Easy filter maintenance * Eco mode helps reduce power consumption when the air is clean **Cons** * High speed is fairly loud (although it moves a lot of air). * Replacement filters are an ongoing cost, so it's worth factoring that into long-term ownership. Overall, this has been a reliable air purifier that balances performance, ease of use, and noise very well. If you're looking for a purifier for a bedroom, office, or medium-sized living area, I'd have no hesitation recommending this model.

reviews.title: Es muy buen producto.
reviews.body: La entrega fue muy rápida, me llegó un día antes de lo previsto, primer punto positivo. El purificador esta hecho de muy buenos materiales segundo punto positivo. En cuanto al ruido en el nivel 1 el ruido no es perceptible y en el nivel 2 es casi imperceptible, en el nivel 3 si se escucha mucho pero son muy pocas ocasiones y por muy poco tiempo en las que se tiene que usar en nivel 3 por lo que también es un punto positivo. Otro punto positivo en mi opinión es su tamaño que es más compacto que otros de su misma capacidad. Yo vivo en una zona donde hay muchas construcciones de edificios en los alrededores lo cual ha hecho que en los últimos dos años haya mucho polvo en el ambiente, además la calidad de aire en la ciudad donde vivo ha bajado mucho también lo que ha provocado que tenga reacciones alérgicas que sobe todo en las noches provocando que se me congestionen las vías respiratorias y batalle para respirar. Las 3 noches que llevo usándolo hasta ahora el nivel de polvo en la habitación a bajado casi en un 90%, no he tenido reacciones alérgicas y en las noches no se me congestiona la nariz, lo tengo encendido las 24 horas del día en el nivel de velocidad 1. Todavía es pronto para ver si tendré buenos resultados a largo plazo pero hasta el día de hoy ha sido muy bueno. A los que están investigando la compra de un purificador de aire les recomiendo que analicen muy bien su situación particular. Este purificador me ha sido muy útil ya que elimina polvos, olores y la gran mayoría de contaminantes, también por lo que investigué elimina solo parte de los gases emitidos por los automóviles en zonas de tráfico pero cuidado, no los elimina del todo, si tu vives en una zona de mucho tráfico vehicular y necesitas eliminar los gases producidos por el tráfico necesitas otro tipo de purificador. En mi caso particular ha resultado excelente compra y si lo recomiendo, estoy por comprar el segundo para la recámara de mis hijos.

reviews.title: Cambiar filtro después de 2 meses?
reviews.body: Compré este purificador de aire que al principio me gustó, realmente es muy silencioso, solo que después de usarlo solo 2 meses ya me dice que cambie el filtro. Por qué? Se supone que hay que cambiarlo después de 6 meses...y eso que solo lo usamos durante la noche...realmente decepcionante...

reviews.title: Brilliant
reviews.body: I got this as we have pets and I have asthma and I am allergic to dust, spores, scents e.g. It came very carefully wrapped from the boxing of the product to the individual filters all in protective packaging. I turned it on and straight away it detected cooking smells and on Auto it started up and turned itself off when air went from red to blue. For those saying it doesnt work … did you take all the wrapping off the filters? Its a modern design and fits nicely against a wall. The air felt so much fresher this morning ( we live near to the sea so home has a sort of beach hut smell generally and close by trees blow pollen in) It clearly removes spores as I didnt have my usual sneezing fit this morning having left it on auto over night.

reviews.title: Didn’t work from the get-go
reviews.body: Opened the box a and followed all the instructions to remove packaging etc but it never worked. After switching on the power butter the speed buttons flash and then I’m not able to click on anything else. It doesn’t turn on at all. And very unhelpful customer service so have not been able to return the item!

title: BLUEAIR Blue Pure 511i Max Smart Air Purifier for Bedroom & Small Rooms up to 1,138 Sq Ft, HEPASilent Air Cleaner for Pets, Allergies, Smoke & Dust, Quiet WiFi Air Purifier with Auto Mode

reviews.title: Compact, Smart, and Perfect for a Bedside Table
reviews.body: This compact air purifier has been an absolute lifesaver for my bedroom allergy flares. It is small enough to sit comfortably on a nightstand or in a tight corner, yet it keeps the air feeling noticeably crisp and clean all day long. Setting up the companion app over WiFi was painless, and it gives you a clear look at your actual indoor air quality in real time. The absolute best feature is the auto mode, which lets the built-in sensors monitor the room and kick up the fan speed automatically whenever it detects pet dander or dust floating around. When it comes to noise, it is practically silent on the lower night settings, meaning you can easily sleep right next to it without any annoying humming or clicking. While the marketing text claims it can handle up to a thousand square feet, it truly shines as a dedicated unit for a standard bedroom, office, or nursery where it can cycle the air constantly. The fabric pre-filter on the outside also does a fantastic job of catching heavy pet hair before it even reaches the main filter, making maintenance a breeze.

reviews.title: Senses and removes odors, unlike the 211i model.
reviews.body: I bought the model 211i first as we have a fairly large house and we were disappointed. I have had terrible allergies this spring so purchased the larger, well recommended unit and it basically did nothing to help. The blue light was always on indicating clean air but it did nothing to get rid of pollen and odors. It was basically a fan that moved air so we returned it. This unit (which is the SP1i model) functions much better to remove smells and VOC's. Our combined family room are roughly 700sq feet and we keep in the family room. It senses food cooking odors from about 25 feet away and helps remove them. I think this has a much more sensitive detector sensor and better filter; we are keeping it.

reviews.title: A must during wildfire smoke or cooking smoke or if you have pets & dust allergies
reviews.body: I bought this because of its great reviews online by Consumer Reports as well as others on youtube who have tried this product. This has an exceptionally high rating that I bought 2 for my family as well. It was very useful for us during the wildfire smoke. Also useful when someone outside our window or a passerby is smoking cigarettes. Also useful when cooking & the trapped air is wafting all over in the living room, bedroom & kitchen. Since it is very lightweight, you can easily carry it to the bedroom or near the kitchen area or living room to suck out all the bad smelling air or toxic air. Highly recommended. And because it has an app, you can check the smoke level in your phone. The filtration & filter replacement lasts a long time. Easy to replace filter, value for your money. Odor removal is quick after just a few minutes of it being on. Also perfect for those who have pets & dust allergies. Provides immediate relief when smoke if trapped inside your apartment or house or small area room. A must have in every part of the house.

reviews.title: Quiet, Effective, and Smart Enough to Just Let It Run
reviews.body: I picked this up mainly for pet dander and general dust in my bedroom, and it's made a noticeable difference. Within the first day or two, I could tell the air felt cleaner, and the auto mode does a good job of ramping up when it detects something and quieting down when the air's already clean, so I'm not manually adjusting settings all the time. The HEPASilent technology lives up to its name. Even on higher fan speeds, it's nowhere near as loud as other purifiers I've owned, and on the lower settings it's practically silent, which makes it easy to leave running overnight without it being disruptive. WiFi connectivity works well through the app, letting me check air quality readings and adjust settings remotely, which is a nice bonus if I want to kick it up a notch before getting home. Setup was straightforward and it paired with my WiFi with no real hiccups. Given the square footage rating, it feels appropriately sized for a bedroom or smaller room rather than something to rely on for whole-home coverage, and that tracks with how it's marketed. I keep it in my bedroom specifically and it handles that space with room to spare. My few hesitations keeping this at four stars: the filter replacement cost adds up over time, and the app occasionally lags or takes a moment to sync current air quality data. Neither is a dealbreaker, but worth knowing going in. Overall, a quiet, capable purifier that's earned its spot in my bedroom.

reviews.title: Clean air indoors when fires rage outdoors
reviews.body: Although it's a smallish unit, it held up to the recommendation I received. Our location has been in the middle of 18 mountain and grassland fires for the last month. As of 16 August 2026, the AQI fluctuated for the last month between "Unhealthy for sensitive groups" and "Very unhealthy." My asthmatic wife couldn't go outdoors for at least two weeks. This unit purified the air in our living room, and we put it in the bedroom at night for better sleep. This product was recommended by my niece, who lives in the Rocky Mountains, which also experienced several mountain fires.

reviews.title: Efficient and Reliable Air Purifier
reviews.body: This is my second Blueair purifier. After owning a larger unit and seeing for myself how dirty the filter gets, I completely trust in the efficiency and reliability of Blueair products. We recently went through exposure of intense smoke that caused red flag days. We were very comfortable with the quality of air in the house thanks to Blueair. This unit shows you, by easily seen colors, your current air quality. And at night time, you can turn the light off so as not to disturb sleep. This unit also connect to a phone with Bluetooth.

reviews.title: Perfect Air Purifier!
reviews.body: The perfect air purifier for your bedrooms. I love that everything is controllable from your phone. You can customize all kinds of settings . It’s not loud or distracting. It looks modern so it fits in with any decor. You can set it to turn off and on when you want it to. The filter life is very long and best of all it detects when there are pollutants in the air.

reviews.title: Air feels good and clean no real issues with it.
reviews.body: It's really nice to have, bigger than I expected, but that's even better. It works nicely, and I enjoy having a way to see the air quality on my phone. I used to always get a runny nose due to dust in my room whenever I cleaned, but this has helped me not get as many runny noses anymore. I can see very little, if any, dust in the air (like when you see it in the sunlight). I tested it by blowing out a match in front of it to see if it really detects stuff; it went to max fan speed, which makes me believe this is working. Speaking of fan speed, it's really cool and nice to feel; I honestly replaced my AC with this most of the time. The main reason I would not give it 5 stars would be the lights. I hate sleeping with any type of lights, and whenever I change it using the buttons, it sometimes leaves a light on even in night mode, which in turn I would need to fix by going on the app, which allows me to turn it off. Other than that, the air feels very fresh, and I can hardly smell anything; it feels clean and nice in the room I use it in. It does need to be connected to an outlet instead of battery, which makes it hard to put it in the middle of the area without a cable being in a way, but for it's price, i would say it's really good, the filters aren't too expensive and I would only need to replace them once every 6 months based on how much im using it.

reviews.title: Efficace, silencieux la nuit, je l’adore, sauf pour le bouton du dessus
reviews.body: Le but de cet achat était initialement destiné à purifier l’air de ma chambre l’hiver, lorsqu’il fait très froid et que les fenêtres sont collées, ou à certaines périodes du printemps, lorsqu’il y a trop de pollen dans l’air pour pouvoir aérer. J’ai reçu cet article parfaitement protégé et avec un emballage du fabricant que j’ai trouvé astucieux. Une fois reçu, j’ai immédiatement mis en fonction ce purificateur d’air, afin de vérifier s’il était en état de marche. Mise en marche : Grâce au mode d’emploi redirigé aussi en français, la mise en marche s’est faite facilement. Je suis satisfaite d’avoir pu lire les explications dans ma langue (je suis francophone). En appuyant une fois sur le bouton situé sur le dessus, c’est le mode silencieux pour la nuit ou le repos; en appuyant deux fois, c’est le mode normal; en appuyant trois fois, c’est le mode à toute puissance. Observation de ce processus : Il n’y a pas de bouton qui semble s’enfoncer, donc parfois je frôle le dessus et je parviens facilement à changer de mode, parfois il faut davantage appuyer. Je n’ai pas réussi à comprendre où se situe le « capteur » s’il y en a un. Ce serait le seul point négatif que j’aurais à signaler. Pas de télécommande pour ce premier prix, cela me convient parfaitement pour ma chambre. C’est suffisant pour mon usage. Résultat de la filtration : J’ai laissé fonctionner le purificateur environ 1h ou 2h (durée au hasard), puis je suis retournée dans ma chambre. C’est incroyable la sensation de frais que j’ai ressentie! J’ai senti immédiatement la différence, au point que j’ai décidé de m’en servir encore dès maintenant (pas uniquement pour l’hiver), tant j’ai été contente, ravie et impressionnée du résultat. Usage en mode silencieux : Bien que je sois très sensible au bruit en général, j’ai dormi plusieurs nuits avec le purificateur d’air en action en mode silencieux. Et cela s’est très bien passé, à ma grande surprise. Mon confort respiratoire s’est nettement amélioré grâce à cet appareil. Autres modes : Le mode normal est supportable en journée, mais peut-être pas de nombreuses heures consécutives si la personne reste dans la pièce. Très bonne efficacité rapide. Le mode en toute puissance est très bruyant, donc à utiliser lorsque c’est temporaire. Personnellement, je l’ai utilisé lorsque j’ai changé mes draps pour les laver, tout en ayant aéré avant ou après. Si je l’utilise, je ferme la porte de la chambre. Par contre, bien que je sois ravie de mon achat, j’ai faussement cru qu’il y avait un affichage de la qualité de l’air avec un voyant lumineux. Je me suis mélangée avec les photos que j’ai consultées. Donc il serait souhaitable d’indiquer qu’il n’y a pas de télécommande, ni de connexion avec le téléphone, ni d’affichage de la qualité de l’air. Cet appareil me convient parfaitement, à ceci près que j’aurais peut-être préféré investir dans le modèle juste au-dessus qui a le voyant de la qualité de l’air. Conclusion : Je suis très satisfaite de mon achat, en dépit de la difficulté que j’ai parfois à savoir appuyer correctement sur le dessus (j’y parviens toujours). Selon notre budget, nous investisserons possiblement dans un second modèle de cette marque spécialisée, qui aurait un voyant indiquant la qualité de l’air. Je dois préciser quand même que j’ai choisi cette pour ses « compétences », et ce modèle parmi la gamme selon la superficie de ma chambre et le prix abordable du Vendredi fou. Bref, merci à la marque d’exister au Canada. Soyez bien alertes sur les comparaisons de modèles. Enfin, je dirais que ce modèle serait parfait dans une chambre, que ce soit pour un enfant ou un bébé ou des adultes, ou bien dans une petite pièce destinée au télétravail. Bon magasinage!

reviews.title: We love this air purifier!
reviews.body: We got this air purifier a few months ago. My husband and I absolutely love it. Just to follow on what I’ve read in other reviews: The automatic mode works well. We didn’t know how to make it work first. But then, we realised we just needed to make sure the unit was on, and leave it on Auto mode, that’s it. The timer works well too. reviews.title: Quiet air purifier
reviews.body: This air purifier keeps the air in my daughter's room clean. We have smokers in the adjacent unit to us and the smell drifts into her room. This unit gets rid of that smell efficiently . It is quiet on the lowest setting but does get noisy when you turn it up. The good thing is we usually only need on the low setting

reviews.title: Effective and quiet air cleaner
reviews.body: The smoke from wildfires promoted me to buy this air purifier. I have two other air cleaners in different rooms that work well but I specifically wanted a quiet one for the bedroom and I crossed my fingers and ordered it. Set up was easy, just plug it in and set to Automatic. I didn't install the app and do not intend to (I'm so done with an app for every appliance). It was very quiet until the air quality detection kicked in (red indicator light = poor air quality) and the fan came on full. Even at maximum fan speed it was quieter than my other cleaners and within an hour the room went from "very polluted" (red indicator light) to "excellent" (blue indicator light). When the AQ got to blue, the fan speed reduced to a quiet maintenance level, perfect for sleeping. The manual explains the indicator lights, settings for fan speed and recommendations for filter change. There's also a WiFi indicator light: the instructions to install an app and connect to your network seem clear in case you want the graphs & reporting from an app. Overall I gave this 5 stars because it didn't force me to install an app, it's quiet, does an excellent job quickly cleaning the air, has clear instructions, and is an attractively designed & easy to maintain unit. One more thing: I ordered this along with some other items that weren't available until 2 days later so to save trips, selected Amazon to ship altogether. I had regrets about delaying delivery as the smoke hanging over my city got worse the next day, and was pleasantly surprised when I was notified the air cleaner had shipped and was out for delivery! Whoever or however that decision was made, I'm grateful.

reviews.title: A small powerhouse
reviews.body: Great so far. Very easy to use and very effective for a moderately sized row house. Within 15 minutes on the highest setting I could feel the difference in the air quality. I put it in different rooms daily. It's light enough to carry from room to room. I keep it on a low setting at night. It's quiet and a powerhouse. I'm really happy with my purchase.

reviews.title: Game changer.
reviews.body: I only just got this yesterday and used it last night for the first time but I feel compelled to write a quick review already. This thing is a game. changer. Ever since moving to Texas, I suffer from terrible seasonal allergies. I never have in my life until now (turns out I'm allergic to a handful of trees that are native around here. Fun.) Some years are worse than others but this year is baaad. For the past few weeks my mornings have had me waking up congested and unable to breathe, blowing wads of snot out of my nose (sorry!), and with a itchy/scratchy sore throat. First thing I do is take an allergy pill and wait in misery until it finally seems to kick in around mid morning. (I've had a terrible time finding meds that work too. It just sucks.) I don't know why I never thought to get an air purifier. I guess when I thought of air purifiers I'd always think of the fancy Dyson ones that cost hundreds of dollars. I mean, puh-lease. Not happening. Then I found this little guy. Had great reviews, was the perfect little size for our master bedroom (216sqft), and reasonably priced with reasonably priced replacement filters. In a plee of desperation I talked my husband into us trying it. It got in yesterday (quicker than expected, yay!). I immediately unboxed it upon getting home from work and plugged it in. It says you only need to run it for about 15-20 minutes on high to cycle the room but I set that little baby on high with a two hour timer and let it run. When it was time for bed, I set the 6 hour timer on sleep mode. The sleep mode is great. It's a lot more quiet than I expected. I still expected to be able to hear a little white noise from it (which doesn't bother me at all) but unless I lift my head off the pillow and really listen, I can only just baaarely hear it. And I have it on my side of the bed about 3 feet away. Our home air system is louder than it on sleep mode. If you enjoy white noise, you could probably just run it on low and be fine. It has a button to turn off the indicator lights at night too so you don't have bright lights keeping you awake if that's a problem for you. Anyway, I woke up this morning with NO allergy symptoms. None. No congestion, absolutely clear nasal passages, and NO sore throat at all! I'm blown away. I'll try to come back and revise this review if my opinion changes but after the first night and the relief I was FINALLY able to feel from my allergies this morning I absolutely rate this thing 5 stars. Worth every penny!

reviews.title: Great Little Machine!
reviews.body: This small, quiet and efficient air purifier is ideal for our needs. It fits neatly into any room, is unobtrusive, and is simple to operate and maintain. The build quality and overall aesthetics is top notch. The cost of replacement filters is reasonable and can be done in less than a minute... about every six to eight months. We noticed that the unit quickly removed any smoke and cooking odors from the area while running. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: So far so good
reviews.body: Bought one for my mom and one for my sister in law. Good thing I bought it for my sister in law because a couple months later the devastating wildfire in the Palisades of Los Angeles happened. So the entire LA county was full of smoke. Hopefully it helped but I'm not entirely sure how well it cleans the air because the amount of air that gets pushed out the top is not as forceful as my own air filters at home. My decades old Hunter air purifier has a ton more air flow it's almost like a high power fan. But I think it is able to move so much air because it doesn't have a pre-filter like all the new air purifiers use. It just uses replaceable HEPA filters and I know it works because I see all the dust it catches in the filter before I have to replace it. As for the Levoit it has a pre-filter which catches most of the dust and dirt but you never know how much actually gets through to the actual HEPA filter. I recommend the Levoit for smaller bedrooms, it's too small to do anything in a large room. At least it's fairly quiet on the lowest and middle setting.

reviews.title: Pet Odor and old house odor, bye bye!
reviews.body: Edit to original review: it’s been several months at this point and I have two in our small farmhouse. They work amazing, best purchase we’ve made. So far: it’s perfect, surpassed all expectations, ALL. Backstory: we’re living in a house from the late 1800s, that has been dormant for about ten years until we moved in a couple years ago. We have five pets, four cats which are strictly indoor and use an automatic litter box (Popur S7 which does great for the smell, it can only do so much though) and one fat, lazy, stinky pitbull. The house is musky, it’s old, it had way too much mold in the detached basement when we moved in. And the pets? They stink bad too, this is coming from someone who is very particular about the house smelling good. The litter box is horrible, the dog is gross, the house is old. I went searching for an air purifier, I’ve been wanting the SHARK never change, but couldn’t break down and buy it for $300. Didn’t try it out, can’t say if it’s good or not. While I was looking at reviews, I found the shark had only 5,000 reviews on Amazon, and it was at 4.3 stars. Okay, that’s not too bad. But this Levoit one had over 100,000 reviews and 4.8 stars. That’s nuts in comparison. I done a lot of looking on Reddit and found that the shark wasn’t even mentioned in the majority of good quality reviews, so I disregarded it. This specific one happened to be in budget and also has amazing reviews. We received it last night and set it up this morning, yep this morning, in our cat’s litter box room which is also unfortunately our closet. That room is the worst room of the house in my opinion. It’s been running for about 6 hours and I already notice a huge impact. It’s easier to breath, the air doesn’t feel so heavy, and the litter box is nonexistent, even right after they use it. Hubby sprayed cologne on himself and not 20 seconds later I walked in and it was gone, already sucked away. I put a box fan on it to help circulation and have it on 3. I’m buying another. Maybe two more. If I remember I’ll come back and review again when it gets a little later in the month. We’re leaving for vacation next Monday, so I’m curious how it will hold up against the cats stagnant litter box, which usually stinks pretty bad when we get home after a week. TLDR; Amazing for pet odor, amazing for muskiness. Perfect and worth every penny.

reviews.title: Use daily in our home!
reviews.body: We have 2 in our house and looking to purchase a 3rd. Love these things! Ours run all the time and after a couple of years are still going strong! I've recommended them to quite a few people. I can't attest to any personal allergy relief since my immediate family doesn't really suffer from much (maybe due to the purifiers) but I do feel a peace of mind having them in our home, especially with pets! Does a great job to trap dust and debris. I am always very surprised to find how much these things pick up when I check/change the filter. I also appreciate the white noise that it gives off. We do run ours on the 3 setting most days and it provides a nice background noise, which is a personal preference for my family. There are 2 other lower settings which are much much quieter. The purifier is easy to use and easy to maintain (filters can be a pricey). I will actually clean the filter a few times before purchasing new and have found that works great for us and saves an extra buck. We have two white ones and find that they look nice and blend in well with the rooms they are placed in. One of the purifiers is in a space between the living room and kitchen area (most traffic and use) and the other is near our home office and entry. I feel that they do a good job for the space size. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.title: A lifesaver in wildfire season.
reviews.body: Impressive. It is whisper quiet, and extremely effective. I’ve been sick all week from the wildfire smoke in the Denver area. I happened to be talking to a friend on the phone when I received my LEVOIT air purifier. I set it up while we chatted and within half an hour I could tell that the air quality had improved. I was breathing easier and my friend said she could hear it in my voice - it wasn’t as rough and nasally. It says it is for a room up to 222 square feet, but it is portable (under 10 lbs), about the size of a wastebasket, it plugs in to a regular outlet, and I can physically only be in one room at a time. It cleared the air so quickly that I can probably manage with just the one for the rest of the wildfire season. But it was very cost-effective, under $100, so I may go ahead and get another one for the kitchen next week. (I am a senior on a fixed income, but this is a necessity if I want to be able to breathe in my own house when the air quality outside is so bad.)

reviews.title: Levoit Air Purifier Home Allergies, Asthma
reviews.body: I love the Levoit Air Purifier! It is very quiet all of the time, but if you use the night time sleep mode, you can just barely hear it at all. The fan has three speeds as well as the sleep mode. You can set the sleep mode for up to 8 hours, the best I remember. I do use sleep mode but not with the timer. You can turn off the display panel and I do that at night because I prefer a totally dark room. I run it all day on low and so far, a week out from getting it and setting it up, there are no signs of anything that needs to be cleaned from the outside as I've seen in other reviews. I don't have any pets, just nasty carpet. I call it nasty, because all carpet is nasty to me. I dislike carpet so much! I don't have a choice, though. I think the filter is supposed to last around six months, so we shall see. I bought a replacement filter when I bought the purifier and several filters for the humidifier, as well. It looks like I may have to change the Humidifier filter once a week as a week out, it is starting to turn brownish-yellow around the top of it. I don't smoke and do try to keep an extremely clean place, so not sure what the discoloration is. I'm the only one who has ever lived here. I use distilled water but also bought the demineralization kit and extra filters for the humidifier in case I run out of distilled water and have to use tap water. I clean the humidifier every day. It's not hard to do once you do it. I love the modern look and it is built very well. It's really not hard to use at all. I believe it is super effective combined with my also Levoit Humidifier. I have them on opposite sides of my small bedroom as I couldn't put my humidifier under the smoke alarm. My skin feels much softer and cleaner using the both of them. I could instantly tell a difference in how well I could breathe using the them. As before purchasing them, I couldn't breathe out of my nose at all. The humidity is brutal here. I have been able to get the humidity down to 58, which is something the local meteorologist said couldn't happen in these heatwave temperatures! Ha! I only use GENUINE LEVOIT filters and they're a bit more costly, but I prefer to use the real deal and have less problems/headaches. It can be a bit catchy to find them on Amazon and the generic ones keep popping up; however, I went straight to the Levoit store to get the genuine ones. Blessed to be able to somewhat better control my Asthma and all-season Allergies with the help of these two awesome products! Thank you, Amazon and Levoit! Sorry for combining reviews but I need to do a copy and paste for the humidifier as it will save me time doing it this way.
