title: Philips Sonicare 4100 Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush, 1 Brush Head, White

reviews.title: Not as weak as they say
reviews.body: This is my 1st electric toothbrush. I ordered it over the oral b smart 1500 because it's cheaper and I found more people who swear by it than oral b. Later on, I read comments where people who have this 4100 for 10+ years say that the newer 2021 version has only half the power of the old version. Someone on reddit showed images of the inside of the new and old versions and the new version has a small plastic toy-like motor, while the old version has a big copper-wrapped motor and an old version user said "now I understand why the new version is lighter and less powerful". I was disappointed on the new version and tried to cancel the order but I couldn't. Once it came, I decided to try it and to my surprise, it brushes my teeth way better than my manual soft-bristled and hard-bristled toothbrushes(I use both manual brushes daily compared to my daily usage of the electric toothbrush 4100 C2 head of medium bristles. If you have gum sensitive issue, buy the S sensitive or G2 optimal brush head. If you want hard-bristled, buy W diamondclean brush head). I don't know how good the old version was but this newer version definitely brushes better than any manual toothbrush unfortunately it doesn't not come with a travel case. Update 5/16/2024: I bought the Oral B smart 1500 because it was on sale and I wanted to see how better it is compared to the sonicare. The oral B package looks nicer and bigger than the Sonicare but upon opening the smart 1500 package, I saw hair all over the toothbrush. I did read many customers saying on reddit that their Oral b toothbrush were repackaged, but I can't believe I'm a victim of this nastiness. It also took 2 weeks to reach me from Hawaii and since it says "made in China", I think the seller is located in China. I'll return this and I'll advise you to buy the Sonicare instead of the oral b if you don't want to be cheated receiving a used-repackaged toothbrush. Update 05/22/2024: On 05/17/24, I bought the Oral b smart clean 360 which has exact power as the smart 1500 that I returned but the smart 360 has 5 modes and a button to change the mode while the smart 1500 has 3 modes and no button to switch between the modes. The advantage of the oral b smart clean 360 is that the brush heads cost is cheaper than the Sonicare 4100 and I find it better at whitening my teeth than the Sonicare. That's all the advantages there. The things that I don't like with it are many, so I'm just going to name the most annoying ones: 1) The brush heads are too big compared to the Sonicare(see picture): Putting Oral b brush heads in my mouth is like putting a golf ball in my mouth(my head and mouth are wider than the average US male). 2) The brush heads have holes(see pictures) that trap saliva+toothpaste and creates more noise when the brush handle needle rotates in the presence of the liquid mixture, and moisture will be also trapped easily in the holes(most customers complain about Oral b brush heads design. Oral b corrected the needle issue with the IO version but the IO introduced a shallow hole which now traps moisture in the brush handle). When I'm using the Oral b with no choice but to have my mouth wide-open, it forces my mouth to produce more saliva which gets mixed with the toothpaste and enters the brush head and creates more noise. 3) Rattling noise: The Oral b smart clean 360 isn't as noisy as people say. It's the quality of the noise the problem. It's a very unpleasant rattling noise as if you're hearing an old car engine with broken parts in it. That noise gets worse when liquid enters the brush head holes. 4) The charger is not round like a perfect circle: You must put the Oral b brush handle in a specific position to charge it and if you place it wrong, it'll fall and might break. 5) The Daily Clean mode is rough and combined with the big brush head the experience is bad, but the smart clean 360 has more mode which make it smoother and better than the smart 1500 but not as good as the Sonicare 4100. 6)It has no auto-stop mode: You keep brushing without knowing how long you have been brushing your teeth. To summarize, the oral b non-IO brush heads are cheap but very badly designed for a pleasant toothbrushing. I won't recommend it if you're shorter than 6 foot tall or have a small mouth.

reviews.title: Replaced my old Series 2 Sonicare with this one and can highly recommend this 4100 Model.
reviews.body: I was replacing my "old" Phillips Sonicare, specifically the HX6240, which was a series 2 model. Loved it. I found newer brands of electric toothbrushes seemed to be including 2 features I did not want, sending my data; and, reminders to brush a new area every 20 sec for 2 minutes. The latter called Brush Pacer results in 6 reminders. I prefer 4 reminders, the Quad Pacer Timer, 4 - 30 sec increments. Easier to keep track of where I already brushed. This new 4100 had the Quad Pacer, was not info invasive, and I could use the same brush tips I liked. The Lithium Ion battery on this new one lasts longer than the old NiMH one. It can sit on a "similar looking" charging base to the old one. But the new model is charged via a USB type A cable base and cord. You can use any standard USB charger you already own for phones or tablets. This model includes 2 Pressure sensitive settings, which is all I need. It is lighter and has a slimmer profile. One unexpected thing is that you can actually charge the new model on the older model's base. My spouse still uses the older model, and when we have extended travel together we take just one charger. Its turned out to be the perfect replacement electric toothbrush for me. (Photos: Older Model is on your left.)

reviews.title: Philips Sonicare 4100: Your Smile's New Best Friend – A Must-Have for Superior Clean!
reviews.body: As someone deeply invested in maintaining optimal oral health, I'm always on the lookout for products that genuinely deliver. After experiencing the Philips Sonicare 4100 Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush (Model HX3681/23), I can confidently say this isn't just another gadget; it's a game-changer for your daily brushing routine. With an impressive 4.4 out of 5 stars from over 46,000 reviews and being an Amazon's Choice with 50K+ units bought last month, it's clear I'm not alone in my enthusiasm! From the moment you unbox this sleek white device, you appreciate its ergonomic design and lightweight feel. But the real magic happens when you start brushing. Here's why the Philips Sonicare 4100 stands out and why it's a smart investment for your oral health: Unmatched Plaque Removal: Forget your manual toothbrush! This sonic powerhouse is clinically proven to remove up to 7 times more plaque. The 31,000 brush strokes per minute gently yet effectively break up and sweep away plaque, leaving your teeth feeling incredibly clean and smooth – a noticeable difference from day one. This directly addresses the core need for effective cleaning. Gentle on Gums, Smart on Pressure: One of my biggest concerns with electric toothbrushes has always been applying too much pressure. The Sonicare 4100 brilliantly solves this with its built-in pressure sensor. If you press too hard, it automatically warns you and reduces vibrations, protecting your gums from damage. This feature alone provides immense peace of mind and makes it ideal for sensitive gums. Master Your Brushing Technique: The SmarTimer and QuadPacer are invaluable. The SmarTimer ensures you brush for the dentist-recommended two minutes, while the QuadPacer guides you to brush each quadrant of your mouth equally. This takes the guesswork out of brushing and helps you develop consistently good habits. Long-Lasting Convenience: With a 14-day battery life on a single charge, this toothbrush is perfect for travel or for those who simply don't want to constantly think about recharging. The included USB charger makes it easy to power up wherever you are. Aesthetic Appeal: Beyond its performance, the sleek white design is a welcome addition to any bathroom countertop, blending seamlessly with modern aesthetics. The Verdict: The Philips Sonicare 4100 isn't just an upgrade; it's an essential tool for anyone serious about elevating their oral care routine. It combines advanced technology with user-friendly features, delivering a superior clean while protecting your gums. Considering its current 20% savings, bringing the price down to just $39.96 from $49.96, it offers exceptional value for such a high-performing device. If you're ready to experience a truly effective, gentle, and smart brushing experience, the Philips Sonicare 4100 is highly recommended. It's more than just a toothbrush; it's an investment in a healthier, brighter smile.

reviews.title: Best I’ve ever used

reviews.title: minor accidents and there goes your 3 digit electric tooth brush
reviews.body: Sonicare loses cleaning power after minor drops I’ve now gone through three Sonicare toothbrushes in about two years. In my experience, even a minor drop can make the vibration much weaker. The brush still turns on and vibrates, but the power drops so much that it no longer feels like an effective electric toothbrush, even with a new brush head. That is the most frustrating part: it does not completely fail, so at first glance it seems fine, but the cleaning performance is clearly reduced. At that point, the main advantage of using an electric toothbrush is basically caput.. This has happened to me twice, and it makes the product feel far less durable than it should be for normal real-world household use. For a premium toothbrush, I expected better resistance to minor drops and better long-term reliability. I still think Sonicare is a great product, but after this repeated experience I would strongly advise buyers to be very careful with handling and not assume it can tolerate everyday bumps or falls. Planned obscolecence? Sad if it is. I am sure it should not take more than a minor cushioning, internal or external to make the product more rugged.

reviews.title: A Nice Upgrade From My Oral-B Pro 100
reviews.body: I recently upgraded from my old Oral-B Pro 100 to the Oral-B iO Series 3, and I can definitely tell the difference. The brushing experience feels much smoother and quieter, and my teeth feel noticeably cleaner after each use. One of my favorite improvements is the pressure sensor. It helps me avoid brushing too hard, which is something my old toothbrush didn't have. I also like the different cleaning modes they're simple to switch between and let me choose what feels best. The brush head glides comfortably over my teeth, and the handle feels solid and well-made. Battery life has also been great so far, lasting several days before needing a recharge. If you're still using an older Oral-B model like the Pro 100 and have been thinking about upgrading, I think the iO Series 3 is well worth it. It feels like a much more refined brushing experience, and I'm really happy with the purchase.

reviews.title: Very nice looking, powerful and inexpensive. A great purchase!!
reviews.body: What a bargain!! This is replacing our old power toothbrush and upgrading to something much better. The cleaning modes are delightful, and the recharge time is efficient. Keeping the brush assembly in the holder and protected from the elements with the plastic case is such a great idea. The quality of this Oral-B toothbrush is second to none, as expected. The power and vibration of the brush is something we'll have to get used to, but that's a given considering our old one is well over 10 years old. 2 thumbs up on this product.

reviews.title: Clean teeth are a must!
reviews.body: Really like this toothbrush. Holds a charge well and I really like the brush heads they seem to clean very well. Has a 2 minute timer and lights that help you to know if you are applying the correct amount of pressure. I'm pleased with it and happy I bought it.

reviews.title: Its a good toothbrush would recommend if your in the market
reviews.body: I’ve been using the Oral-B iO Series 3 for a few weeks now, and the difference compared to a standard electric or manual toothbrush is night and day. It leaves your teeth feeling amazingly smooth, like you just stepped out of a dental cleaning. ​What makes it great: ​Unreal Cleaning Power: The round micro-vibrating brush head gets into every spot with zero effort. My teeth have never felt cleaner or fresher. ​Smart Pressure Sensor: This is probably the best feature. The light indicator shows green when you're using the right amount of pressure, red if you're pressing too hard, and white if you're too soft. It takes all the guesswork out of brushing and protects your gums. ​Built-in Timer & Modes: The built-in 2-minute timer pulses every 30 seconds to let you know when to switch quadrants, making it super easy to ensure a complete clean every single time. ​Solid Battery Life: Holds a charge really well for daily morning and night use, and the charging base takes up very little counter space. ​If you’re thinking about upgrading your oral care routine, this toothbrush is worth every penny. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: I love this toothbrush!
reviews.body: I always forget to write reviews after I buy stuff on Amazon. I should try to do it more because it is helpful when you find a review that is real. So, I bought this toothbrush to replace another brand that I bought about a year and a half ago. The old toothbrush just wasn't doing a good job at cleaning my teeth. I have always had problems with cavities and plaque build-up. The only sure-fire way of getting all of the plaque for me was to use Plax prior to brushing. Still, I find myself in the dentist's office every six months with a hygienist jack-hammering my mouth with water pick to get my teeth clean. It's embarrassing and it makes me feel anxious about my gum health. I saw the Oral-B iO Series 3 here on Amazon and it was discounted. According to Oral-B it is really good at getting rid of plaque. I took the manufacturer at their word, and bought it. Holy crap, ya'll! This thing is amazing! The iO3 has a round brush head similar to the polishing tool your dental hygienist uses. I've used cheaper Oral-B electric toothbrushes that also have round heads, but they weren't as robust as the brush head on the iO3. The bristles aren't hard, but they are dense and arranged in a way that they can hug your teeth while brushing. You can get that brush on every surface of each tooth (except directly between the teeth, of course). The motorized handle has a pressure sensor that changes color based on how hard or soft you are pressing. If you get it just right, it lights up green. The iO3 also helps you time your brushing so that you the recommended two minutes. It pulses when it's time to change to a different quadrant. It doesn't automatically shut off when the two minutes are up, however. That's fine with me as I will just continue brushing other parts of my mouth like my tongue and the roof of my palette when I'm done with my teeth. There are supposedly three types of brushing settings to choose from, but I have only used the default cleaning setting. The other two setting are supposed to be for sensitive teeth and whitening. The default works just fine for me. The build is solid and feels good in my hands. I like that the handle comes with two brush heads, a travel case, and case for the brush heads. I like to take my brush head off and put it in the case after I'm finished just because I'm paranoid about having a toothbrush exposed in the bathroom. It's nice to have the option to shield it from germs. So, TLDR, this is a great electric toothbrush. My teeth haven't felt this clean since the last time I went to the dentist. Oral-B did a fantastic job of designing a product that makes brushing easy and will almost certainly result in you having a positive visit at the dentist, and may help reverse gum issues and prevent cavities. I definitely recommend you buy this product if you are in the market for an electric toothbrush.

reviews.title: A noticeable upgrade from the Pro 1000!
reviews.body: I previously owned the Oral-B Pro 1000, and while it did a good job cleaning my teeth, this model is definitely an upgrade. The pressure sensor is one of my favorite features. When I press too hard, the light changes color, making it easy to know when to ease up. It's a simple feature, but very useful. It's also noticeably quieter and smoother than the Pro 1000, and the battery life is much better. Overall, brushing just feels more comfortable and enjoyable with this model. I'm very happy with this upgrade and would definitely recommend it.

reviews.title: Best toothbrush I've ever owned
reviews.body: This is by far the best toothbrush I have ever used! The dentist told me several years ago to buy an electric toothbrush so I bought the cheap oral B ones from walmart and forced myself to use that several times a week. Thinking that was better then just using my regular manual one. My husband bought this in black about a month ago and liked it and it was on sale so I decided to jump and get it as well. I've been using it for a week now and my mouth still feels as clean as it did the day I came home from the dentist with a cleaning. It was a little strong on the vibrations at first but after the week of using it consistently it no longer bothers me. Its not loud at all and I love the 30 second interval vibrations it gives you so you know to move on to the next quadrant in your mouth. Over all the best thing I've bought all year. Would recommend it to everyone.

reviews.title: La meilleure brosse-à-dents électrique
reviews.body: Après deux mois d'utilisation, je peux le dire, il s'agit de la meilleure brosse-à-dents électrique que j'ai utilisé. En voyant ce nouveau type de brosse pourtant, je me demandais au départ s'il ne s'agissait pas d'une autre façon d'attirer le consommateur, mais non. Le système de nettoyage me paraît bien différent de ce que j'utilisais auparavant, y compris chez Oral B. POURS : - Le système de vibration / rotation de la brosse est tout simplement très bien pensé. C'est très doux à l'usage, cela paraît également très précis et le résultat est vraiment bon. - Le voyant qui permet de savoir si l'on appuie trop sur la brosse est très visible, c'est assez simple d'adapter la pression exercée. - J'aime également la vitesse de vibration. CONTRES : - Un peu dispendieux. Sur du long terme, si la brosse-à-dents reste toujours aussi fiable, cela pourrait compenser son prix. Conclusion : C'est un coup de cœur pour la brosse Oral B iO ! En espérant que cela dure plusieurs années.

reviews.title: Simple, effective, and reliable sonic cleaning without the extra frills!
reviews.body: As an Amazon Vine Voice, I tested the PHILIPS Sonicare 1100 Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush over a two-week period, using it for twice-daily brushing routines to evaluate its cleaning power, battery life, and overall usability. If you want to step up from a manual toothbrush without paying for expensive, feature-heavy models you'll never use, this stripped-down sonic brush is a compelling option. Here is my honest breakdown of how it performs: ⭐ Cleaning Performance & Power Sonic Technology: Delivering solid vibration action, it drives fluid deep between teeth and along the gumline. It leaves your mouth feeling remarkably fresh—way cleaner than any standard manual brush. Single-Mode Simplicity: It features just one cleaning speed and one button. While it lacks multiple intensity settings or fancy pulse cycles, it focuses entirely on doing the core job exceptionally well. Easy-Start Feature: If you are new to electric toothbrushes, it includes a built-in feature that gently ramps up the power gradually over your first 14 brushing sessions to prevent gum sensitivity. 🛠️ Design & Usability Slim & Lightweight: The handle has a sleek, ergonomic profile that feels comfortable and lightweight in the hand without taking up unnecessary counter space. Smart Timers: The integrated SmarTimer automatically shuts the brush off after the dentist-recommended 2 minutes, while the QuadPacer pulses every 30 seconds to signal when you should switch quadrants of your mouth. 🔋 Battery Life & Charging Dependable Endurance: The internal rechargeable battery easily lasts up to 2 weeks (around 14 days) on a single charge under normal use. Convenient Indicator: A subtle battery level LED indicator alerts you when it's time to drop it back on its USB charging base. 🛑 Minor Cons to Consider No Pressure Sensor: Because this is a budget-friendly model, it lacks a pressure sensor warning light. If you have a heavy hand, you'll need to mind how hard you press manually. Basic Accessories: The kit keeps things minimal with just the handle, one brush head, and a USB charging stand (wall adapter block not always included). The Verdict The PHILIPS Sonicare 1100 proves you don’t need to spend a fortune to get a dentist-clean mouth. It cuts out the complicated modes in favor of reliable timers, great battery life, and powerful sonic action. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a straightforward, high-value electric toothbrush!

title: Oral-B Pro 1000 Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush, Pink

reviews.title: Lasted 12 years before I had to buy it again! Superior clean without the hefty price.
reviews.body: After an incredible 12-year run with my first Oral-B Pro 1000, I finally bought it again! The battery on my original brush finally bit the dust, and toward the end, it would only stay charged enough to get me through 24 hours of teeth brushing (if I was lucky) before dying. However, I loved the performance so much over the last decade that replacing it with the exact same model was an absolute no-brainer. Here is why this brush is a classic: Hygienist Approved: My dental hygienist once told me that it really doesn't matter how fancy or expensive an electric toothbrush is—any solid electric toothbrush is far superior to a manual brush. This model gives you that elite, professional clean without making you pay for unnecessary, over-hyped tech features. The One Minor Con: If I have to name one downside, it is the noise. Even brand new out of the box, it does sound a bit like it might be powered by hamsters while it is working. But just because it doesn't sound whisper-quiet doesn't negate the fact that it is a remarkably solid, heavy-duty toothbrush. A Note on the Color: The color is fun, but the listing is a bit misleading. I thought I would be getting a mint green, but instead, it is definitely a powder blue. I much prefer green to blue, but eh, whatever—it still cleans my teeth perfectly! If you want a proven, durable electric toothbrush that will last you for years to come without draining your wallet, this is the one to get. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Crooked, Overcrowded, Yellow Teeth
reviews.body: Let me start this review by saying that when I was younger, much to my parent's dismay, I neglected to brush my teeth. I would brush them but not as often and as thoroughly as a child should. This was partly due to my very bad gag reflex and partly due to the fact that it felt painful (?). Anyway, I've had yellow teeth my whole life (I'm 29) because of it. I never got braces (thanks again gag reflex) but my parents tried everything to get me to have better oral hygiene and to have a more aesthetically pleasing smile. Now that I'm well into adulthood, my smile being so yellow, and also very crowded, was starting to bother me. I knew I had to give in and fix one or the other. (To be clear if you have crooked teeth don't feel like you have to change yourself just for society - after 29 years, I can say that I truly wanted to change the yellowness purely for myself). I've gotten healthier in almost all other aspects of my life. I decided to make the plunge and buy this in hopes it would help get my teeth cleaner and help reduce plaque buildup. Not just for aesthetics, but for actual oral hygiene. So, I've used it twice a day for 3 days so far and my brother commented on how "white" my teeth look yesterday evening. That felt very good to hear, not gonna lie. I think this toothbrush is amazing for the price. I love how tiny the head of the brush is. It fits into my small, overcrowded mouth perfectly. I was worried that it would take forever to brush my teeth since I wasn't doing the work, the toothbrush was. However, it takes about 2 minutes and 30 seconds or 3 minutes if you're extra thorough. It allots 30 seconds to each section of your mouth, it will do a variation in the vibration to let you know when the 30 seconds is up and to move to the next portion of your mouth. It doesn't automatically shut off after 3 minutes (that I know of) if you want to go back and do another section of your mouth, which is nice. As for the pressure sensor on the toothbrush, mine does not work. It doesn't indicate any color or anything. It just appears to be a normal electric toothbrush. I may have gotten a "bad" toothbrush since it's not working, but to be honest, I truly just wanted something that would do a deep clean and this toothbrush does that. However, all the other reviews mention the sensor working so if that's something you're looking for, I would still highly recommend this toothbrush. I think mine might just be a dud in that department. The charging took several hours to be full on the first day. I keep it on the charger to ensure that it is always fully charged. If you don't have your charger with you and you need to rely on it without it, I'm told the battery lasts up to a week. Which, is very impressive for a $50 toothbrush. Amazon says that it has Bluetooth connectivity but I do not see any indication of that on the boxes or in the manual. My parents bought me an electric toothbrush when I was little, but I was too young to appreciate it. Now that I'm older, I think this is a great option for any person of any age. I do recommend it!

reviews.title: I love this toothbrush
reviews.body: I have used the Oral-B electric toothbrushes for many years. I’ve been told I have a small mouth and the small round head of this toothbrush is perfect for me. It makes every brushing like going to the hygienist—smooth clean teeth. It has a timer for a total of 2 minutes, with a change every 30 seconds to move you through the front and back of both sides of your mouth. I wouldn’t use any other toothbrush.

reviews.title: A great value that comes with power
reviews.body: This is the most powerful electric toothbrush I have ever used! I ordered this toothbrush to replace a manual one that I had. My dentist recommended an electric one so I picked this one up. This is amazing! My teeth have never felt so clean When you first get it, it will come with no charge, so make sure you charge it. In the box, it includes the toothbrush and a charger. You don’t get any extra heads so make sure that you order some. When you do use it though, you will love how clean your teeth get! My teeth have never felt so clean! I use it every day. It is waterproof, so you can take it in the shower, which is perfect for me since my mornings are rushed. It is enjoyable to use and to hold, it’s terrific! One thing I really enjoy about it is the two minute timer. It keeps me accountable to actually brush my teeth for a long enough time, and it doesn’t allow me to brush for a longer time than I have to. It pauses every thirty seconds, so you can brush each quadrant of your teeth for thirty seconds, so you can give one section of your teeth the attention it deserves. With the pros out of the way, I do want to talk about a few cons. There are way too many settings to use. I know that it’s nice to have many options to choose from so we can pick what we want, but you don’t need three different ways to brush your teeth. Most of the time I just click the on button and don’t bother with the other settings and turn it off when I’m done. The other settings aren’t even that different. You can see that in my included video The battery life is also not the best. Some people have reported getting a week or two’s worth of battery, but I’m finding I have to charge mine every five days, which isn’t a dealbreaker, but I travel a lot, so it’s not ideal. Speaking of not ideal, they use a proprietary charger which really makes this toothbrush not travel friendly. You need to take so many chargers with you for your phone and laptop. Those might have the same charger, like USB-C, but this doesn’t. So, you need to take this charger separately. Another thing is that you need to really keep the toothbrush, charger, and any surface it touches, clean and dry. Otherwise, wherever you put this, bacteria will start to build up. If you don’t clean your charger every other day, bacteria will start to build up and it’s gross. The included picture doesn’t do it justice, and that’s just on my sink. Despite my complaints, I really enjoy this toothbrush. It’s relatively inexpensive compared to other electric toothbrushes, it has lasted me a long time, and it’s powerful. I do recommend it!

reviews.title: Great electric toothbrush but head replacement gets pricey!
reviews.body: Great, lightweight electric toothbrush with several different replacement heads to choose from. Lower upfront cost to purchase the toothbrush than other brands or models within the Oral-B family. Recharges fast and is easy to take on trips too. Only issue is with the price of replacement heads - that is where they get you. Just do your research as the brush heads need replacing every few months and it adds up.

reviews.title: Don’t be frightened when your teeth feels clean for the first time!
reviews.body: Absolutely phenomenal. People weren’t lying when they said it feels like you just came from the dentist. I don’t know how it does it, but if you brush the same way you brush with a manual toothbrush, alongside the intense vibration, it feels like it removes 100% of plaque, especially the plaque that’s hard to get behind each tooth. Also, at first, the vibration may feel a little intense, but you’ll get used to it. But if it’s too strong, just press the button and it will go to a slower mode. I highly recommend the strongest mode for the most effectiveness. But hands down, this is the best toothbrush I’ve ever got in my life. I will say, because the brush is small, I usually apply the toothpaste on my finger and place it in my mouth manually, then brush. But that’s my personal preference. I just prefer more toothpaste. And it sits well on the charging pad. I honestly have no complaints.

reviews.title: Excellent!

reviews.title: Great cleaning, versatile options for brush heads, charge lasts, but only 1 speed setting
reviews.body: One of my best purchases. I used to clean my teeth with a manual toothbrush, thinking that if I spent enough time and diligence, it would provide the same level of cleaning as an electric toothbrush. I was wrong. After my very first cleaning with this device, I felt a level of clean teeth only experienced when I leave the dentist's office after a cleaning. And it wasn't just a subjective feeling. When I returned for my 6 month cleaning the next time, there was barely any tartar or plaque build up - all had been removed by this toothbrush. I also noticed that my level of bad breath and tonsil rocks declined significantly. Turns out a manual cleaning is nowhere near as good as this machine. I have purchased this toothbrush for familty and friends, telling them it has changed my life. I wish I had this device as a child! The toothbrush comes with interchangebale heads, so that you can pick the one that works best for you - sensitive teeth, hard brush, whatever. Oral-B makes these products available, but you can also purchase no-name brands as well. It does create quite a bit of vibration in your head that I found a little scary at first. However, despite having sensitive teeth and gums, the toothbrush never harmed them. The toothbrush ahs a pressure sensor that stops once you put it too tightly against your teeth to prevent this. There is supposed to be 3 levels of speed for the brush. Mine doesn't seem to have them - has shown in the video. It's not that I don't know how to operate it - the toothbrush I purchased for my family (in white instead of pink) had those features, as advertized. In the end, I don't feel that having those 3 levels are important, except perhaps to get used to the sensation of vibration in the initial phases of use. The toothbrush comes with a plug and charger. It seems t o keep its charge for 4-5 days (I only use this toothbrush once a day for 4 min). Then the little light at the bottom of the toothbrush turns from green to red, alerting me that it is time to charge it (so I can usually travel without the toothbrush charge if it is for a trip that is less than a week). The charge itself happens very quickly - it seems to be charged within 20 min. I highly recommend this spinning toothbrush. It has changed my mouth's health!

reviews.title: Oral-B Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush, iO5 Win over Philips.
reviews.body: The Oral-B iO5 series toothbrush is an exceptional product, renowned for its durability and quality construction. The toothbrush’s plastic components are robust, ensuring longevity and reliability. The entire unit is designed to withstand rigorous use, embodying the latest advancements in dental technology. One of the standout features of the iO5 series is its Bluetooth connectivity. This innovative feature allows users to sync their toothbrush with their smartphone, enabling them to track their brushing habits and receive personalized recommendations. The toothbrush also includes a range of essential features, such as pressure sensors and timers, to ensure optimal oral hygiene. Notably, the iO5 series is manufactured in Germany, as indicated on the packaging and the toothbrush itself. This commitment to German craftsmanship sets it apart from other brands, such as Philips, which is known for producing inferior products made in Vietnam. In contrast, the iO5 series has proven to be a reliable and effective replacement for my previous Philips toothbrush, which required frequent replacements due to its poor quality. Even my dentist recommended the iO5 series, further solidifying its reputation as a superior dental product. MADE IN GERMANY 🇩🇪

reviews.title: Good for sensitive teeth
reviews.body: I have been told by dentists for years that I should be using an electric toothbrush, but I have VERY sensitive teeth, and every time I used one it sent me through the roof! Well, a couple tooth cracks later and I decided to suck it up and try again. I bought this one because it has a lot of settings, including one for very sensitive teeth. Out of the box it was sleek and solid, and the display was easy to use and intuitive. It did take some getting used to, and I used it with warm water, but it did not hurt, which was thrilling for me! Now, several months later, I can say that I love this toothbrush and that it genuinely cleans my teeth really well! I am not one for pairing things with apps or my phone, so I can't comment on that side of the toothbrush, but it does have a pressure sensor that lights up red or green to let you know if you are bruising too hard or too lightly as you go. The battery lasts a long time, as do the heads, and it comes with a travel case as a bonus. Two thumbs up!

reviews.title: Works Great but App is Okay
reviews.body: I had the old style Oral-B before and was ready for a new toothbrush. The IO5 was on sale so I bought it. I didn't think I'd use the app at all but it turns out that the gamification of my oral hygiene is a positive for me. I brush longer and use the guided brushing to make sure I'm getting full coverage. The only thing is that the zone identification is sketchy. On almost every brushing, it indicates the wrong active area of my teeth. I've tried Oral-B's recommendations- stand straight, do each tooth one at a time, move to different segments, repeat on inside and bite surfaces- but it still misdetects zones. What that does is make me brush even longer, so not terrible, but better accuracy would be much better and, frankly, I expected much better. Occasional it totally glitches and I need to restart the app and the brush. I also thought the battery would lastonger but it's about the same as my OG Oral-B electric that was around $40. Note that I am probably brushing longer, so maybe the battery is a little better but I hoped for 3 weeks and I'm getting less than 2 between charges. I still like the brush, but just know the app guidance doesn't work as well as you'd think. I do like that it reminds you to floss, brush your tongue, and use a mouth rinse. It also gives you a score for each session and a running score, which I like even though I thought I'd never use that. In summary, it works well and my dentist noticed a difference and told me to keep it up. It is a bit expensive for an electric toothbrush, so I hope it lasts a long time.

reviews.title: Amazing toothbrush

reviews.title: Not Recommended
reviews.body: I would not buy this product again. While it has several issues I could overlook, one major problem makes it unusable for me. The vibration of this brush feels “off” in a way that makes me dizzy and gives me a headache every time I use it, and I’m not someone who normally gets headaches. I actually dread brushing my teeth with it, and at this point I’ll probably just accept the $60 loss and purchase something else. The strange part is that the brush isn’t loud and the vibration doesn’t feel particularly strong, yet something about the way it operates gives me headaches even on the lowest setting. There are also other issues that add to my frustration. The brush head doesn’t come with a cover, yet the instructions recommend removing it after each use to clean and dry it. That means it has to sit uncovered on its side, which isn’t ideal for keeping it clean. The timer is also odd. It gives the standard 30‑second alerts for a 2‑minute brushing cycle, but it doesn’t turn off at the end. It just keeps running and continues the 30‑second pulses. To power it down, you have to click through every mode, there’s no simple one‑button off option, unless I am missing instructions. Another strange issue is that while my teeth feel polished after use, my mouth as a whole doesn’t feel clean. I’ve used the same toothpaste for years and have never had this bad taste in my mouth after brushing. It’s disgusting and it’s super frustrating. Overall, I cannot recommend this product. And if you suffer from headaches, I would stay far away.

reviews.title: Works well, but high maintenance
reviews.body: The toothbrush works quite well and I'm satisfied with it. It makes my teeth feel clean and polished. The battery charge lasts a very long time. I find the timers a little annoying as I actually spend more time brushing than they would indicate. They give you two brushes, but they aren't the same. I guess that's OK so you can decide which type to order in the future. I use a regular toothbrush in the morning and this one at bedtime. I do this because to clean it after each use as directed takes a little time. Then you're supposed to balance the brush facing up and the handle facing down until dry. (I set them on a face cloth and lean them against an adjacent cabinet). So, the only time I use the stand is when it needs charging. With all of that said, I would still recommend it. Just know what you're getting into.

reviews.title: Hygienist Approved Clean That’ll Make You Smile Wider
reviews.body: TL;DR: The Oral-B iO Series 2 turned my semi-okay brushing routine into something my dental hygienist actually high-fived me for. Quiet motor, smart pressure sensor, and three useful modes mean it’s basically a tiny personal trainer for your teeth—and it works. ________________________________________ What I Love Feature Real World Impact Automatic Pressure Sensor lights up red and slows the head if I press too hard, so my gums are finally spared my “scrub like a sidewalk” technique. 3 Modes (Super Sensitive, Gentle, Daily Clean) I start on Super Sensitive first thing in the morning, switch to Daily Clean after coffee—versatility without overthinking it. 2 Minute Timer with 30 Second Pulses Reminds me to hit every quadrant. No more guessing whether I’ve done my time. Whisper Quiet Motor Barely louder than a kitten’s purr—no bathroom wake-up calls for anyone still sleeping. Long-lasting battery. One charge lasted me an entire weeklong trip (twice daily brushing). ________________________________________ Results That Actually Show My hygienist recommended this after a lecture on plaque, and three months later, she spent most of my check-up admiring how little scraping she had to do. In her words: “Whatever you’re using, keep using it.” Translation: The iO Series 2 is doing its job. ________________________________________ Small Gripes (but nothing deal-breaking) • No travel case in the starter kit—had to toss it in a zip lock for my trip. • Replacement heads cost more than generic ones, but you’re paying for the iO’s magnetic tech. I swap mine every ~3 months to stay frugal. ________________________________________ Bottom Line If you’re ready to graduate from manual brushing (or an older, rattly electric) to something that polices your pressure and times your session, this is an easy win. The improvement in my check-up alone justifies the price, and the sleek “Night Black” handle looks sharp on the counter. Would buy again in a heartbeat—and my hygienist would probably throw me another high five.

I haven’t updated my electric toothbrush in many years. I had an older model of the same brand, and it just seemed like the motor/batter had gotten weak and it wasn’t functioning that well anymore. I got this on a prime day sale so it is absolutely worth the money, however having used it now I would have been happy paying full price for the update in quality compared to my old brush. I haven’t been able to test the battery life yet, but we have travel coming up so I am happy that it comes with a travel case. Personally I love the modern look of the black brush, but it was hard to choose a color. It actually does feel nice to hold as well, when comparing it to my old one. reviews.title: Healthier Gums and a Cleaner Smile
reviews.body: I’ve been very pleased with this Philips Sonicare toothbrush. After using it consistently, I’ve noticed a significant improvement in my gum health. My gums no longer bleed when I brush, which has been a wonderful and encouraging change. The toothbrush leaves my teeth feeling much cleaner than a manual toothbrush, and I appreciate the built-in timer that helps me brush for the recommended amount of time. The different cleaning modes are easy to use, and the battery life has been excellent between charges. As a retired pharmacist, I understand how important good oral hygiene is to overall health. Investing in a quality electric toothbrush has been well worth it, and seeing healthier gums has been the biggest benefit for me. I would highly recommend the Philips Sonicare to anyone looking to improve their oral health, especially if they’re experiencing sensitive or bleeding gums. With regular use and good brushing habits, it has made a noticeable difference for me.

reviews.title: Best electric toothbrush (when on sale)

reviews.title: Fantastic clean, superb build quality, and great battery life
reviews.body: As an Amazon Vine Voice reviewer, I have tested my fair share of personal care devices, and the Philips Sonicare 5950 Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush immediately sets a high bar. Out of the box, you can tell this is a top tier, premium product with a lot of thought put into the engineering and design. The matte black finish looks sleek on the bathroom counter, but more importantly, the build quality feels incredibly solid. The handle has a nice weight to it, offering a comfortable, ergonomic grip that does not feel slippery when wet. The buttons have a satisfying click with zero play, and the brush heads snap on with a tight, precise fit. It feels durable and well sealed against water, which is essential for long term use. When it comes to performance, it leaves your teeth with that fresh, dentist clean feel every single time. The sonic vibration power is strong and consistent without feeling harsh on your gums, and the pressure sensor works like a charm to let you know if you are pressing too hard. Having the two brush heads included in the box is a great touch, making it ready for months of use right away. The battery life is equally impressive. A single full charge easily lasts for weeks of twice daily brushing, making it super convenient for travel without having to haul extra cords around. If you are looking for a high quality, reliable electric toothbrush that looks modern and delivers serious cleaning power, this one is worth every penny. Extremely well made and easily recommended.

reviews.title: Must be the 10th a buy
reviews.body: These Sonicare ebrushes work pretty well. We rely on them for daily cleaning and we are pretty satisfied with them. Use the provided travel container when packing them ( my wife did not and it broke) or at least take out the brush. They tend to collect some crap between the brush and the handle. They last a couple years before the buttons cover breaks up and water enter the handle, affecting the battery. Twice happened to me and they start vibrating unexpectedly like they are possed LOL ( hence the 4 stars.)

reviews.title: Amazing Toothbrush
reviews.body: Amazing. I have been using Sonicare toothbrushes for over 20 years. I decided it was time for an upgrade, but never knew they had so many versions. I chose this series as it appeared to have the right amount of bells and whistles I needed, and it was affordable. Wow. I have never been so impressed by a toothbrush, and did not realize there would be such a difference compared to my older simple version. It is powerful, but soft on the gums, so my teeth feel like they're getting scrubbed, yet there is no irritation or pressure on the gums. It has different speeds, including one for gum health. Weird to be going on so much over a toothbrush, but what a difference. Looking forward to my next dental appointment for the real truth.

reviews.title: I never had a tooth brush like this.
reviews.body: I used to just have the mediocre vibrating toothbrushes but at work I would notice spots the brush missed. After my dentist recommended something like this, I checked it out for Prime Day and saw it was around $50 so I decided to try it out and i was blown away at how clean my teeth felt after one brushing! It was like leaving the dentists office after they cleaned your teeth. Definitely worth the price but try and wait for a sale 💕 I charged it once out of the box and within 2 months I still am at full charge! Comes with a travel case too.

reviews.title: Best toothbrush made!
reviews.body: I had a Sonocare a long time ago and switched to Oral-B because I liked it better. My dentist told me she thought the Sonocare was better for cleaning and gums so I switched to the Sonocare. I was surprised by how much it has improved over the years. My teeth feel much cleaner after brushing. The Sonocare is much more powerful and the head is much faster now. I expect my next checkup and cleaning to be much better. If you have sensitive teeth it offers 3 speeds to fit your needs. After I brush now my teeth feel like they were just cleaned at the dentist office. My only complaint is the price of replacement brush heads, ridiculous high prices are a typical USA industry ripping off Americans witch is out of control!

reviews.title: Works well but check replacement brushes
reviews.body: This Philips Sonicare electric toothbrush was recommended by a friend and seems to be a good product. The unit provides a "time-frame" for brushing and if used in accordance to the directions, really does provide a fresher feeling to teeth. Purchasing replacement brushes proved to be somewhat challenging, as there are multiple different models and the replacement brushes do not fit all models. Recommend that this is sourced at the time of purchase.

reviews.title: Great toothbrush!
reviews.body: Works very well, easy to use. The pressure sensitivity alert is a helpful prompt to ease up. It's been a couple weeks and my teeth feel clean and look a little whiter. Side note: love that the packaging was quite compact and used paper vs plastic packaging.

reviews.title: Best toothbrush ever
reviews.body: I can't believe I thought I was brushing well with a manual toothbrush. It's like night and day. With the Sonicare toothbrush my teeth and mouth feel as clean as right after I've had a dental cleaning. The toothbrush is powerful and well-made. It's comfortable to use. I love the purple handle! reviews.title: Dental care brush is highly recommended
reviews.body: Well packaged, arrived when stated. Top notch electric tooth brush, purchased two units 2 months ago. 3 speeds, 3 cleaning methods - whitens, cleans, whitens + clean. Good battery life. Had to buy cord for charger, but not a problem when considering how well this works. Comes with 2 brushes. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Perfect Toothbrush for Daily Cleaning
reviews.body: This toothbrush is awesome. First of all, you can tell how much battery life is left by the three dots at the base. So much better than the last Sonicare toothbrush that I owned. The clean level is perfect for a thorough brushing. Not too hard or damaging to your gums. I love the travel case too, because it's the same size as the toothbrush. Takes up less space when traveling than my old one did.

reviews.title: Good toothbrush, but I miss the extra features
reviews.body: Overall, this is a great electric toothbrush. It cleans well, has good battery life, and leaves my teeth feeling fresh after every use. The only reason I gave it 4 stars is because I miss my older Sonicare model, which had more cleaning modes and customization options. If you’re coming from a basic toothbrush, you’ll probably love it, but if you’re upgrading from an older premium Sonicare, you may notice some missing features. Overall, it’s still a solid toothbrush that I’d recommend.

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.body: This is my first electric toothbrush and I really like it! It comes with a lot of battery already on it so I haven't even charged it yet and I've been using it for a few weeks. It seems heavy duty and I like the options for sensitivity, whitening, etc. The app is neat too so I can see stats on how much I've brushed, how many brushes until I have to charge it again, and can easily buy brushes heads. reviews.title: I LOVE THIS SONICARE!!
reviews.body: HOLY SMOKES! This is by far the best Sonicare toothbrush I have owned. We have been using Sonicare brushes for the last 23 years and have gone through several (always bought the two in one pack from big box store) over the years. Well mine puttered out so I needed just one so where do I go? You got it. Amazon. :) After much research and reading all reviews I decided to give this one a try. WOWZA what a difference in vibration & noise level. I think all Sonicare brushes are on the expensive side but once you try you just can't go back. That being said the value for this particular brush was within budget range so I jumped and boy am I glad I did. I LOVE IT!

reviews.title: Absolutely Excellent Oral-B Electric Toothbrush with a Soft Brush Head

This Oral-B IO is exceptional and arrived fully charged. Also, it did a great job cleaning my teeth leaving my mouth feeling fresh. There are several reviews that mention the single included brush head is stiff. I’ve not had the same experience. Perhaps I received a different brush head.

reviews.title: A Game-Changer for My Dental Routine — Noticeable Results and Effortless to Use
reviews.body: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I’ve been using this electric toothbrush for close to a year now, and I absolutely love it. Before this, I was using a regular manual toothbrush, and I truly had no idea what I was missing. The difference is enormous — this toothbrush cleans my teeth so much better and leaves my mouth feeling like I just left the dentist. One of the things that really convinced me it was working was my six-month dental appointment. My hygienist actually commented on how clean my teeth looked compared to previous visits. I hadn’t changed anything else in my routine except for switching to this toothbrush, so that alone made me a believer. It’s rechargeable, which is incredibly convenient, and the battery lasts a long time before needing to be plugged in again. The design is sleek — I have the white one, and it looks great on my bathroom counter. It also offers multiple brushing speeds, which I didn’t think I needed until I tried them. Being able to choose the intensity makes brushing feel more personalized and comfortable. The best part is how effortless it is to use. I don’t feel like I’m doing much of the work anymore — the toothbrush does it for me. My teeth feel cleaner with far less effort, and once you experience that, it’s hard to go back to anything else. Final Rating: 5 Stars — Amazing performance, noticeable results, and a must-have upgrade from a regular toothbrush.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.body: Easy to use and great for beginners. My teeth have definitely been getting whiter from the settings. Would recommend!

reviews.title: Torn between this and the other brand
reviews.body: Been a Sonicare user for 10-15 years and decided I wanted to try the Oral B. I didn't want to spend a lot, so I found this one and ordered it. Things I like: Love circular motion of the brush instead of the up an down movement of the Sonicare. Love that it has a sensor to alert you if you are brushing too hard. Such a simple feature and hopefully it shows on my next dental visit. Battery seems to last a long time between charges. I am going on two weeks without charging which is great for travel. Like that the handle stays cleaner compared to my older Sonicare because of how it is designed. Toothpaste and water run down it and does not have a place to collect. Things I don't like: The brush had by design traps water whereas the Sonicare brush design seems to drain water better. I rinse my toothbrush and then lay it brush side down on a towel to let it dry before standing it up on the counter or charger. If not, I worry about it not drying fully and things growing. I hate that it doesn't have an auto shut off. It does vibrate every 30 seconds but it doesn't shut off. First time I used it I probably brushed for 3.5 minutes before I realized it wasn't going to turn off. Overall the quality doesn't seem as nice. Maybe this would be different if I had spent more money on a higher end model, but because this something I was just buying to try, I didn't want to spend a lot. If I was completely sold on this brush, I would upgrade for sure. I really am torn between the two brands of brushes. Now if someone would make one that has the best of both. :)

reviews.title: Amazing Brush and Heads
reviews.body: I finally updated my old Oral B Pro electric toothbrush that I have used for 10+ years when it was on sale during Prime days. I figured why switch if it wasn’t broken. I’m not sure that it is the brush, it might be the more expensive Oral B replacement brush heads. Either way you don’t need to buy the more expensive Oral B i09 with so many modes. The more reasonably priced i02 is all you need. I may return the Waterpik flosser my hygienist recommended for easier flossing of my back teeth. I bought it for a great price during Prime days too. I haven’t opened the box yet. My new electric Oral B i02 toothbrush works so well, I think the waterpik is an extra step that maybe is no longer needed.

reviews.title: Big Performance Without the Big Price Tag: A Total Game Changer
reviews.body: I used to rely strictly on an Oral-B rotary toothbrush, but after picking up a cheap vibrating brush on a whim, I realized how much I preferred sonic vibration. Deciding it was time to step up to a proper rechargeable unit, I chose this one, and it has been an absolute game changer. In fact, I loved my first one so much that I ended up buying a couple more for family members. Real-World Details & Performance The feature that immediately stands out is the variety of oscillating patterns. Each setting delivers a distinctly different vibration feel, making it easy to switch up depending on what feels best for a deep clean. The shape of the brush head is exceptionally comfortable in the mouth, and the cleaning power easily outperforms my old Oral-B—I honestly don't see myself ever going back to a rotating head. While I haven't tried ultra-premium brands like Sonicare, I can't imagine they offer much more than what this unit delivers. Another massive plus is the value packed into the box: it comes with enough replacement heads to last a full year, making it effortless to swap in a fresh head every few months for that brand-new, fresh-from-the-dentist feeling. Pros & Cons Pros: Multiple Effective Modes: Distinct oscillating patterns that allow you to customize your clean. Superior Clean & Ergonomics: Head shape fits comfortably and cleans noticeably better than traditional rotary brushes. Outstanding Value: Includes a full year’s supply of replacement heads right out of the box. High Satisfaction: Fantastic overall performance that prompted me to buy additional units for family. Cons: Sonic Transition: If you are strictly used to rotating/rotary brush heads, the intense sonic vibration takes a couple of days to get used to. Final Verdict I highly recommend this toothbrush to anyone looking to upgrade to a high-performing sonic toothbrush without paying the inflated price tag of big-name brands. It delivers fantastic performance, incredible value, and a top-notch clean.

reviews.title: An absolute game-changer for kids with braces!
reviews.body: I originally purchased two of these electric toothbrushes for my kids after our orthodontist highly recommended switching from manual brushing to help keep their braces clean. Anyone with kids in braces knows exactly how difficult it is to get them to brush effectively around all those brackets and wires! These toothbrushes have been an absolute lifesaver. First off, my kids actually love using them. The brushing modes are incredibly effective at sweeping away food and plaque, but gentle enough that they don't irritate their gums. They find the handles easy to maneuver, and the built-in timer keeps them brushing for the right amount of time without me having to stand there and nag. It has taken the daily battle completely out of our morning and bedtime routines. The absolute best part, however, has been the results. At our last checkup, our dentist specifically went out of their way to comment on how incredibly clean their teeth are now. They noted a massive improvement in plaque removal around the orthodontic hardware compared to when we were using standard manual brushes. If you are a parent on the fence about upgrading to an electric toothbrush, especially if you are dealing with braces, this is 100% worth the investment. The quality is fantastic, the kids are happy, and the dentist is thrilled. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Great value, cleans well

To get 8 brush heads, charging stand and this quality for this price (on sale for $8.99) is such a great deal. I had tried another brand for the same price before I found this one. The brush heads were too small and soft to clean well and it had no charging stand and limited features. I struggled with it for a year and a half before it died. I'm so happy to have found this one as a replacement. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Fantastic price point for such a capable little brush!
reviews.body: This is great, especially for the price point. It's a fantastic value. If you just want a basic oral, this is the one. It's just like the big guy, perfectly soft bristles, it's not vibration so much as just buzzing and it shouldn't bother your hands. Looks great on the counter. It has a nice group of settings, there's no "AI" brushing but I had it on my last one and it wasn't much use. Durability is yet to be determined although it looks like the same as my other one. It's rechargeable and so far I made it a, week without recharging, so I'd rate it's portability as an A+, you get a travel case with it too. Very pleased with this purchase.

reviews.title: Better than Phillips Sonicare. App is actually useful and not just a gimmick.
reviews.body: So, I'm a long-time user of Sonicare, which means I've gone through a number of them that always tend to break right at warranty expiry. Though I usually find them on sale, they are not cheap, nor are the brushes, and for the price they are still so prone to breaking down and various issues. So, when my current one started to have an issue (turning on randomly on its own, startling all around), I started shopping for a replacement. This Oral B brush went on sale, so I decided to check it out - maybe return if it wasn't all that great in comparison. At first, I was a little confused, because I thought these brushes mainly worked by rotation, but they are both that and sonication. I don't know if the vibration speed matches to Sonicare, but it doesn't seem critical. One immediate thing I noticed was the light ring which instantly lets you know if you are pressing too hard or not enough. As somebody with gum issues, this is appreciated. Next thing, do set up and try out the app. I was skeptical, but it really does a good job of figuring out what part of your mouth you are brushing, apparently by some kind of bluetooth-based sonar and something in the brush that can tell if it's facing up or down. It's not to the level of knowing which tooth, but it maps the front and two sides of both the top and bottom of your mouth, which is still pretty detailed. Rather than just using some kind of timer, it tracks that you spend the proper amount of time in each of the 6 regions. Your coverage within each region is then up to you. Sure, there are some times when it is a bit off, but I find that that tends to happen if I turn my head. So if you keep your head still, it seems to work more accurately. Not too hard to do. Besides the main brush tracking, you can set specific goals, and it will add recommendations for other steps like tongue brushing and flossing. I started a program for plaque removal. So now, instead of brushing or not kind of mindlessly in the shower one a day, I have started brushing twice a day, with more intention, and it's even slightly fun. And so far, my teeth feel smoother and cleaner. I also get less gum bleed, perhaps due to avoiding pressing too hard. I think this is still a bit pricey at full price, but maybe in this case it could be worth it for the improvement in your teeth and gum health. On sale, I can definitely recommend. Will it last long term? We'll see.

reviews.title: Smart, Powerful, and Leaves Teeth Feeling Dentist-Clean
reviews.body: I’ve been using the Oral-B iO5 and it’s honestly a huge upgrade from a regular toothbrush. The cleaning power is excellent—my teeth feel noticeably smoother and cleaner after every use. The micro-vibrations combined with the round brush head really make a difference, removing more plaque than a manual brush. What I really like is the smart pressure sensor and guided brushing. It helps you avoid brushing too hard and improves your technique over time, which is great for gum health. It’s also very easy to use, with multiple modes depending on your needs (sensitive, whitening, daily clean, etc.), and the overall design feels premium and comfortable. Overall, this is a high-quality electric toothbrush that delivers a professional-level clean at home—definitely worth it if you want to upgrade your oral care routine.

reviews.title: Charging
reviews.body: I love my toothbrush. The bristles are very good, it has just enough power. I will say however, my only complaint is the battery does not seem to last that long! Other than that I have no complaints

reviews.title: ★★★★★ A favorite in our house
reviews.body: This has quickly become a favorite for our entire family. Everyone has used it, and it's been a great purchase from day one. The quality is better than we expected, and it's easy to use, making it something we reach for regularly. What I appreciate most is that it has held up well with multiple people using it. It does exactly what it's supposed to do, and we haven't had any issues with it so far. If you're considering buying one, I wouldn't hesitate to recommend it. It's been a great value for our family, and we'd definitely purchase it again.

reviews.title: Very Nice Device
reviews.body: I had a different brand before this one and that one was my first electric toothbrush. One thing I didn’t like about it was the size of the brush head. It was too narrow and since it was a vibration device only, the head material being plastic was very uncomfortable to use and the vibration of the head material against my teeth was annoying if you didn’t hold it just right. The size of the head was very small and narrow so it seemed to take a long time to get the job done. After receiving and using this device, what a difference it made. Very easy to use and cleaned extremely well. The brush head size was perfect and comfortable and even though there is some vibration, it was very comfortable and easy to get used to and wasn’t annoying. As far as cleaning goes, this device was exceptional and did a fantastic job on the first try, the rotation of the heads really seem to help clean. The APP mapping of the brushing worked great and let me know where I needed to brush and for how long. It’s not a cheap brush but so far seems to be well worth the expense. It came with three brush heads and I used the ultimate clean one only so far and did a great job. The brush heads may seem expensive but if the system does what it’s supposed to do then I’m all in. So far I’m very pleased with my purchase and delivery was received overnight so delivery was quick as usual from Amazon.

reviews.title: Good: Great cleaning - Bad: MESSY -- a 2 min brushing turns into 4 mins of cleanup
reviews.body: To be clear, the cleaning power gets five stars. However, this is the messiest toothbrush I've ever used. The brush heads have two holes in the back, and you might think you could _hold_ it a certain way to keep toothpaste and spit from getting everywhere. You would be wrong. If you've never had a smart electric toothbrush, the ideas here are very cool and mostly useful, but be prepared to have a LOT more cleanup when done than simply rinsing the head under the sink and wiping your mouth. Pay close attention, or you'll have stains on your shirt. Toothpaste WILL be on your chin, your hand, and dribbling down your arm, unless you keep your elbow raised for the duration! I love the ideas and how well it cleans my teeth, but for the reasons mentioned above, I can't really recommend this to people I actually like.

reviews.title: Incredible clean, with every penny
reviews.body: My roommate was raving about this toothbrush that he bought for himself a month ago. He knows I try to take good care of my teeth, and encouraged me to consider getting one, I’ve been using a manual toothbrush for my entire adult life. I had a ver basic electric toothbrush when I was a teenager, but it was not great, so I was skeptical, as I thought I did a pretty great job caring for my teeth with a manual one, but OH MY GOD was I wrong! I took a leap of faith and bought the io 5 with three different heads. I got it on sale. Well, very first time I used it, I felt like I had gone to the dentist to get my teeth cleaned and polished. My teeth feel sooooo good. I am currently also using the app, which is sorta fun, it maps out and tracks where you have brushed and how long, and the pressure guide is very helpful! It also tracks flossing, tongue cleaning and mouth wash rinsing, and you get trophies for completing a full mouth cleaning routine. It’s really helped me to commit to consistent oral care. If you don’t have benefits to get dental cleanings, I genuinely and honestly strongly suggest that you get this toothbrush. I honestly don’t think I’ll ever need to go get a dental cleaning done now that I have this tooth brush. Also, if you don’t have dental benefits, it is very much in your best interest to get this toothbrush, as dental repair is very expensive and having this brush is likely going to greatly reduce your risk of serious tooth problems. Also, I learned that it has a dual oscillating plus micro vibrations, which is why it cleans so well. I will undoubtedly buy another one of these when the time comes, maybe even level up and get the top of the line. Have only had it for a few days, so I can’t speak for its longevity or durability yet, but if it craps out, I’ll update my review. Seriously, do yourself a favour and get this toothbrush.

reviews.title: Didn’t last a year
reviews.body: I’m really disappointed with this purchase. I bought this Oral-B toothbrush from Amazon less than a year ago, and it completely stopped working after just 11 months of normal use. For a product from a well-known brand like Oral-B, I expected much better durability and quality. It was working fine at first, but suddenly it just stopped turning on, and there was no visible damage or misuse on my end. This feels like poor value for money, especially considering the price point. I also expected it to last well beyond a year, so having it fail this quickly is frustrating. reviews.title: Elevate Your Dental Routine with this electric Toothbrush!

reviews.title: Lasted 12 years before I had to buy it again! Superior clean without the hefty price.
reviews.body: After an incredible 12-year run with my first Oral-B Pro 1000, I finally bought it again! The battery on my original brush finally bit the dust, and toward the end, it would only stay charged enough to get me through 24 hours of teeth brushing (if I was lucky) before dying. However, I loved the performance so much over the last decade that replacing it with the exact same model was an absolute no-brainer. Here is why this brush is a classic: Hygienist Approved: My dental hygienist once told me that it really doesn't matter how fancy or expensive an electric toothbrush is—any solid electric toothbrush is far superior to a manual brush. This model gives you that elite, professional clean without making you pay for unnecessary, over-hyped tech features. The One Minor Con: If I have to name one downside, it is the noise. Even brand new out of the box, it does sound a bit like it might be powered by hamsters while it is working. But just because it doesn't sound whisper-quiet doesn't negate the fact that it is a remarkably solid, heavy-duty toothbrush. A Note on the Color: The color is fun, but the listing is a bit misleading. I thought I would be getting a mint green, but instead, it is definitely a powder blue. I much prefer green to blue, but eh, whatever—it still cleans my teeth perfectly! If you want a proven, durable electric toothbrush that will last you for years to come without draining your wallet, this is the one to get. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Crooked, Overcrowded, Yellow Teeth
reviews.body: Let me start this review by saying that when I was younger, much to my parent's dismay, I neglected to brush my teeth. I would brush them but not as often and as thoroughly as a child should. This was partly due to my very bad gag reflex and partly due to the fact that it felt painful (?). Anyway, I've had yellow teeth my whole life (I'm 29) because of it. I never got braces (thanks again gag reflex) but my parents tried everything to get me to have better oral hygiene and to have a more aesthetically pleasing smile. Now that I'm well into adulthood, my smile being so yellow, and also very crowded, was starting to bother me. I knew I had to give in and fix one or the other. (To be clear if you have crooked teeth don't feel like you have to change yourself just for society - after 29 years, I can say that I truly wanted to change the yellowness purely for myself). I've gotten healthier in almost all other aspects of my life. I decided to make the plunge and buy this in hopes it would help get my teeth cleaner and help reduce plaque buildup. Not just for aesthetics, but for actual oral hygiene. So, I've used it twice a day for 3 days so far and my brother commented on how "white" my teeth look yesterday evening. That felt very good to hear, not gonna lie. I think this toothbrush is amazing for the price. I love how tiny the head of the brush is. It fits into my small, overcrowded mouth perfectly. I was worried that it would take forever to brush my teeth since I wasn't doing the work, the toothbrush was. However, it takes about 2 minutes and 30 seconds or 3 minutes if you're extra thorough. It allots 30 seconds to each section of your mouth, it will do a variation in the vibration to let you know when the 30 seconds is up and to move to the next portion of your mouth. It doesn't automatically shut off after 3 minutes (that I know of) if you want to go back and do another section of your mouth, which is nice. As for the pressure sensor on the toothbrush, mine does not work. It doesn't indicate any color or anything. It just appears to be a normal electric toothbrush. I may have gotten a "bad" toothbrush since it's not working, but to be honest, I truly just wanted something that would do a deep clean and this toothbrush does that. However, all the other reviews mention the sensor working so if that's something you're looking for, I would still highly recommend this toothbrush. I think mine might just be a dud in that department. The charging took several hours to be full on the first day. I keep it on the charger to ensure that it is always fully charged. If you don't have your charger with you and you need to rely on it without it, I'm told the battery lasts up to a week. Which, is very impressive for a $50 toothbrush. Amazon says that it has Bluetooth connectivity but I do not see any indication of that on the boxes or in the manual. My parents bought me an electric toothbrush when I was little, but I was too young to appreciate it. Now that I'm older, I think this is a great option for any person of any age. I do recommend it!

reviews.title: I love this toothbrush
reviews.body: I have used the Oral-B electric toothbrushes for many years. I’ve been told I have a small mouth and the small round head of this toothbrush is perfect for me. It makes every brushing like going to the hygienist—smooth clean teeth. It has a timer for a total of 2 minutes, with a change every 30 seconds to move you through the front and back of both sides of your mouth. I wouldn’t use any other toothbrush.

reviews.title: A great value that comes with power
reviews.body: This is the most powerful electric toothbrush I have ever used! I ordered this toothbrush to replace a manual one that I had. My dentist recommended an electric one so I picked this one up. This is amazing! My teeth have never felt so clean When you first get it, it will come with no charge, so make sure you charge it. In the box, it includes the toothbrush and a charger. You don’t get any extra heads so make sure that you order some. When you do use it though, you will love how clean your teeth get! My teeth have never felt so clean! I use it every day. It is waterproof, so you can take it in the shower, which is perfect for me since my mornings are rushed. It is enjoyable to use and to hold, it’s terrific! One thing I really enjoy about it is the two minute timer. It keeps me accountable to actually brush my teeth for a long enough time, and it doesn’t allow me to brush for a longer time than I have to. It pauses every thirty seconds, so you can brush each quadrant of your teeth for thirty seconds, so you can give one section of your teeth the attention it deserves. With the pros out of the way, I do want to talk about a few cons. There are way too many settings to use. I know that it’s nice to have many options to choose from so we can pick what we want, but you don’t need three different ways to brush your teeth. Most of the time I just click the on button and don’t bother with the other settings and turn it off when I’m done. The other settings aren’t even that different. You can see that in my included video The battery life is also not the best. Some people have reported getting a week or two’s worth of battery, but I’m finding I have to charge mine every five days, which isn’t a dealbreaker, but I travel a lot, so it’s not ideal. Speaking of not ideal, they use a proprietary charger which really makes this toothbrush not travel friendly. You need to take so many chargers with you for your phone and laptop. Those might have the same charger, like USB-C, but this doesn’t. So, you need to take this charger separately. Another thing is that you need to really keep the toothbrush, charger, and any surface it touches, clean and dry. Otherwise, wherever you put this, bacteria will start to build up. If you don’t clean your charger every other day, bacteria will start to build up and it’s gross. The included picture doesn’t do it justice, and that’s just on my sink. Despite my complaints, I really enjoy this toothbrush. It’s relatively inexpensive compared to other electric toothbrushes, it has lasted me a long time, and it’s powerful. I do recommend it!
